chapters.title: Chapter 1251: Slaughter Blood Domain
paragraphs: After taking Zhang Chen and the others for a stroll in the Sun-Moon Domain, Zhang Fei [5] brought them back to the Moonlit Passion Sect. However, he discovered that almost all of his main harem members had gone to other domains, accompanied by Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, Ye Zhiye, and several other senior women.

Zhang Fei [5] didn’t mind and went to inspect the sect’s grounds. Meanwhile, Zhang Chen, Luo Yunxiao, and several women who had previously accompanied him to the Sun-Moon Domain immediately returned to the back mountain, where they cultivated by the Celestial Yin Lake.

Even though his sect had quite many disciples after the merger with the Blazing Union Sect, Zhang Fei [5] was not satisfied because the majority of them were dual cultivators with limited fighting abilities.
Zhang Fei [5] decided to meet with Jin Zhongli, Jian Kuang, Zhuxian Sheng, and several other senior cultivators. He discussed his plans to strengthen the disciples and improve their combat abilities.

Jian Kuang was too lazy to train those disciples, as he wasn’t a member of the sect and was used to living an unrestrained life. However, he changed his mind after Zhang Fei [5] expressed his thoughts about the dangers they might face in the future, and Feng Yao’s three subordinates supported his words on the matter.

Just like Jian Kuang, Zhuxian Sheng also had no direct ties to the Moonlit Passion Sect, and he went to the sect only to train Zhang Fei [5] at Feng Yao’s request. He felt that he didn’t need his training after they sparred daily for over a month, and he considered leaving the sect.

However, Zhuxian Sheng did not belittle Zhang Fei [5]’s words about the dangers, and since he could not help him with cultivation resources or the like, he agreed to his request to train the sect’s disciples and people from the Three Mortal Realms.
Zhang Fei [5] decided to contact Feng Yao, and the phoenix princess agreed to his request to send some of her other subordinates to help him train them.

Zhang Fei [5] asked Elmyra, Huo Lanyin, Lin Jingxia, Ji Changlan, Gong Ren, Cheng Gaoji, and Duannmu Luolan to select people in their sects who were talented in healing, alchemy, formation arrays, and blacksmithing.

Zhang Fei [5] also asked Zhong Yan, Huang Rong, Yang Lu’er, and several other women from Earth to start setting up their new shops, starting with their current domain. He believed that their sects would continue to develop, and they would gain more disciples in the future, so he needed more resources for them.
After they dispersed, Zhang Fei [5] went to see Tian Shuixiang and discussed his plan to go to the Slaughter Blood Domain. "When are we going to leave?"
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly. "My original body is still learning two ice body techniques, which are more difficult than I previously imagined."

"Haha." Tian Shuixiang laughed at that. "Of all the basic elements, the ice element has always been the most difficult to learn because most ice techniques require extreme cold. However, you are lucky because you know the ice phoenix races, and one of your wives is an ice phoenix."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in agreement with him. "Have you contacted your acquaintances in the Slaughter Blood Domain?"
"Yes." Tian Shuixiang nodded slightly. "Once we arrive, I will take you to meet him directly, and he will guide us through the secret passage to the Blood Sea."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] then turned to Nalan Wangzi, who was flying towards them. "I thought you were still enjoying your reunion with Yuzhu."

"Haha." Nalan Wangzi giggled. "I’ve spent a few months with my sister in your training space, so I’m satisfied with that. Moreover, you wanted to go to the Slaughter Blood Domain, so I was thinking of going with you to that domain."
"We—"
"Hey!" Nalan Wangzi interrupted Zhang Fei [5] before wearing an artifact, which caused her aura to change. "Can you feel it?"
"Your aura is like mine." Tian Shuixiang nodded.
Zhang Fei [5] observed Nalan Wangzi’s artifact up close. "How can you change your aura to be like that of an asura demon?"

"This artifact is a disguise tool that retains the auras of those I have previously defeated." I once defeated someone from the asura demon race in the past, and this artifact remembers her aura, which allows me to use her aura to disguise mine." Zhang Fei [5] was genuinely interested in Nalan Wangzi’s artifact. "Unfortunately, the person who created this artifact is long dead, and my mother has tried asking others to create another one, but that person always ends up dead."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded his head a few times. "Since you can disguise your aura, I’ll take you with us to that domain. However, I need you to lend this artifact to Gong Ren and Cheng Gaojie, and I’ll ask them to create one or more."
"Hmm?" Nalan Wangzi raised her eyebrows.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately spoke to her again. "Gong Ren and Cheng Gaojie do come from the Three Mortal Realms, but they both love artifact forging, and their skills in that field are quite impressive. Your mother’s chosen people may not be able to create one, but I’ve always had confidence in their abilities, and I believe they can create several copies of your artifact."

"Sigh." Nalan Wangzi sighed softly. "Since you have such confidence in their abilities, I’ll lend them my artifacts after we return. However, I want you to give me something if they fail to create one, and you must not refuse my request."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow for a moment. "Alright, I’ll definitely fulfill your request if they fail, but you must fulfill mine if they succeed. How is it?"
"Sure!" Nalan Wangzi replied confidently.
After that, Zhang Fei [5] went to the mountaintop, where he dual cultivated with Yan Jinwu and Sima Huiqing.

In the Ice Phoenix Domain, Feng Shizhu and Feng Bingying had already completed their cultivation, as had the rest of their race. The two women did not immediately leave the area, and they stood at the edge while observing Zhang Fei, who was still seriously studying the two ice body techniques.
Meanwhile, Zhang Yue, Feng Jingqiu, and Feng Xueying were also still focused on cultivating on that side of the area.
Feng Shizhu nodded in satisfaction seeing them like this. "These kids seem to be used to focusing like this, so I don’t think they’ll finish cultivating anytime soon."

"Yes." Feng Bingying nodded in agreement with that, but she was also surprised by their perseverance, especially Zhang Yue, as she was still very young when compared to Feng Jingqiu and Feng Xueying. "Are you really going to make her the leader of our race, Ancestor?"

Feng Shizhu nodded slightly. "Our ancestor said that whoever succeeds in inheriting her skeleton will become the leader of our race, and Zhang Yue has already inherited it, so she will become the leader of our race. However, she is still too young and has not fully matured, so you will continue to lead our race until she is fully ready."
"Alright."
When Zhang Fei opened his eyes, Mei informed him that three days had passed. He then looked at Zhang Yue, Feng Jinqiu, and Feng Xueying, but the three women still hadn’t opened their eyes.
"Have you successfully learned those two ice body techniques?"

Zhang Fei immediately stood up and answered Feng Bingying, who had just arrived. "At first, I thought it wouldn’t be difficult to learn both of them, but it ultimately took me three days to master the initial stages of both techniques. By the way, I’m going to the Slaughter Blood Domain, so I’ll entrust the three of them to you."
"Hmm?" Feng Bingying frowned slightly. "What do you want to do in the Slaughter Blood Domain?"
"One of the souls of the ten-tailed fox is in that domain, so I have no choice but to go there." Zhang Fei immediately opened the gate to return to his domain. "I entrust them to you."
"Alright."

After arriving at the Moonlight Passion Sect, Zhang Fei immediately brought Tian Shuixiang and Nalan Wangzi to the border, and the three of them hurriedly left through the gate that led them to the demon domains.
Upon their arrival, Tian Shuixiang immediately pointed him in the direction of the Slaughter Blood Domain, and Zhang Fei swiftly led the two of them into the domain.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Slaughter Blood Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]

The Blood Slaughter Domain was a nightmare realm filled with endless slaughter and rivers of blood. The land itself was filled with crimson mist, and the air carried the lingering stench of slaughter. Within this domain resided the Asura Demon Race, a demon race born of battle and nourished by blood. The sky rumbled with the wails of its victims, while the ground pulsed with the essence of endless slaughter.

Here, killing intent is the law, and bloodlust is the only truth. Every stone and stream resonates with the screams of countless slain living beings, creating an environment where cruelty and savagery are as natural as breathing. Cultivators who step into this realm are either consumed by its madness or forged into living weapons of destruction. However, to the Asura Demons, this realm is a paradise battlefield where they thrive, grow stronger, and reign supreme as the embodiment of slaughter.

[Quest: Steal Asura Demon Race Treasure.]
[Quest rank: Special]
[Reward: Special gift pack x 1]

’Hmm?’ Zhang Fei furrowed his brows as soon as those notifications appeared. ’The system sometimes gives me unreasonable missions! How can I possibly defeat Shang Zhanluo with my current strength? His cultivation has already reached the Celestial Venerable Realm, and his demon rank has also reached the Demon God!’

[You’re lucky because the system never gives you a time limit to complete those quests, Master. Otherwise, you would never have been able to complete all the quests the system gave you in the past or in the future.]
’Well, that’s true.’ Zhang Fei then asked Tian Shuixiang. "Do you know anything about the five Asura Demon Guardians?"
Tian Shuixiang looked at Zhang Fei. "What do you want from them? The five Asura Demon Guardians are under Shang Zhanluo’s direct control, and my father is one of them."
"Is your father really one of them?"

Tian Shuixiang nodded at him. "In fact, my father’s status within our Asura Demon Race is similar to my father-in-law’s status within the Eternal Night Demon Race, and he is the leader of the five guardians. He should be in the Asura Palace right now, as he rarely leaves Shang Zhanluo’s side. As for the other four guardians, they reside in the northernmost, easternmost, westernmost, and southernmost parts of this domain."
"Please tell me their identities.
"Shang Beixuan lived in the northernmost. Shang Dongzhu lived in the easternmost. Shang Zhang Xijiao lived in the westernmost. Shang Nanzhui lived in the southernmost."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei tried to check all four directions. "Who is the strongest and weakest among them?"

Tian Shuixiang informed him directly. "Shang Beixuan is the strongest among them, and his strength is almost on par with my father’s. Shang Xijiao is the weakest among them, but you can’t underestimate his strength, especially when he uses our race’s strengthening technique."

"Haha! You’ve been gone for a long time, so you don’t know the changes in their positions." Zhang Fei and Tian Shuixiang turned to Nalan Wangzi directly. "Shang Beixuan used to be the strongest, but his position has been replaced by Shang Dongzhu, and the weakest among them is no longer Shang Xijiao but Shang Nanzhui."
"Has Shang Xijiao ever defeated Shang Nanzhui?" Tian Shuixiang asked in surprise.

"Yes." Nalan Wangzi nodded at him. "They fought for a hundred years, and their fight was the most brutal and bloodiest ever. Back then, my mother and the other demon gods were also present to witness their fight. Nalan Xijiao emerged victorious on the final day, but both of them suffered heavy injuries, which took them thousands of years to return to their prime."

"I see." Tian Shuixiang then turned to Zhang Fei, who looked curious about that. "Our demon race is different from other demon races, and we are demons born of battle and nourished by blood. Our status is determined by brutal fights, and we sometimes have to fight to the death to achieve the best status."
"Wouldn’t that be detrimental to your race?" Zhang Fei asked in confusion.

Tian Shuixiang acknowledged it with a nod. "The situation is often detrimental to our race, but we cannot change it because that rule has been in place since our Asura Demon Race existed in this universe, and that rule has been ingrained in our bloodline. If we don’t channel our bloodlust in battle, it will take over and control our minds, and we will attack the other races blindly."

"I’ve heard that the Asura Demon Race is indeed a terrifying race, but I didn’t expect that you guys would be that terrifying." Zhang Fei then asked him. "So, where is your acquaintance? Will he come to us? Or should we go see him?"
"We have to go meet him at the Slaughter City; It’s 1,000 miles north of our location."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei looked in the direction Tian Shuixiang was pointing before enveloping the two of them with his aura. "Let’s go now."

Tian Shuixiang stopped him immediately. "I think you shouldn’t use your movement technique here, and we should fly to that city manually. Shang Zhanluo can detect all movement in this domain, and no member of our race can move as fast as you, so he will notice if we infiltrate here."
"I see." Zhang Fei immediately withdrew his aura. "Let’s go there now."
"Hmm?" A male demon with fiery hair and six arms, who was sitting on his throne, suddenly raised his eyebrows. He quickly moved towards the balcony of his palace and looked into the distance. "Zhui."
*Swoosh*
Another male demon with a nearly identical appearance appeared behind him. "Did you summon me, Demon God?"
"Try checking that direction using your senses." Shang Zhanluo said, pointing in another direction, specifically towards the location of Zhang Fei and the other two.
Shang Zhui immediately followed Shang Zhanluo’s orders by spreading his senses toward that direction, but his expression turned to shock. "Demon God, one of them—"

"Yes." Shang Zhanluo nodded at him. "One of those two men is your son, Shang Xiuluo. Even though he got help from the Faceless Demon Race to disguise himself, he wouldn’t be able to hide his asura demon aura from me, so I’m sure that he is your son. By the way, I can’t recognize the other man because his aura is completely similar to ours, but the female demon beside them is definitely not a member of our race, and she uses an artifact to imitate our aura."

Shang Zhui nodded in agreement. "Could that woman be Ye Zhiye? She and my son ran away from this realm tens of thousands of years ago, and since he’s returned to this realm, I think that woman should be her."

"That’s possible, but I don’t understand the reason behind their decision to suddenly return to our domain." Shang Zhanluo fell into thought for a while. "We have been looking for the two of them for so long, but we have never managed to find any trace of them in this realm."

Shang Zhui nodded at him. "In the past, Ye Futian descended to the Three Mortal Realms specifically to look for them, but he was unable to find them there either. Do you want me to capture them now, Demon God?"

"No need." Shang Zhanlu shook his head in response. "Judging from the direction they’re flying, they should be heading towards Slaughter City. I’m not interested in your son or Ye Zhiye, but the man by their side gives me a bad feeling. I feel that he is not as simple as he seems from the outside, and there is something inside his body that makes me uneasy."

Shang Zhui looked at Shang Zhanluo in astonishment, as he had never seen him like that before, and his expression also looked very serious. "In that case, I will order someone to monitor them, and I will immediately report to you once I get information about that man."

"Go." Shang Zhui disappeared from that place, but Shang Zhanluo continued to stand there and look in that direction. "Who exactly is that man? His cultivation is clearly still at the Celestial Lord Realm, but his presence somehow gives me a dread feeling."
*Tap... Tap...*
A middle-aged woman with an appearance almost identical to Shang Zhanluo approached him and asked, "What are you thinking about, husband?"
"Shang Luohu, I feel that there will be turmoil in our domain soon." The woman looked at Shang Zhanluo in surprise. "Shang Xiuluo and Ye Zhiye have returned."
Shang Luohu was even more surprised to hear that. "Have you ordered Shang Zhui to capture them?"

"No." Shang Zhanluo then told his wife about Zhang Fei’s presence by their side. "I’ve never been afraid of Mo Shentian or Long Wuzhao, but the presence of that young demon somehow gives me a feeling of dread, and I haven’t felt this kind of fear in a long time."
Shang Luohu grabbed her husband’s hand. "What exactly do you feel from that young demon?"

"I can’t say for sure," Shang Zhanluo replied with a shake of his head. "I have ordered Shang Zhui to investigate that young demon, and I will wait for information from him before making a decision. If that young demon is a threat to me and our race, I will come to him to eliminate him."
Shang Luohu nodded slightly. "Let’s wait for Zhang Zhui’s report."
"Yeah."
[Master, Shang Zhanluo seems to have noticed the presence of the three of you, and he ordered someone to investigate you.]

Zhang Fei nodded slightly because he had previously felt Shang Zhanluo and Shang Zhui’s senses lock onto them. He then spoke to Tian Shuixiang. "Your demon god has already noticed our presence, and he seems to have seen through your disguise."
"Hmm?" Tian Shuixiang and Nalan Wangzi turned to Zhang Fei in shock. "Are you sure about that, brother-in-law? Why didn’t we detect anything earlier?"
Zhang Fei shook his head at Nalan Wangzi. "I can’t say for sure, but I previously felt two senses locking onto us, and I’m certain one of them belongs to Shang Zhanluo."

"The situation is often detrimental to our race, but we cannot change it because that rule has been in place since our Asura Demon Race existed in this universe, and that rule has been ingrained in our bloodline.
If we don’t channel our bloodlust in battle, it will take over and control our minds, and we will attack the other races blindly."
"I’ve heard that the Asura Demon Race is indeed a terrifying race, but I didn’t expect that you guys would be that terrifying." Zhang Fei then asked him.
"So, where is your acquaintance?
Will he come to us?
Or should we go see him?"
"We have to go meet him at the Slaughter City; It’s 1,000 miles north of our location."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei looked in the direction Tian Shuixiang was pointing before enveloping the two of them with his aura.
"Let’s go now."
Tian Shuixiang stopped him immediately.
"I think you shouldn’t use your movement technique here, and we should fly to that city manually.
Shang Zhanluo can detect all movement in this domain, and no member of our race can move as fast as you, so he will notice if we infiltrate here."
"I see." Zhang Fei immediately withdrew his aura.
"Let’s go there now."
"Hmm?" A male demon with fiery hair and six arms, who was sitting on his throne, suddenly raised his eyebrows.
He quickly moved towards the balcony of his palace and looked into the distance.
"Zhui."
*Swoosh*
Another male demon with a nearly identical appearance appeared behind him.
"Did you summon me, Demon God?"
"Try checking that direction using your senses." Shang Zhanluo said, pointing in another direction, specifically towards the location of Zhang Fei and the other two.
Shang Zhui immediately followed Shang Zhanluo’s orders by spreading his senses toward that direction, but his expression turned to shock.
"Demon God, one of them—"
"Yes." Shang Zhanluo nodded at him.
"One of those two men is your son, Shang Xiuluo.
Even though he got help from the Faceless Demon Race to disguise himself, he wouldn’t be able to hide his asura demon aura from me, so I’m sure that he is your son.

By the way, I can’t recognize the other man because his aura is completely similar to ours, but the female demon beside them is definitely not a member of our race, and she uses an artifact to imitate our aura."
Shang Zhui nodded in agreement.
"Could that woman be Ye Zhiye?
She and my son ran away from this realm tens of thousands of years ago, and since he’s returned to this realm, I think that woman should be her."
"That’s possible, but I don’t understand the reason behind their decision to suddenly return to our domain." Shang Zhanluo fell into thought for a while.
"We have been looking for the two of them for so long, but we have never managed to find any trace of them in this realm."
Shang Zhui nodded at him.
"In the past, Ye Futian descended to the Three Mortal Realms specifically to look for them, but he was unable to find them there either.
Do you want me to capture them now, Demon God?"
"No need." Shang Zhanlu shook his head in response.
"Judging from the direction they’re flying, they should be heading towards Slaughter City.
I’m not interested in your son or Ye Zhiye, but the man by their side gives me a bad feeling.
I feel that he is not as simple as he seems from the outside, and there is something inside his body that makes me uneasy."
Shang Zhui looked at Shang Zhanluo in astonishment, as he had never seen him like that before, and his expression also looked very serious.
"In that case, I will order someone to monitor them, and I will immediately report to you once I get information about that man."
"Go." Shang Zhui disappeared from that place, but Shang Zhanluo continued to stand there and look in that direction.
"Who exactly is that man?
His cultivation is clearly still at the Celestial Lord Realm, but his presence somehow gives me a dread feeling."
*Tap...
Tap...*
A middle-aged woman with an appearance almost identical to Shang Zhanluo approached him and asked, "What are you thinking about, husband?"
"Shang Luohu, I feel that there will be turmoil in our domain soon." The woman looked at Shang Zhanluo in surprise.
"Shang Xiuluo and Ye Zhiye have returned."
Shang Luohu was even more surprised to hear that.
"Have you ordered Shang Zhui to capture them?"
"No." Shang Zhanluo then told his wife about Zhang Fei’s presence by their side.
"I’ve never been afraid of Mo Shentian or Long Wuzhao, but the presence of that young demon somehow gives me a feeling of dread, and I haven’t felt this kind of fear in a long time."
Shang Luohu grabbed her husband’s hand.
"What exactly do you feel from that young demon?"
"I can’t say for sure," Shang Zhanluo replied with a shake of his head.
"I have ordered Shang Zhui to investigate that young demon, and I will wait for information from him before making a decision.
If that young demon is a threat to me and our race, I will come to him to eliminate him."
Shang Luohu nodded slightly.
"Let’s wait for Zhang Zhui’s report."
"Yeah."
[Master, Shang Zhanluo seems to have noticed the presence of the three of you, and he ordered someone to investigate you.]
Zhang Fei nodded slightly because he had previously felt Shang Zhanluo and Shang Zhui’s senses lock onto them.
He then spoke to Tian Shuixiang.
"Your demon god has already noticed our presence, and he seems to have seen through your disguise."
"Hmm?" Tian Shuixiang and Nalan Wangzi turned to Zhang Fei in shock.
"Are you sure about that, brother-in-law?
Why didn’t we detect anything earlier?"
Zhang Fei shook his head at Nalan Wangzi.
"I can’t say for sure, but I previously felt two senses locking onto us, and I’m certain one of them belongs to Shang Zhanluo."

chapters.title: Chapter 1253: Blood Sea
paragraphs: Tian Shuixiang frowned at that. "If that’s true, the other sense should belong to my father since he never left Shang Zhanluo’s side."
"I think so." Zhang Fei then asked Nalan Wangzi. "Do you want to go back first? If you stay with us, it will be difficult for us to protect you if they attack us."

Nalan Wangzi’s lips curled upwards. "Brother-in-law, do you realize how much you underestimate me? Although I don’t have your abilities, I am the first princess of the Soul-Devouring Demon Race. My cultivation is above yours, and my abilities are different from those of my little sisters. As long as Shang Zhanluo or his five guardians don’t attack us, I’m confident in defeating the others, so you don’t need to worry about me."

"Alright then." Zhang Fei then spoke to Tian Shuixiang again. "You should contact your acquaintances first, as I’m sure Shang Zhanluo and your father have already ordered people in the Slaughter City to investigate us. Let’s meet him somewhere else, and if possible, ask him to meet us in Blood Sea directly."

Tian Shuixiang nodded in agreement. "Since Shang Zhanluo and my father already know of our presence, you don’t need to hide your abilities anymore, and you can take us to the Blood Sea directly. However, we still have to be careful of Shang Beixuan because that area is within his territory, and he is the most fierce among the others."
After Tian Shuixiang contacted his acquaintance, Zhang Fei enveloped her and Nalan Wangzi with his aura before taking them into the Blood Sea.
Shang Zhanluo and his wife, who were monitoring them from their palace, were shocked by their movements.

"How can that young demon move so fast, husband?" Shang Luohu asked in astonishment. "His cultivation is at the Celestial Lord Realm, so his speed shouldn’t be that fast. Even with our cultivation and speed, we can barely keep up with his movement. Moreover, he’s not moving alone, and he’s carrying those two people with him, which makes it even more impossible for him to move that fast."

Shang Zhanluo pondered for a while before answering her. "If my guess is correct, it wasn’t his true speed, but he used a movement technique to boost his speed, allowing him to take them away so quickly."
"Have you ever seen a movement technique that can allow us to move that fast?" Shang Luohu doubtfully asked.

"Yes." Shang Zhanluo nodded at her. "Have you forgotten about the existence of the Speed Demon, Su Shentian? Before he became as strong as he is now, his speed was already impressive, and no one has ever been able to capture him since his appearance. I heard that Long Xukong once tried to capture him in a match, but his speed surpassed that old dragon’s speed in executing his void abilities."

"Naturally, I remember Su Shentian, but that man has no relationship with anyone, and he also doesn’t have a disciple. Moreover, he has never liked demons, so I don’t believe that the young demon has a relationship with him. Shang Zhanluo doesn’t deny Shang Luohu’s words, but he can’t think of any other possibility besides that. "Where are they going now?"

"The Blood Sea." Shang Luohu was surprised to hear that from Shang Zhanluo. "I don’t understand why the young demon brought them there, but the sea is beneficial for him. If he cultivates and absorbs the demon Qi there, his body will become stronger, but it will also increase his bloodlust. If he loses control of his bloodlust, it will take over his mind, and he will become a cold-blooded demon."
"Does that mean he is not from our race?"

"That young demon does have the physique and aura of our asura demon race, but I dare say with certainty that he’s not an asura demon like us." Shang Luohu immediately realized something, which Shang Zhanluo confirmed with a nod. "The lust demon race has the ability to manipulate their body and aura like that of other living creatures, so I believe he is a lust demon. However, I don’t understand how he knows Shang Xiuluo and Ye Ziye, and both of them seem to respect him."

Shang Luohu turned toward the location of the Blood Sea. "Could it be that the young demon has been hiding them all this time? You previously said that someone from the Faceless Demon Race helped Shang Xiuluo disguise himself, and that young demon could modify his or other people’s bodies."

"Your guess may be correct, but we can only find out the answer by capturing them." Shang Zhanluo released a soft sigh before continuing. "The Blood Sea is in Sheng Beixuan’s territory, and I’m sure that guys will notice their presence once they arrive there."
"Are you going to ask Shang Beixuan to capture them?"

Shang Zhanlu shook his head slightly. "With that young demon’s speed, Shang Beixuan would never succeed in capturing them. Moreover, I still feel that there is something strange about that young demon, and I still can’t get rid of this feeling of fear coming from him, so it will be better if we don’t act now. Instead, I asked him to monitor their activities from afar to find out their purpose here, and I will make a decision once we have clear information about them."

"What if I go there to monitor them directly?" Shang Zhanluo frowned at Shang Luohu. "I don’t know why you feel that way about that young man, but I don’t share your feelings. Furthermore, our strengths are almost equal, and he will never be able to harm me with his current cultivation. Additionally, we are in our domain, and I can boost my strength even more, so there is no need for you to be overly worried, right?"
Shang Zhanluo released a soft sigh before nodding. "Alright, you can go to the Blood Sea, but I don’t want you to contact them directly, and you must monitor them from afar."
"Alright." Shang Luohuo immediately flew out of their palace and headed for the Blood Sea.

The Blood Sea was the heart of the endless and churning Slaughter Blood Domain, where the Asura Demon Race thrived. Its waves were not water but boiling, scarlet blood, formed from centuries of slaughter, sacrifice, and battle. The stench of death filled the air, and the cries of the fallen seemed to echo endlessly off its surface.

Its tides surge with malevolent demon qi, devouring the weak and tempering the strong. In its depths lurks a terrifying creature born from the essence of pure-blood creatures with blood-stained wings and an endless hunger. Even the Asura Demons themselves fear entering its deepest layers. At its center lies the Blood Abyss, an unfathomable vortex of blood and darkness that never ceases to devour.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei frowned as soon as they landed on the side of the Blood Sea, and Mei immediately told him about the creature in its depths. "Do you know anything about the creature in this sea?"

"Hmm?" Tian Shuixiang looked at Zhang Fei in surprise, but he only smiled in response. "The creature you’re referring to is the Slaughter Blood Phantom, and it’s the sole guardian of this domain. I don’t know how it was born, but legends within my race say that it was born from the blood of billions of living creatures who died here, both demons and other living beings. The more blood that is sacrificed, the stronger the creature will become. However, few members of my race, including my father, have ever seen it. It has never surfaced before, and it has always remained at the bottom of the sea."
"The blood of billions of living creatures who died here?" Zhang Fei was shocked by that.

"Yes." Tian Shuixiang nodded at him. "Even though this Paradise Realm is still chaotic today, the situation in this realm was far more chaotic in the past because the war between all races never stopped back then. This domain used to be the worst among all domains, and countless living beings died here. According to the legends, this Blood Sea was formed from the blood of those who died here, and the ancestors of my Asura Demon Race took over this domain after the war subsided because the bloodlust and demon Qi here were very beneficial for our race."

Nalan Wangzi then spoke to Zhang Fei, "Brother-in-law, each demon domain possesses a unique dark history, which causes righteous cultivators to avoid approaching any of them due to this ominous past. Just like this domain, my Soul-Devouring Domain was one of the worst battlefields in the past. Even to this day, many of the souls of the victims still roam there, and they will absorb the souls of living beings who enter my domain, especially those who are not demons. Because of their presence there, my ancestors chose that domain as our race’s residence, and those souls dare not approach us because they know that we can absorb their souls."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "The existence of your race and those souls in that domain benefits each other, and they indirectly become protectors for the members of your race."
"That’s right." Nalan Wangzi nodded at him. "So, what are we going to do here now? Why don’t you just look for that item?"
"The item is over there." Zhang Fei pointed in one direction. "However, I’m curious about this Blood Sea, and the blood within it should be very beneficial to demons like us."

chapters.title: Chapter 1254: Six Paths Asura Emblem
paragraphs: "You were right about this blood sea." Tian Shuixiang walked to the side of the sea, squatted down, and dipped his hand into it. "The blood in this sea benefits not only the Asura demon race but all demon races; however, it will also influence your bloodlust. You should already know the consequences if you fail to control your bloodlust, right?"

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed and walked to Tian Shuixiang’s side. "You’ve known me for a long time, and you already know a lot about my history in the Three Mortal Realms; therefore, you don’t need to doubt my ability to control my bloodlust, right?"

"I know that, but—" Tian Shuixiang stopped speaking when Zhang Fei unleashed his killing intent and bloodlust, but he was shocked that his killing intent and bloodlust didn’t spread to other areas; instead, both of them were suppressed by an unseen force. ’How did he manage to do this?’

Nalan Wangzi, who was standing behind them, was equally stunned to see that, as Zhang Fei’s killing intent and bloodlust gathered around him. ’This! How is this possible? His control over his killing intent and bloodlust is truly a masterclass!’

"Do you understand now?" Zhang Fei suppressed his killing intent and bloodlust again. "Both of them were already under my complete control long before I went to the upper realms, and I continued to suppress them in the past two decades. In fact, I used both daily, but no one, including Jian Kuang, was aware of them."
"Are you for real? Are you really using your killing intent and bloodlust on a daily basis?"

"In general, cultivators make the mistake of using both only during battles or specific situations, which prevents them from truly controlling their killing intent and bloodlust. I don’t want to be like them, and I use both of them every day, including during my dual cultivation sessions with all my wives." Zhang Fei then walked to the location of the Corpse-Refining Coffin, and he had no trouble finding it with the clues Ma Kuangyu gave him. He hurriedly stored it into the system’s inventory because Shang Zhanluo was still watching them from a distance, and he returned to Tian Shuixiang’s side afterwards. "Has your acquaintance left here?"
Tian Shuixiang shook his head at Zhang Fei. "He still has a few things to finish, but he will meet us here after he finishes all his business."
"I see." Zhang Fei stared at the Blood Sea while thinking. ’Mei, have you found the location of the ten-tailed fox statue?’

[Master, the fox statue is located in the Blood Forest, but you must go to the Blood War City first to get there. The forest and the city are located in the same area, where a powerful formation protects both, making it impossible for you to access that location using your abilities.] Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow because Shang Zhanluo lived in that city. [You might be able to ask Bing Xingying for help to go there directly, but it will cause you trouble with the Asura demon race. Therefore, you have no choice but to go there through the normal route, but I’m afraid the Asura Demon God will capture you as soon as you enter that city.]
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement. "Does your acquaintance know of a secret path to the Blood Forest?"
"Hmm? Is the statue located in that forest?" Zhang Fei nodded to Tian Shuixiang. "I don’t know if my acquaintance knows of a secret path to the forest, so we must wait for him to arrive first."

Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh, as he didn’t want to stay too long in that domain, and he wanted to meet one of the ten-tailed fox souls as soon as possible. "Hey, what is your race’s most valuable treasure?"

"Are you thinking about stealing their treasure, brother-in-law?" Nalan Wangzi and Tian Shuixiang facepalmed as soon as they saw Zhang Fei’s expression, which clearly showed that he indeed wanted to steal the treasure of the asura demon race. "If you steal it, Shang Zhanluo and his entire race will hunt you down wherever you go, and you will bring trouble to the people of other domains. If they discover your true identity and location, they will launch a direct attack against us, and we will not be able to face their great attack unless Empress Huo assists you. However, I don’t think she will help you deal with them if you look for trouble with them first, right?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed bitterly. "You’re right. Feng Yao wouldn’t be willing to help me if I looked for trouble with them first. However, there’s something I can’t explain to you two, and it forces me to steal their most precious treasure. Therefore, I want to know about it, and I will think of the best way to steal it."

Nalan Wangzi helplessly shook her head, but Tian Shuixiang immediately told Zhang Fei about it. "Our demon race’s most precious treasure is the Six Paths Asura Emblem. According to legend, it was crafted from the fusion of the bloodline and demon essence of the First Asura Demon God and fragments of the Six Paths Wheel, which was considered the emblem of rulership over all Asura clans."
"Wait a minute." Zhang Fei stopped Tian Shuixiang. "What is the Six Path Wheel? Does it have anything to do with reincarnation?"

Tian Shuixiang shook his head in response. "I don’t know if the Six Paths Wheel relates to reincarnation since no one has seen it, but the Asura Demon God can use six paths by activating the Six Paths Asura Emblem, which are the Human Path, the Demon Path, the Heavenly Path, the Hell Path, the Karmic Path, and the Annihilation Path. Don’t ask about their benefits and uses because I don’t know about them, and Shang Zhanluo is the only one who can use the emblem. One thing that is certain is that he will become truly powerful and terrifying once he uses the Annihilation Path, and that is one reason why Mo Shentian does not dare to fight him head-on. Not to mention, he can still use the Bloodline Awakening technique, which will boost his strength even further."

"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding because he had fought an asura demon in the Forbidden Land before, and the demon’s strength had increased significantly at that time. "If Shang Zhanluo is that strong, how can the Asura Demon Race be the second strongest after the Celestial Demon Race? Your race should be able to become the strongest among the ten demon races, right?"

"Somehow I feel that you are too naive, brother-in-law." Nalan Wangzi said this while shaking her head. "It’s impossible for the Celestial Demon Race to become the strongest in this realm without any reason, okay? Mo Shentian can’t use his secret ability continuously, but he will become invisible if he activates it, and he can bend reality using it."
"Bending reality?" Zhang Fei furrowed his brows. "I know two celestial demons, but neither of them has such an ability."

Nalan Wangzi shook her head while rubbing her forehead. "That’s because their demon rank is still at the Ten Mortal Demon Ranks, and Mo Shentian is a demon god; therefore, you can’t compare your two celestial demon acquaintances with him. Once they reach the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks, they will evolve and gain new abilities, and they will attain the same ability as him after they reach the Demon God Rank."

"Phew." Zhang Fei exhaled softly. "You two are lucky because you were born as demons! As for me, I still have to think about my cultivation, my demon ranks, and my beast ranks. I have long believed that there are other stages above the Five Celestial Realms, which makes my cultivation journey still very long. For my demon rank, I haven’t even managed to reach the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks, let alone the Demon God Rank. My beast rank is in the mythical rank, but there are still immortal and primordial ranks above it. Long Wuzhao and the four perils are immortal beast rank, and the two primordial beasts are primordial beast rank."
Tian Shuixiang and Nalan Wangzi smiled in amusement as they heard Zhang Fei complain like that, but they suddenly sensed someone moving toward their location.
"Who is Shang Luohu?" Zhang Fei asked, monitoring the female demon from the map.
Tian Shuixiang frowned at that. "Shang Luohu is Shang Zhanluo’s empress, and she is no less powerful than him. Since she’s on her way here, we should leave now, or she’ll attack us."

"No need." Zhang Fei rejected that. Instead, he floated above the Blood Sea before sitting there, confusing Tian Shuixiang and Nalan Wangzi. "She has no intention of approaching us, and she only wants to monitor us from afar, so we don’t need to pay attention to her. This is a good opportunity for us to cultivate here, so we should not waste time and start cultivating now."
Tian Shuixiang didn’t understand how Zhang Fei could be so confident, but he immediately followed him and floated above the Blood Sea, and the two of them began cultivating there.

"The blood in this sea benefits not only the Asura demon race but all demon races; however, it will also influence your bloodlust.
You should already know the consequences if you fail to control your bloodlust, right?"
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed and walked to Tian Shuixiang’s side.
"You’ve known me for a long time, and you already know a lot about my history in the Three Mortal Realms; therefore, you don’t need to doubt my ability to control my bloodlust, right?"

"I know that, but—" Tian Shuixiang stopped speaking when Zhang Fei unleashed his killing intent and bloodlust, but he was shocked that his killing intent and bloodlust didn’t spread to other areas; instead, both of them were suppressed by an unseen force. ’How did he manage to do this?’
Nalan Wangzi, who was standing behind them, was equally stunned to see that, as Zhang Fei’s killing intent and bloodlust gathered around him. ’This!
How is this possible?
His control over his killing intent and bloodlust is truly a masterclass!’
"Do you understand now?" Zhang Fei suppressed his killing intent and bloodlust again.
"Both of them were already under my complete control long before I went to the upper realms, and I continued to suppress them in the past two decades.
In fact, I used both daily, but no one, including Jian Kuang, was aware of them."
"Are you for real?
Are you really using your killing intent and bloodlust on a daily basis?"
"In general, cultivators make the mistake of using both only during battles or specific situations, which prevents them from truly controlling their killing intent and bloodlust.

I don’t want to be like them, and I use both of them every day, including during my dual cultivation sessions with all my wives." Zhang Fei then walked to the location of the Corpse-Refining Coffin, and he had no trouble finding it with the clues Ma Kuangyu gave him.
He hurriedly stored it into the system’s inventory because Shang Zhanluo was still watching them from a distance, and he returned to Tian Shuixiang’s side afterwards.
"Has your acquaintance left here?"
Tian Shuixiang shook his head at Zhang Fei.
"He still has a few things to finish, but he will meet us here after he finishes all his business."
"I see." Zhang Fei stared at the Blood Sea while thinking. ’Mei, have you found the location of the ten-tailed fox statue?’
[Master, the fox statue is located in the Blood Forest, but you must go to the Blood War City first to get there.

The forest and the city are located in the same area, where a powerful formation protects both, making it impossible for you to access that location using your abilities.] Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow because Shang Zhanluo lived in that city.
[You might be able to ask Bing Xingying for help to go there directly, but it will cause you trouble with the Asura demon race.
Therefore, you have no choice but to go there through the normal route, but I’m afraid the Asura Demon God will capture you as soon as you enter that city.]
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement.
"Does your acquaintance know of a secret path to the Blood Forest?"
"Hmm?
Is the statue located in that forest?" Zhang Fei nodded to Tian Shuixiang.
"I don’t know if my acquaintance knows of a secret path to the forest, so we must wait for him to arrive first."
Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh, as he didn’t want to stay too long in that domain, and he wanted to meet one of the ten-tailed fox souls as soon as possible.
"Hey, what is your race’s most valuable treasure?"

"Are you thinking about stealing their treasure, brother-in-law?" Nalan Wangzi and Tian Shuixiang facepalmed as soon as they saw Zhang Fei’s expression, which clearly showed that he indeed wanted to steal the treasure of the asura demon race.
"If you steal it, Shang Zhanluo and his entire race will hunt you down wherever you go, and you will bring trouble to the people of other domains.
If they discover your true identity and location, they will launch a direct attack against us, and we will not be able to face their great attack unless Empress Huo assists you.
However, I don’t think she will help you deal with them if you look for trouble with them first, right?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed bitterly.
"You’re right.
Feng Yao wouldn’t be willing to help me if I looked for trouble with them first.
However, there’s something I can’t explain to you two, and it forces me to steal their most precious treasure.
Therefore, I want to know about it, and I will think of the best way to steal it."
Nalan Wangzi helplessly shook her head, but Tian Shuixiang immediately told Zhang Fei about it.
"Our demon race’s most precious treasure is the Six Paths Asura Emblem.

According to legend, it was crafted from the fusion of the bloodline and demon essence of the First Asura Demon God and fragments of the Six Paths Wheel, which was considered the emblem of rulership over all Asura clans."
"Wait a minute." Zhang Fei stopped Tian Shuixiang.
"What is the Six Path Wheel?
Does it have anything to do with reincarnation?"
Tian Shuixiang shook his head in response.

"I don’t know if the Six Paths Wheel relates to reincarnation since no one has seen it, but the Asura Demon God can use six paths by activating the Six Paths Asura Emblem, which are the Human Path, the Demon Path, the Heavenly Path, the Hell Path, the Karmic Path, and the Annihilation Path.
Don’t ask about their benefits and uses because I don’t know about them, and Shang Zhanluo is the only one who can use the emblem.
One thing that is certain is that he will become truly powerful and terrifying once he uses the Annihilation Path, and that is one reason why Mo Shentian does not dare to fight him head-on.
Not to mention, he can still use the Bloodline Awakening technique, which will boost his strength even further."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding because he had fought an asura demon in the Forbidden Land before, and the demon’s strength had increased significantly at that time.
"If Shang Zhanluo is that strong, how can the Asura Demon Race be the second strongest after the Celestial Demon Race?
Your race should be able to become the strongest among the ten demon races, right?"
"Somehow I feel that you are too naive, brother-in-law." Nalan Wangzi said this while shaking her head.
"It’s impossible for the Celestial Demon Race to become the strongest in this realm without any reason, okay?

"Bending reality?" Zhang Fei furrowed his brows.

Nalan Wangzi shook her head while rubbing her forehead.

chapters.title: Chapter 1255: The Slaughter Blood Phantom
paragraphs: Shang Luohu intently monitored the three, and Nalan Wangzi’s decision not to join the others in the Blood Sea convinced her that she was indeed disguised.
However, Shang Luohu was not convinced that Nalan Wangzi was Ye Ziye, as her attitude toward Tian Shuixiang was too casual, considering the two were lovers.

’Who exactly is that woman? From which demon race did he come?’ Shang Luohu’s gaze shifted to Zhang Fei, who had begun to absorb the power contained within the blood. ’Is he really a lust demon? If he really was a lust demon, how could he control himself after absorbing it? Even Shang Xiuluo has begun to be affected by his bloodlust, yet the young demon maintains such calmness.’
*Thud*
Shang Luohu turned to the male asura demon who had just arrived. "Why did you come here, Shang Beixuan?"

"Empress, my emperor ordered me to come here to protect you." Shang Luohu raised an eyebrow in response to Shang Beixuan. "My emperor told me some things about that young demon, and I have similar feelings toward him. He’s just an ant with his cultivation still at the Celestial Lord Realm, but his presence fills me with dread."
Shang Luohu was surprised to hear that, as she didn’t feel the same feelings from Zhang Fei’s presence. "What makes you feel that way?"

"I can’t say for sure, Empress." Shang Beixuan pointed to Zhang Fei. "My emperor said that he is most likely a lust demon, and a normal lust demon will definitely go berserk once he absorbs the power contained within the blood. However, his expression clearly shows that he feels nothing, and he absorbs the power within the blood without restraint—something that most members of our demon race, including myself, cannot do. Even though I won’t lose control or go berserk, once I absorb the power within the blood, my bloodlust will undoubtedly become uncontrollable. Shang Zhui and the other three will also experience the same thing if they absorb the power within the blood."
Shang Luohu nodded in understanding. "So, what do you think is best for us to do with that young demon?"

"Even though the power within the blood can’t affect him, he’s not an asura demon like us, so he won’t be of much use to our asura demon race." Shang Luohu agreed with Shang Beixuan, who suddenly had an idea. "Even so, I think there’s no harm in drawing him to our side, and he might be useful to us in some way. Isn’t that right, Shang Zhui?"

"Yes." Both Shang Luohu and Shang Beixuan turned to look at Shang Zhui, who had just arrived. "My emperor also thinks it would be wiser if we tried to draw this young demon to our side, but we should monitor him more closely first because we don’t have much information about him yet."
Shang Luohu then asked him. "Did you come here for your son?"

"Yes." Shang Zhui looked at Tian Shuixiang, who was starting to have difficulty controlling his bloodlust due to the influence of the power within the blood. "Even though I never liked his relationship with Ye Zhiye, he is still my only son, so I miss him. He has been missing for tens of thousands of years, and his cultivation hasn’t changed much since then."
*Thud... Thud... Thud...*
Three male asura demons suddenly landed near them, making Shang Luohu sigh to himself. "Why did you three also come here?"
"Empress, the three of us also felt the presence of that young demon, and his presence gave us fear, so we came here to check on him." Shang Dongzhu was the first to answer.

Shang Nanzhui nodded his head slightly. "I suspect that young demon is not an asura demon like us, but I can’t recognize his identity, and he seems to have come here for another purpose, so I hurriedly went here."

"I also sensed something strange about this young demon, so I previously asked our emperor about him, and he said that he might be a lust demon. Hence, I rushed here, but I didn’t expect that you would also come here to check on him, Empress." Shang Xijiao spoke as he repeatedly looked at Zhang Fei. "The strangeness I felt from him seemed to be true, as he didn’t feel anything from the power in the blood, even though he was not an asura demon like us."
Shang Luohu nodded to them. "My husband indeed suspected that the young demon was a lust demon, and I came here to confirm that, but his disguise was too perfect. He—"
*Rumble... Rumble... Rumble...*

The ground beneath them suddenly shook violently, and the source came from the Blood Sea. Their expressions changed slightly as they saw the blood in the sea churning, and a blood vortex suddenly emerged from within before enveloping Zhang Fei’s body.

"This crazy bastard!" The five asura demon guardians shouted. "Is he crazy? He’s not affected by the power in the blood, but he’s pushing himself too hard by increasing his absorption rate that fast!"
Shang Zhui nodded in agreement with Shang Beixuan. "He will provoke the anger of the Slaughter Blood Phantom, and it will definitely come to the surface to kill him."

"Hey! It’s been a long time since we saw the Slaughter Blood Phantom appear on the surface, and I think this is the best opportunity for us to analyze this young demon’s abilities." Shang Dongzhu spoke as his aura overflowed involuntarily.

The other four asura demons were also the same as Shang Dongzhu; their auras were involuntarily released from their bodies. They are demons born from battle and blood, and the Slaughter Blood Phantom is the sole guardian of their asura demon race, possessing extraordinary power. The fight that might happen soon caused their blood to boil, and they couldn’t wait to witness Zhang Fei’s strength.

’These guys!’ Shang Luohu could only shake her head seeing them like that, but she herself was also curious about Zhang Fei’s strength, and she hoped that their guardian would appear to attack him so they wouldn’t have to move themselves to test his abilities. "It’s really coming up."
"Hahaha! Let’s see their fight."

"Shit!" Tian Shuixiang cursed when he sensed the change in the Blood Sea, and he stopped absorbing the power within the blood before flying to the side of the sea. "Zhang Fei! You must stop now! The Slaughter Blood Phantom will come out soon!"
"My brother-in-law didn’t seem to hear you, Xiuluo." Nalan Wangzi stood beside Tian Shuixiang. "It’s too late to stop him because the Slaughter Blood Phantom has already moved to the surface."

"I don’t understand why he deliberately lured the Slaughter Blood Phantom out, but his decision will bring trouble for him." Tian Shuixiang glanced in another direction. "Moreover, Shang Luohu, my father, and the four guardians have arrived here, and they will definitely make a move against him."
Nalan Wangzi let out a heavy sigh. "Let’s see what happens next."
*Boom*

A loud explosion suddenly rang in their ears, followed by an explosion of blood from within the Blood Sea. Soon, the Slaughter Blood Phantom shot out from within the sea, and it stared at the vortex of blood surrounding Zhang Fei’s body.

The Slaughter Blood Phantom is a formless living being born from the murderous will of the Blood Sea. When the blood of countless other creatures fused with the hatred of their final screams, the Blood Sea condensed this essence into a drifting nightmare that gave it life.

The Slaughter Blood Phantom has no fixed form, but now it looks like a ferocious beast with claws and fangs, like a crimson mist entwined with the form of death itself. The air thickens with a killing intent so oppressive that it makes Shang Luohuo and the others tremble, let alone Tian Shuixiang and Nalan Wangzi.

Nalan Wangzi and Tian Shuixiang took several steps back when the Slaughter Blood Phantom turned towards them. However, Shang Zhui suddenly appeared in front of them, protecting them with his asura demon aura.
Tian Shuixiang’s heart skipped a beat when he saw his father, and his hands clenched into fists. He wanted to call out to him, but no words came out of his mouth.
Nalan Wangzi, who was standing beside Tian Shuixiang, glanced at the father and son a few times. ’I didn’t expect him to show up to protect his son.’
"You finally decided to come back, Xiuluo." Shang Zhui softly spoke.

Tian Shuixiang was at a loss to respond to him, as he was disappointed with Shang Zhui’s past decisions regarding his relationship with Ye Ziye, which forced the two to flee to the Three Mortal Realms.
Shang Zhui looked back at them, specifically at Nalan Wangzi. "Is she Ye Ziye?"
"Unfortunately, you are wrong about me because I am not Ye Ziye, Senior Zhui." Nalan Wangzi shook his head at him.
Shang Zhui raised his eyebrows. "Then, who are you? Why are you with Xiuluo and that young demon?"

"Xiuluo is my old friend, and that young demon is my lover." Shang Zhui immediately examined Nalan Wangzi’s body, discovering Zhang Fei’s Yang Qi within her. "My identity is secret, and I won’t tell you."
"Father." Tian Shuixiang called softly. "I’m sorry, I—"

"No need." Shang Zhui shook his head at Tian Shuixiang before returning his gaze to Zhang Fei, who had appeared above the Blood Sea. "Is your friend really a lust demon? Has he gone mad? Why did he deliberately lure the Slaughter Blood Phantom out?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1256: Enter The Blood Sea
paragraphs: Tian Shuixiang nodded slightly. "Father, my friend is indeed a lust demon, but he’s not an ordinary lust demon. I don’t understand why he lured the Slaughter Blood Phantom out, but he often does unexpected things."
"Hmm?" Shang Zhui furrowed his brows because the Slaughter Blood Phantom didn’t immediately attack Zhang Fei; instead, it circled around him as if it was curious about him. ’What happened?’
*Thud... Thud... Thud...*

Shang Luohu and the other four asura guardians decided to appear in front of them, causing Tian Shuixiang and Nalan Wangzi to take a few steps back. However, they paid no attention to the two of them; instead, their gazes were solely focused on Zhang Fei and the Slaughter Blood Phantom.
"Have any of you ever seen the Slaughter Blood Phantom act like this?" Shang Luohu asked them.
"Yes." Shang Beixuan replied with a nod. "The Slaughter Blood Phantom only acted like this towards the previous Asura Demon God."
"Since then, the Slaughter Blood Phantom has never acted this docile, and it attacked our emperor when he tried to challenge it in the past." Shang Dongzhu added.
Shang Nanzhui then asked. "Do you think this young demon has a relationship with the previous demon god?"

"Impossible!" Shang Xijiao denied his friend straight away. "This young demon is not a member of our demon race, and he only disguised himself, so he cannot possibly have any relationship with our previous demon god."
Shang Luohu looked back at Tian Shuixiang. "What information do you have about this young demon, Xiuluo?"

"I’m sorry, but I can’t tell you anything about him, empress." Tian Shuixiang’s answer caused Shang Luohu, Shang Zhui, and the other four to frown. "He has helped me and Ziye a lot in the past, and he is my current leader, so I won’t say anything about him."

"Your leader?" The six asura demons were shocked to hear this because Zhang Fei was weaker than Tian Shuixiang, but he was willing to acknowledge him as his leader. Furthermore, their asura demon race would only recognize the strongest as their leader, making it difficult for them to believe his words.

Nalan Wangzi shook her head when Shang Luohu and the others looked at her. "I haven’t known him for a long time, so I don’t have much information about him. Instead of wondering about him, you can wait for him to act."
"Who exactly are you? Why are you disguised as a member of our demon race? Shang Luohu asked with a frown.

Nalan Wangzi shrugged casually. "I don’t have any intentions towards your demon race, and I disguised myself just to accompany him because I was bored with my domain, so I wanted to take a walk here."

"Hmm?" Shang Luohu squinted her eyes, seriously observing Nalan Wangzi while searching in her memories for information regarding her. ’Who exactly is this woman? Why isn’t she afraid of me? How can she disguise her aura this perfectly?’
*Roar*
A loud roar startled them, and they hurriedly returned their gaze to the Slaughter Blood Phantom, which was snaking in front of Zhang Fei again.

Zhang Fei had already opened his eyes, and his bloody-red eyes shone brightly. He casually looked at the Slaughter Blood Phantom, and there was not the slightest fear in his expression. He did not stop absorbing the power contained in the blood; instead, his absorption rate was getting faster and faster.
Zhang Fei smirked faintly before releasing his killing intent and bloodlust, which spread and enveloped the entire area of the Blood Sea.

Shang Luohu and the five asura demon guardians were somehow frightened by Zhang Fei’s killing intent and bloodlust, and they subconsciously took a step back. ’What the hell is with this young demon? How can he scare us with his killing intent and bloodlust?’
Zhang Fei extended his hand to the Slaughter Blood Phantom. "I didn’t come here to disturb or challenge you, but I want to absorb the power contained within the blood to increase my strength."
The Slaughter Blood Phantom fiercely stared at Zhang Fei, but it suddenly brought its head to him and wagged its tail, allowing him to pet it like a docile beast.

Shang Luohu and the five asura demon guardians were dumbstruck watching the behavior of the Slaughter Blood Phantom. Nalan Wangzi was also astonished by that because she still didn’t know Zhang Fei that well, and she turned to Tian Shuixiang, who shook his head in response.
The five male asura demons rubbed their eyes to make sure they didn’t see wrongly, but it was a fact that the phantom was being docile towards Zhang Fei. ’What the fuck is going on here?’
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed as he patted the head of the Slaughter Blood Phantom. "You like my killing intent and bloodlust, huh?"
The Slaughter Blood Phantom nodded to Zhang Fei before looking at the surface of the blood sea, and a large hole suddenly appeared in it, making the bottom visible to his eyes.
The Slaughter Blood Phantom’s actions perplexed Shang Luohu and the others, and they immediately realized its intentions towards Zhang Fei.
"Do you want to take me there?" The Slaughter Blood Phantom said nothing and pulled Zhang Fei into the Blood Sea, and the blood immediately closed by itself.
Shang Luohu was completely confused by the behavior of the Slaughter Blood Phantom. "What’s really going on here? Why is the phantom so docile to that young demon?"

"That young demon doesn’t seem like an ordinary demon, empress." Shang Zhui spoke to her. "We and our emperor continue to feel an unusual feeling radiating from him, but I can’t determine what makes him different."

Shang Luohu nodded to Shang Zhui before flying away. "My husband should already know about this matter, but I will return to the palace to meet him, and you guys must stay here to wait for that young demon to return."
"You guys wait here." Shang Zhui then enveloped Tian Shuixiang and Nalan Wangzi with his aura. "We’ll talk somewhere else."
"Yes, father." Tian Shuixiang and Nalan Wangzi could only surrender as Shang Zhui took them away.
"How did that young demon manage to tame the Slaughter Blood Phantom?" Shang Beixuan asked the other three.
Shang Nanzhui shook his head in response. "Not even we or our emperor can tame the Slaughter Blood Phantom."

"Hey! That young man seems to have some special abilities, so I’ll wait for him to come out of the Blood Sea and challenge him to a fight." The other three turned to Shang Xijiao. "What? Why are you guys looking at me like this? Aren’t you interested in fighting him?"

Shang Dongzhu nodded at him. "Naturally, I want to fight that young demon, but we don’t know when he’ll emerge from the Blood Sea. Furthermore, he managed to bring Shang Xiuluo and that female demon into our domain without us noticing, and we only realized their presence after they made their way here."
"Do you think he will run away?"
"Yes." Shang Dongzhu nodded slightly. "Unfortunately, we have no choice but to wait, as the Slaughter Blood Phantom will attack us if we disturb them now."
Shang Xijiao immediately sat down in his spot. "Let’s wait then! I hope he won’t run away from us because I really want to fight him."
When they arrived at the bottom of the Blood Sea, Zhang Fei saw countless skeletons there, and he could feel that the power contained within the blood came from them.

The Slaughter Blood Phantom immediately moved to a rock that wasn’t very large, but it exuded a strong bloodlust and glowed blood-red. It curled up there and circled the rock, signaling Zhang Fei to sit on the rock.

Zhang Fei immediately sat on the rock and absorbed the power in it and the blood, but his bloodlust immediately went out of control, causing his eyes to become even redder. He hurriedly suppressed it while channeling his light element into his body. ’Phew! Almost! It would be troublesome if I lost control of my bloodlust.’
Mei suddenly spoke to him. [Master, you’ll definitely be surprised by the item inside the rock beneath you.]
’Oh?’ Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow slightly. ’What item are you referring to, Mei?’

[Haha! The Asura Demon Bloodline Crystal Essence!] Zhang Fei was shocked by that. [If you can persuade this Slaughter Blood Phantom to hand it over to you, you’ll obtain their bloodline. This way, you’ll be able to use their abilities, including their secret strengthening technique. Moreover, that bloodline does not belong to the current Asura Demon Race but rather to one of their members from the past, who might be even more powerful than their current demon god.]
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "I’ll think about that later, and I’ll focus on tempering myself inside first. Do you think I can bring the blood of this sea into the training space, Mei?"

[Unfortunately, you can’t do that, Master. If you want to cultivate in this sea, you have no choice but to come to this domain. I think it’s not a problem for you because this Slaughter Blood Phantom is attracted to you, so you can come in here whenever you want.]

Zhang Fei let out a disappointed sigh after hearing that, as he preferred cultivating in the training space rather than in the outside world, mainly because of the time flow there. ’Mei, I’ll focus on cultivating here, so I need you to monitor Tian Shuixiang and Nalan Wangzi.’
[Leave them to me, Master.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1257: Shang Zhui’s Explanation
paragraphs: "Why don’t you undo your disguise, little girl?" Shang Zhui asked Nalan Wangzi once they arrived at a room. "Not even my emperor can peek into this place, so you don’t have to worry about him discovering your identity."
"Hehe." Nalan Wangzi chuckled and removed her artifact, revealing her true face. "Do you recognize me now, Uncle Zhui?"
Shang Zhui nodded slightly. "I didn’t expect it to be you, Little Wangzi. How did you end up with my son and that young demon?"

"That young demon is my brother-in-law, and he sent your son back to this realm several years ago." Nalan Wangzi’s confession took Shang Zhui aback. "I’m telling you this because of your good relationship with my father, so I hope you don’t mention this matter to anyone, including Shang Zhanluo."
"I know." Shang Zhui then asked Nalan Wangzi. "Does that mean that the young demon has freed Little Yushu from the Star Tower?"
"Yes." Nalan Wangzi nodded at Shang Zhui. "He not only freed my sister’s soul from the tower, but he also helped her reshape her body, and they are husband and wife now."

"I see." Shang Zhui’s expression looked relieved after hearing the news about Nalan Yushu. "You must tell Little Yuzhu to continue staying in hiding and never appear in public, or Mo Shentian will come after her if he finds out she’s back."

"Yushu was aware of the matter, and my brother-in-law was not stupid, so he would never bring her into public view." Nalan Wangzi then asked Shang Zhui. "What exactly does Mo Shentian want from my sister? Why is he so eager to get her? According to my brother-in-law, there’s nothing special about her, which confuses me."
"Do you really think that Mo Shentian targeted Little Yushu because she was special?" Nalan Zhui’s question made Nalan Wangzi raise an eyebrow.

Tian Shuixiang directly spoke to Nalan Wangzi. "Mo Shentian doesn’t care whether Nalan Yushu is special or not, and he targeted her because your mother loves you both so much. Currently, you are Mo Taizi’s fiancée, and he will gain complete control over your mother if your little sister also falls into his hands."

"I see." Nalan Wangzi nodded in understanding before asking Nalan Zhui again. "Is that also what happened with your race? Shang Xueli and Mo Zixiao’s marriage is still confusing to everyone, as it happened all of a sudden without any prior warning."

"You are lucky because Mo Taizi is different from his big brother, and he never forced you to marry him." Shang Zhui’s words did not surprise Nalan Wangzi because she was familiar with the three princes of the Celestial Demon Race. "We didn’t reveal the details of their marriage to the public because it would be a shame for our asura demon race, but Mo Zixiao used underhanded means to obtain my princess. Since everything has happened, we have no other choice but to hand her over to Mo Shentian, and you already know the rest of the story. Currently, only Mo Taiqi is still single, and his father has already prepared him to be Little Yushu’s husband."

Nalan Wangzi helplessly shook her head. "In the past, I heard that Mo Shentian wanted to marry Mo Taiqi to Ye Nichang, but the latter married in secret. Unfortunately, Aunt Mingran had no other daughters, and the other demon gods had no daughters."

"That’s right." Shang Zhui nodded at her. "Even though Little Yushu previously died, Mo Shentian never forgot his idea. He forced your mother to hand you over to Mo Taizi in exchange for your little sister, and he forced Mo Taiqi to remain single until her soul was free from the tower and reshaped her body."

"Hahaha." Nalan Wangzi laughed softly after hearing that. "Unfortunately, Mo Shentian’s plans for Yushu have failed because she belongs to my brother-in-law now, and he is the most possessive man I have ever met. His strength is still far below yours or all the demon gods, but no one can underestimate him, and those who do will die in regret."
Shang Zhui seemed confused by Nalan Wangzi’s confidence in Zhang Fei, and he looked at his son, but Tian Shuixiang also showed the same expression. "Are you two that confident in that young demon?"

"Father, I’ve witnessed many of his actions in the Three Mortal Realms, and he’s not as simple as you think. I can’t tell you too much detail about him, but I can say that Shang Zhanluo’s decision not to attack him was the best decision he ever made in his life." Shang Zhui was shocked to learn that Zhang Fei came from the Three Mortal Realms and only ascended to the Paradise Realm a few years ago, but he knew that Tian Shuixiang had never boasted or lied to him. "He’s only been cultivating for about 23 or 24 years, but he’s already reached the Celestial Lord Realm, so—"
Shang Zhui immediately shouted. "Are you kidding me? Has that young demon truly been cultivating for such a short period?"

"I’m not lying to you, Father." Tian Shuixiang then told Shang Zhui some things regarding Zhang Fei’s actions in the upper realms of the Three Mortal Realms, which perplexed him. "He is an alchemy god like me; he is also the youngest swordmaster to reach the god-rank in swordsmanship, and he still has skills in various other fields."
"Eh?" Shang Zhui looked at Tian Shuixiang with surprise. "Are you really an alchemy god now? When did you learn alchemy?"
Tian Shuixiang rubbed his head. "I started learning alchemy after I took my wife to escape to the Three Mortal Realms, and I learned it for thousands of years until I reached that rank."
"Where is Zhiye now? Why didn’t you bring her here?" Shang Zhui questioned him.
"She—"

Nalan Wangzi immediately stopped Tian Shuixiang before speaking to Shang Zhui. "Uncle Zhui, I don’t know anything about the matters between your Asura Demon Race and the Eternal Night Demon Race in the past, but I think it’s time to clear things up because we will be facing the same enemy soon. Currently, Mo Shentian is looking for the real body of the Faceless Demon God, and you definitely know the risks if he succeeds in finding him and capturing him."

"Honestly, I’ve heard about that matter, and I’ve tried to find the hiding place of Wu Mian’s real body, but he hid it too neatly." Shang Zhui then told them about the problems between the two demon races. "Not many people know that Ye Futian had two daughters, and his first daughter died at Shang Yuheng’s hands. That fool killed his first daughter and other family members, which worsened the already strained relationship between the two demon races."
"I already knew about Shang Yuheng’s actions from my wife, but I never knew about the strained relationship between the two demon races." Tian Shuixiang spoke.
"Me too." Nalan Wangzi nodded slightly. "I asked my mother about the issues between the two demon races, but she was never willing to explain it to me, and she forbade me from asking about it."

Shang Zhui released a heavy sigh. "The conflict between the two races started with the dispute between the former Asura Demon God and the former Eternal Night Demon God, but I am uncertain about the details of what transpired between them at that time. Since then, the two demon races have been at odds, and Shang Yuheng’s actions worsened our relationship. Therefore, the two demon races were never willing to establish a relationship with each other, but you and Ye Zhiye broke it."
"Father—"

"Forget it." Shang Zhui waved his hand to stop Tian Shuixiang. "I’ve been thinking about this matter since the two of you ran away, Xiuluo. If I still had objections to the relationship between the two of you, we wouldn’t be standing and talking here now, and I would have captured you a long time ago."
"So—"

"Yeah." Shang Zhui then patted Tian Shuixiang’s shoulder. "The dispute between the two demon races is the responsibility of seniors like me, and we shouldn’t burden our younger generations with that responsibility. Since you’re already happy with Ye Zhiye, I won’t say anything more about your relationship with her. Instead, I hope the relationship between you two will bring a better future for both demon races, and I hope you guys will end the enmity between us in the future."

Tian Shuixiang let out a soft sigh before hugging Shang Zhui. "Thank you, Father. I can’t promise you that we will succeed in reconciling the two demon races, but we will definitely try to do it, and the younger generations of both races will never have to suffer as we have."
"I hope you two will succeed."
*Clasped*
Nalan Wangzi clasped her hands. "Isn’t this great, Xiuluo? Your father and Uncle Futian have already approved your relationship with Ye Zhiye, so you guys don’t need to hide it anymore."
Shang Zhui released his son from his embrace. "Have you met Ye Futian before? Has he really accepted your relationship with his daughter?"

"We met with my father-in-law some time ago, and he has accepted our relationship," Tian Shuixiang then told him. "Even though you both have accepted our relationship, my wife and I will not be returning to either domain, and we will focus on helping our leader build his power."
Shang Zhui suddenly realized something. "What exactly is that young demon’s name? Why do you two keep hiding it from me?"
