That fool killed his first daughter and other family members, which worsened the already strained relationship between the two demon races."
"I already knew about Shang Yuheng’s actions from my wife, but I never knew about the strained relationship between the two demon races." Tian Shuixiang spoke.
"Me too." Nalan Wangzi nodded slightly.
"I asked my mother about the issues between the two demon races, but she was never willing to explain it to me, and she forbade me from asking about it."
Shang Zhui released a heavy sigh.

"The conflict between the two races started with the dispute between the former Asura Demon God and the former Eternal Night Demon God, but I am uncertain about the details of what transpired between them at that time.
Since then, the two demon races have been at odds, and Shang Yuheng’s actions worsened our relationship.
Therefore, the two demon races were never willing to establish a relationship with each other, but you and Ye Zhiye broke it."
"Father—"
"Forget it." Shang Zhui waved his hand to stop Tian Shuixiang.
"I’ve been thinking about this matter since the two of you ran away, Xiuluo.
If I still had objections to the relationship between the two of you, we wouldn’t be standing and talking here now, and I would have captured you a long time ago."
"So—"
"Yeah." Shang Zhui then patted Tian Shuixiang’s shoulder.
"The dispute between the two demon races is the responsibility of seniors like me, and we shouldn’t burden our younger generations with that responsibility.
Since you’re already happy with Ye Zhiye, I won’t say anything more about your relationship with her.
Instead, I hope the relationship between you two will bring a better future for both demon races, and I hope you guys will end the enmity between us in the future."
Tian Shuixiang let out a soft sigh before hugging Shang Zhui.
"Thank you, Father.
I can’t promise you that we will succeed in reconciling the two demon races, but we will definitely try to do it, and the younger generations of both races will never have to suffer as we have."
"I hope you two will succeed."
*Clasped*
Nalan Wangzi clasped her hands.
"Isn’t this great, Xiuluo?
Your father and Uncle Futian have already approved your relationship with Ye Zhiye, so you guys don’t need to hide it anymore."
Shang Zhui released his son from his embrace.
"Have you met Ye Futian before?
Has he really accepted your relationship with his daughter?"
"We met with my father-in-law some time ago, and he has accepted our relationship," Tian Shuixiang then told him.
"Even though you both have accepted our relationship, my wife and I will not be returning to either domain, and we will focus on helping our leader build his power."
Shang Zhui suddenly realized something.
"What exactly is that young demon’s name?
Why do you two keep hiding it from me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1258: Shang Zhui’s Request
paragraphs: "His name is—"

"Zhang Xiaolong." Unlike Nalan Wangzi, Tian Shuixiang knew that Zhang Fei always used that name as his disguise while in the Three Mortal Realms, so he gave it to his father. "As I said before, he came from the Three Mortal Realms several years ago, so he has no connection to the Zhang Clan of the Starfall Martial Domain."

Shang Zhui nodded in understanding. "The Zhang Clan of the Starfall Martial Domain has never favored any demon race, so he couldn’t possibly be one of them. Even if he were, they would have killed him long ago because he was a disgrace to their clan. Then, what do you mean by wanting to help him build his power? Does he want to dominate this realm?"

"You are mistaken, Uncle Zhui." Shang Zhui looked at Nalan Wangzi. "My brother-in-law is the opposite of Mo Shentian or Shang Zhanluo, and he has never been interested in dominating this realm. He wants to build his power so he can live a free life and protect those closest to him, and he also wants to build a place that will be a sanctuary for all races."
"A sanctuary for all races?" Shang Zhui was surprised to hear that.

Tian Shuixiang immediately spoke to his father. "Wangzi is right, Father. In fact, Zhang Xiaolong has a good relationship with all races, whether human races, demon races, beast races, winged races, or natural races. Many of them have sent their representatives to join him, and they live in one place in one of the domains now. My wife and I joined him after we witnessed all his past actions for ourselves, and we believe that he will succeed in uniting all races."

"Who are the people who have joined Zhang Xiaolong?" Shang Zhui found it difficult to believe Tian Shuixiang’s words, as Long Wuzhao had once tried to unite all the races in the past, but he ultimately failed, leaving only Zhang Fei, who hadn’t ascended to their realm for long.

Tian Shuixiang and Nalan Wangzi exchanged glances for a moment. "Among the demon races, both my Soul-Devouring Race and the Eternal Demon Race have joined him. My mother decided to join him because he is her son-in-law, and Aunt Mingran decided to join him because he is Ye Futian’s great-grand disciple."
"Oh?" Shang Zhui was surprised by Zhang Fei and Ye Futian’s relationship. "How could he become Ye Futian’s great-grand disciple?"

"Father, do you remember when my father-in-law descended to the Three Mortal Realms to look for us?" Shang Zhui nodded to Tian Shuixiang. "He met a sword master there, and he was interested in his swordsmanship, so he took him as his disciple. His disciple was dead, but that same deceased disciple took on a new disciple, who later became Zhang Xiaolong’s master. Therefore, he became my father-in-law’s great-grand disciple."

Shang Zhui nodded in understanding. "This universe is so vast yet so small. Zhang Xiaolong and Ye Futian should have never met each other, but they already had such a relationship before he ascended to this realm. He even met Ye Zhiye and you there, and he took the two of you back here. So, who are the other people?"

"Tian Yizu’s daughter and Tianshi Bailong’s daughter are also on his side now." Shang Zhui was shocked again after hearing those two names from Tian Shuixiang. "In fact, he has a good relationship with Long Wuzhao, and the dragon emperor has helped him resolve various issues several times, including those that arose in the Endless Night Dungeon some time ago."

Shang Zhui furrowed his brows. "I’ve heard reports from members of our race who went into that dungeon, and they said that Long Wuzhao appeared there along with Long Xukong and Tianshi Bailong. I heard they captured the ten evil mythical beasts, but I didn’t hear about Zhang Xiaolong."

"Hehe." Nalan Wangzi chuckled. "Naturally, you wouldn’t hear about my brother-in-law, Uncle Zhui. He didn’t make public appearances; instead, he carried out all his actions behind the scenes. When he noticed the presence of the ten evil mythical beasts, he immediately asked Tianshi Shengjie to contact Tianshi Bailong, and he came there with Long Wuzhao and Long Xukong. Thus, you should already understand about his relationship with them, right?"
Shang Zhui nodded to Nalan Wangzi. "Since Long Wuzhao and the two dragons were willing to come to answer Zhang Xiaolong’s call, their relationship was obviously very deep."

"The Ice Phoenix Race has also joined my brother-in-law, as one of his wives is an ice phoenix." Shang Zhui stared at Nalan Wangzi in astonishment, as the ice phoenix race had never been involved with any race, let alone a demon like Zhang Fei. "Several natural races from this realm have also joined him, one of which is Jia Xianzu."
"Huh?" Jia Xianzu’s name shocked Shang Zhui again. "Did he really decide to return?"

"Yes." Nalan Wangzi nodded at Shang Zhui. "You don’t know it yet, but Jia Zizhen’s secret has been exposed, and the rumors that he conspired with demon races to kill the previous Fairy King have been proven true. Mo Shentian and Jiu Mozu helped him to gang up on the previous Fairy King, and he absorbed his power before killing him."

Shang Zhui himself had long suspected that Jia Zizhen was colluding with several demon races, but he never expected the Fairy King to be in cahoots with Mo Shentian and Jiu Mozu. "Who managed to uncover Jia Zizhen’s secret?"

"Who else but Long Wuzhao?" Nalan Wangzi then explained to Shang Zhui some of the things about how the dragon emperor could know the truth, but he did not tell him about Zhang Fei’s relationship with Jia Yuyan. "Jia Xianzu already knew the truth, so he decided to return and join my brother-in-law, and several members of the fairy race will follow him soon, such as Jia You. In fact, there are several natural races on my brother-in-law’s side now, such as elves, dwarfs, dryads, and many others."

Shang Zhui took a breath after hearing all that, as Zhang Fei’s feat was simply too fast, and no one was aware of his action except for the people in his inner circle. "Xiuluo, I understand your desire not to return to this domain, but you are still part of our asura demon race, and you are one of the candidates to replace our emperor in the future."
"Father, I—"

"I’m not asking you for anything difficult, and I just want you to maintain your relationship with Zhang Xiaolong." Without Shang Zhui saying it, Tian Shuixiang had long decided that he would always stay by Zhang Fei’s side. "If all your stories are true, I believe he will continue to grow, and he will become a great power in this realm. I am familiar with our emperor’s character because I have been his advisor for so long, but I can’t guess anything for now. He hasn’t done anything to him now, but he might change his mind if he becomes too strong in the future, and he might consider him a threat."
"You mean—"

Shang Zhui nodded slightly. "Our emperor’s ego and pride are too high, and he will never allow anyone to threaten him. If Zhang Xiaolong becomes too strong, I believe he will attack him even if he knows the depth of his strength. However, many members of our race are different from him, and many of us desire a more peaceful life, including me. I hope something like that will not happen, but I can’t stop our emperor with my strength. If it happens in the future, I hope you will be the liaison between him and our race, and you must lead our race to a better future."
"Father—"
"How about you, Uncle Zhui?" Nalan Wangzi asked.

Shang Zhui shook his head at her. "Little Wangzi, I am Shang Zhanluo’s subordinate, and you know that I cannot disobey his orders because of my oath. If he decides to attack Zhang Xiaolong, I will have no other choice but to help him."

"I see." Nalan Wangzi nodded in understanding. "Actually, we don’t need to think about things that might not happen, and we still have plenty of time to think about the best solution for the sake of all parties. I don’t know how the oath in your demon race works, but my brother-in-law might have a way to break your oath, so you don’t need to follow Shang Zhanluo’s orders."

"Haha." Shang Zhui laughed while shaking his head. "Little Wangzi, our oath was ingrained in our soul when we took the oath to be loyal to Shang Zhanluo, so no one will ever be able to break it, and the only way to break it is death."
Hearing that, Tian Shuixiang and Nalan Wangzi exchanged glances before laughing softly, confusing Shang Zhui.
"Is there something funny?" Shang Zhui asked with raised eyebrows.
"Hehe." Nalan Wangzi giggled while shaking her head. "There’s nothing funny, Uncle Zhui.

Tian Shuixiang then told Shang Zhui. "Father, Zhang Xiaolong is an expert soul cultivator, and his soul level has already reached the half-perfection stage of the divine soul level. On the other hand, Shang Zhanluo is a warrior and not a soul cultivator, so I believe he can remove your oath to him from within your soul."
Shang Zhui wore an incredulous expression after hearing that. "Is his soul level really that high? How can he learn so many things at once? Alchemy path, soul cultivation path, and sword path."

chapters.title: Chapter 1259: Convince The Phantom
paragraphs: Tian Shuixiang and Nalan Wangzi chose not to answer Shang Zhui’s questions. "Father, we’ve already talked too much about him, so we won’t say any more. However, I assure you that he should be able to remove it from your soul, but we must wait for him to come out."
"Alright, I understand." However, Shang Zhui asked them again. "Did he come here specifically to train in the Blood Sea?"
"Yes." Tian Shuixiang decided to lie to his father. "I told him about the Blood Sea because he was eager to train there to temper his body."
Shang Zhui nodded slightly. "In that case, I won’t keep you two here, and you can accompany her on a stroll in this Blood War City, Xiuluo."
"Father." Shang Zhui raised an eyebrow at Tian Shuixiang. "It’s not that I want to disown you or disrespect our ancestors, but I prefer to use my current name, Tian Shuixiang."
Shang Zhui let out a soft sigh. "Even though I don’t like it, I will address you as Tian Shuixiang from now on."
"Thank you, Father."
Thereafter, Tian Shuixiang took Nalan Wangzi with her, and the two of them strolled around Blood War City, as they didn’t know how long Zhang Fei would be cultivating in the Blood Sea.
On the other hand, Shang Zhui went to the Asura Palace to meet Shang Zhanluo.
"What do you think about that young demon, wife?"

Shang Luohu shook his head at Shang Zhanluo. "I can’t be sure about that young demon, and we still have to investigate him more deeply. However, his killing intent and bloodlust were quite frightening to me, and I subconsciously stepped back when he released both. Oddly, the Slaughter Blood Phantom liked him so much that it behaved docilely around him and led him to the bottom of the Blood Sea."

"I also feel strange about that." Shang Zhanluo narrowed his eyes as he looked at the location of the Blood Sea. "I once tried to tame the Slaughter Blood Phantom because my predecessor could do it, but it actually attacked me with killing intent even though I was the emperor of our race. Yet, it behaved that way toward that young demon, which confused me. Could it be that he has a relationship with our race?"
"I don’t think so, Emperor." Shang Zhanluo and Shang Luohu turned to Shang Zhui, who had just appeared. "His name is Zhang Xiaolong, and he ascended to this realm about five to six years ago."
"Did your son tell you about that? Is the woman with them Ye Zhiye?" Shang Luohu questioned Shang Zhui.

"My son told me his name, but the woman with them is not Ye Zhiye. Instead, she is Zhang Xiaolong’s lover, as I can sense his yang Qi within her body." Shang Zhui’s final sentence surprised Shang Zhanluo and Shang Luohu because Zhang Fei’s cultivation was at the Celestial Lord Realm, and Nalan Wangzi’s cultivation was at the Celestial Emperor Realm, making them puzzled by her decision to become his lover. "By the way, I couldn’t see through her disguise even from close range, and she was unwilling to introduce herself to me. She came here just to accompany him and to take a walk."
"Your son told you something else about Zhang Xiaolong, right?" Shang Zhanluo spoke with confidence.

Shang Zhui nodded at Shang Zhanluo before telling them some things about Zhang Fei based on what he heard from Tian Shuixiang and Nalan Wangzi before, but he hid many details from them, such as Nalan Yushu’s return, his relationship with several races, and some other sensitive matters.

Shang Zhanluo and Shang Luohu were utterly shocked when Shang Zhui mentioned Zhang Fei’s status as a god-rank sword master, since he was still too young to have reached that level. "Are you sure about that?"

"Empress, you know my son’s character, and he will never lie to me." Shang Luohu nodded to Shang Zhui. "After my son said that to me, I guessed that the Slaughter Blood Phantom behaved like that toward Zhang Xiaolong because of his sword qi. Even though our race was born from blood and war, none of us had walked the sword path, which made the Slaughter Blood Phantom attracted to him. Given his current level of cultivation, he is certainly not a match for us, and he has come here solely to strengthen his body in the Blood Sea. Therefore, I think we don’t need to do anything to him; instead, we can try to build a good relationship with him."

Shang Luohu looked at her husband and spoke to him. "I agree with him, husband. Zhang Xiaolong’s cultivation is indeed too low to be our opponent, so we don’t need to worry too much that he will create chaos in our domain. Furthermore, he is still in his early forties, but he has already become a god-rank sword master; even the sword maniac, Jian Kuang, can’t do that. Additionally, the Slaughter Blood Phantom likes him, and it might turn against us if we try to do evil things to him."

"Hmm?" Shang Zhanluo frowned, recalling the Slaughter Blood Phantom’s docile behavior toward Zhang Fei. "Alright, I won’t take any action against Zhang Xiaolong at this time, but I want everyone to monitor him closely. Additionally, I want you to find a way to uncover that female demon’s disguise, and I want to know her identity as soon as possible."
"Yes." Shang Luohu then ordered someone to monitor Nalan Wangzi from a distance.

"Emperor, I’ve obtained important information about Mo Shentian." Shang Zhanluo looked at Shang Zhui with a deeper frown. "He took his third son, Shang Taiqi, to the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain three days ago. I heard they were looking for a female beast named Dong Xuanyin to ask for her help in finding Wu Mian’s real body."

"What’s so special about Dong Xuanyin? Why does Mo Shentian want to look for her?" Shang Zhanluo asked in confusion, as he didn’t have much information about the evil beast races, except for the four perils.

Shang Zhui shook his head in response. "I don’t have clear information on Dong Xuanyin’s abilities, but Mo Shentian seems confident that she can help him. If she manages to find Wu Mian’s true body and hand it over to him, our Asura Demon Race and the other demon races will be in serious trouble, so we must find a way to stop her."

"Hmm?" Shang Zhanluo immediately took out a device and sent a message to someone before giving an order to Shang Zhui. "Send Shang Hongyan and Shang Liang to the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain, and an acquaintance of mine from the evil beast races will meet them there."
"Yes." Shang Zhui immediately disappeared from their sight.

Shang Zhanluo also left the place, leaving Shang Luohu behind. However, she doesn’t live there; Instead, she went to the Blood Sea again, as she was curious about Zhang Fei’s activities at the bottom of the sea.
Zhang Fei, who was cultivating at the bottom of the Blood Sea, immediately opened his eyes when he sensed the movement of the Slaughter Blood Phantom.

"Why are you looking at me like this?" The Slaughter Blood Phantom shook his head at Zhang Fei because it was unable to speak. "Are you staying at the bottom here to guard the Asura Demon Bloodline Crystal Essence in this rock?"
The Slaughter Blood Phantom nodded its head, and it used its claws to point to the rock under Zhang fei.
"Can you hand it over to me?" Zhang Fei was disappointed that the Slaughter Blood Phantom rejected his wish. "Do you want to give it to one of the members of the Asura Demon Race?"
The Slaughter Blood Phantom nodded its head again.

"Hmm? Will the Asura Demon Bloodline Crystal Essence make an asura demon stronger than the current Asura Demon God?" The Slaughter Blood Phantom nodded again, and Zhang Fei immediately thought of Tian Shuixiang. "I have an acquaintance who is an asura demon, and he is much better than Shang Zhanluo. What do you think if I bring him here? If you feel that he deserves it, you can hand it over to him."
The Slaughter Blood Phantom didn’t answer Zhang Fei right away, and it thought for quite a long time.

Zhang Fei sighed softly before trying to convince the Slaughter Blood Phantom. "You don’t know him like I do, so it’s natural to doubt him. However, I assure you that his character is far better than Shang Zhanluo’s, and his talent is also excellent. If he becomes stronger than Shang Zhanluo after obtaining that item, he might be able to defeat him in the future and become the next Asura Demon God. I believe the asura demon race will be more prosperous under his leadership, so I hope you can give him a chance. If you think he is not worthy of getting it, I will send him away directly."
After some thought, the Slaughter Blood Phantom finally agreed to give Tian Shuixiang a chance, much to Zhang Fei’s relief.
Zhang Fei immediately used his water element to push the blood around him away, and he opened the portal to the training space afterward, making the Slaughter Blood Phantom curious about it.

The Slaughter Blood Phantom grew even more curious as Zhang Fei [4] walked out from inside, but Zhang Fei immediately closed the portal. "I’ll go pick up my acquaintance, and my clone will take my place here."

"In that case, I won’t keep you two here, and you can accompany her on a stroll in this Blood War City, Xiuluo."
"Father." Shang Zhui raised an eyebrow at Tian Shuixiang.
"It’s not that I want to disown you or disrespect our ancestors, but I prefer to use my current name, Tian Shuixiang."
Shang Zhui let out a soft sigh.
"Even though I don’t like it, I will address you as Tian Shuixiang from now on."
"Thank you, Father."
Thereafter, Tian Shuixiang took Nalan Wangzi with her, and the two of them strolled around Blood War City, as they didn’t know how long Zhang Fei would be cultivating in the Blood Sea.
On the other hand, Shang Zhui went to the Asura Palace to meet Shang Zhanluo.
"What do you think about that young demon, wife?"
Shang Luohu shook his head at Shang Zhanluo.
"I can’t be sure about that young demon, and we still have to investigate him more deeply.
However, his killing intent and bloodlust were quite frightening to me, and I subconsciously stepped back when he released both.
Oddly, the Slaughter Blood Phantom liked him so much that it behaved docilely around him and led him to the bottom of the Blood Sea."
"I also feel strange about that." Shang Zhanluo narrowed his eyes as he looked at the location of the Blood Sea.
"I once tried to tame the Slaughter Blood Phantom because my predecessor could do it, but it actually attacked me with killing intent even though I was the emperor of our race.
Yet, it behaved that way toward that young demon, which confused me.
Could it be that he has a relationship with our race?"
"I don’t think so, Emperor." Shang Zhanluo and Shang Luohu turned to Shang Zhui, who had just appeared.
"His name is Zhang Xiaolong, and he ascended to this realm about five to six years ago."
"Did your son tell you about that?
Is the woman with them Ye Zhiye?" Shang Luohu questioned Shang Zhui.
"My son told me his name, but the woman with them is not Ye Zhiye.

Instead, she is Zhang Xiaolong’s lover, as I can sense his yang Qi within her body." Shang Zhui’s final sentence surprised Shang Zhanluo and Shang Luohu because Zhang Fei’s cultivation was at the Celestial Lord Realm, and Nalan Wangzi’s cultivation was at the Celestial Emperor Realm, making them puzzled by her decision to become his lover.
"By the way, I couldn’t see through her disguise even from close range, and she was unwilling to introduce herself to me.
She came here just to accompany him and to take a walk."
"Your son told you something else about Zhang Xiaolong, right?" Shang Zhanluo spoke with confidence.

Shang Zhui nodded at Shang Zhanluo before telling them some things about Zhang Fei based on what he heard from Tian Shuixiang and Nalan Wangzi before, but he hid many details from them, such as Nalan Yushu’s return, his relationship with several races, and some other sensitive matters.
Shang Zhanluo and Shang Luohu were utterly shocked when Shang Zhui mentioned Zhang Fei’s status as a god-rank sword master, since he was still too young to have reached that level.
"Are you sure about that?"
"Empress, you know my son’s character, and he will never lie to me." Shang Luohu nodded to Shang Zhui.
"After my son said that to me, I guessed that the Slaughter Blood Phantom behaved like that toward Zhang Xiaolong because of his sword qi.
Even though our race was born from blood and war, none of us had walked the sword path, which made the Slaughter Blood Phantom attracted to him.
Given his current level of cultivation, he is certainly not a match for us, and he has come here solely to strengthen his body in the Blood Sea.
Therefore, I think we don’t need to do anything to him; instead, we can try to build a good relationship with him."
Shang Luohu looked at her husband and spoke to him.
"I agree with him, husband.
Zhang Xiaolong’s cultivation is indeed too low to be our opponent, so we don’t need to worry too much that he will create chaos in our domain.
Furthermore, he is still in his early forties, but he has already become a god-rank sword master; even the sword maniac, Jian Kuang, can’t do that.
Additionally, the Slaughter Blood Phantom likes him, and it might turn against us if we try to do evil things to him."
"Hmm?" Shang Zhanluo frowned, recalling the Slaughter Blood Phantom’s docile behavior toward Zhang Fei.
"Alright, I won’t take any action against Zhang Xiaolong at this time, but I want everyone to monitor him closely.
Additionally, I want you to find a way to uncover that female demon’s disguise, and I want to know her identity as soon as possible."
"Yes." Shang Luohu then ordered someone to monitor Nalan Wangzi from a distance.
"Emperor, I’ve obtained important information about Mo Shentian." Shang Zhanluo looked at Shang Zhui with a deeper frown.
"He took his third son, Shang Taiqi, to the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain three days ago.
I heard they were looking for a female beast named Dong Xuanyin to ask for her help in finding Wu Mian’s real body."
"What’s so special about Dong Xuanyin?
Why does Mo Shentian want to look for her?" Shang Zhanluo asked in confusion, as he didn’t have much information about the evil beast races, except for the four perils.
Shang Zhui shook his head in response.
"I don’t have clear information on Dong Xuanyin’s abilities, but Mo Shentian seems confident that she can help him.
If she manages to find Wu Mian’s true body and hand it over to him, our Asura Demon Race and the other demon races will be in serious trouble, so we must find a way to stop her."
"Hmm?" Shang Zhanluo immediately took out a device and sent a message to someone before giving an order to Shang Zhui.
"Send Shang Hongyan and Shang Liang to the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain, and an acquaintance of mine from the evil beast races will meet them there."
"Yes." Shang Zhui immediately disappeared from their sight.
Shang Zhanluo also left the place, leaving Shang Luohu behind.
However, she doesn’t live there; Instead, she went to the Blood Sea again, as she was curious about Zhang Fei’s activities at the bottom of the sea.
Zhang Fei, who was cultivating at the bottom of the Blood Sea, immediately opened his eyes when he sensed the movement of the Slaughter Blood Phantom.
"Why are you looking at me like this?" The Slaughter Blood Phantom shook his head at Zhang Fei because it was unable to speak.
"Are you staying at the bottom here to guard the Asura Demon Bloodline Crystal Essence in this rock?"
The Slaughter Blood Phantom nodded its head, and it used its claws to point to the rock under Zhang fei.
"Can you hand it over to me?" Zhang Fei was disappointed that the Slaughter Blood Phantom rejected his wish.
"Do you want to give it to one of the members of the Asura Demon Race?"
The Slaughter Blood Phantom nodded its head again.
"Hmm?

Will the Asura Demon Bloodline Crystal Essence make an asura demon stronger than the current Asura Demon God?" The Slaughter Blood Phantom nodded again, and Zhang Fei immediately thought of Tian Shuixiang.
"I have an acquaintance who is an asura demon, and he is much better than Shang Zhanluo.
What do you think if I bring him here?
If you feel that he deserves it, you can hand it over to him."
The Slaughter Blood Phantom didn’t answer Zhang Fei right away, and it thought for quite a long time.
Zhang Fei sighed softly before trying to convince the Slaughter Blood Phantom.
"You don’t know him like I do, so it’s natural to doubt him.
However, I assure you that his character is far better than Shang Zhanluo’s, and his talent is also excellent.
If he becomes stronger than Shang Zhanluo after obtaining that item, he might be able to defeat him in the future and become the next Asura Demon God.
I believe the asura demon race will be more prosperous under his leadership, so I hope you can give him a chance.
If you think he is not worthy of getting it, I will send him away directly."
After some thought, the Slaughter Blood Phantom finally agreed to give Tian Shuixiang a chance, much to Zhang Fei’s relief.
Zhang Fei immediately used his water element to push the blood around him away, and he opened the portal to the training space afterward, making the Slaughter Blood Phantom curious about it.
The Slaughter Blood Phantom grew even more curious as Zhang Fei [4] walked out from inside, but Zhang Fei immediately closed the portal.
"I’ll go pick up my acquaintance, and my clone will take my place here."

chapters.title: Chapter 1260: Fighting Shang Xijiao
paragraphs: *Splash*

Shang Luohu and the four asura guardians were surprised when Zhang Fei emerged from the Blood Sea. They wanted to block him, but he immediately used the nine cloud steps and disappeared from their sight.
"Too fast!" The four asura guardians screamed simultaneously.
Zhang Fei’s speed also shocked Shang Luohu. "As expected, it wasn’t his original speed but a movement technique."
"A movement technique?"

"Yes." Shang Luohu nodded at them. "I didn’t believe it at first either, but I was sure that it was his movement technique after seeing it up close. His original speed was ridiculously fast, and his movement technique made his speed even faster."
"Do you know where he went, Empress?" Shang Beixuan asked.
"Yes." Shang Luohu nodded in response. "Shang Xiuluo and the female demon are in the Blood War City now, so I’m sure he went there to pick them up."
"Shall we chase after him?"

"No need." Shang Luohu then told them about Shang Zhanluo’s decision regarding Zhang Fei, including Shang Zhui’s conversation with Tian Shuixiang, which shocked them. "Furthermore, Xiuluo said that Zhang Xiaolong wants to temper his body in the Blood Sea, so I’m sure he will return soon."

"Can I try fighting him, Empress?" Shang Luohu frowned at Shang Xijiao. "Haha! Empress, I just want to test his fighting skills, okay? I won’t use all my strength against a junior like him, so you don’t have to worry about me harming him."

Shang Beixuan, Shang Nanzhui, and Shang Dongzhu also expressed the same wish as their friends, causing Shang Luohu to sigh softly. "Alright, the four of you can test Zhang Xiaolong’s abilities, but I strictly forbid you from using your full strength when fighting him; otherwise, he will sustain heavy injuries and possibly die. Do you guys understand?"
"Yes, Empress!" The four guardians answered in unison.
Shang Luohu did not immediately leave the Blood Sea, and they waited for Zhang Fei to return there.
[Quest: Visit the Blood War City.]
[Quest rank: Easy]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: Easy gift pack x 1]

[Master, Shang Luohu and the other four are waiting for you in the Blood Sea, and I think you can use this opportunity to fight them. After all, Tian Shuixiang already told you that Shang Zhanluo won’t make a move on you, so I don’t think those people will dare defy their emperor’s orders.]
’That’s true.’ Zhang Fei nodded in agreement. ’In recent times, I’ve only sparred with Jian Kuang and Zhuxian Sheng, so I need new sparring partners, and I’ll use them as my sparring partners.’

Zhang Fei did not immediately meet Tian Shuixiang and Nalan Wangzi, and he went to look at the shops in the Blood War City, which mostly sold war equipment and demon items. Unfortunately, none of the items caught his interest, so he went straight to them.

After the three met, Zhang Fei told Tian Shuixiang about the Asura Demon Bloodline Crystal Essence at the bottom of the Blood Sea. "Honestly, I wanted to obtain it to strengthen myself, but the Slaughter Blood Phantom refused my request. Instead, it wanted to give it to an asura demon, but it deemed no one worthy of it, including Shang Zhanluo."
"Then—"

"You don’t need to feel inferior, you know?" Zhang Fei stopped Tian Shuixiang. "Shang Zhanluo may be the current emperor and the demon god of your Asura Demon Race, but you are not inferior to him. I’ve convinced the Slaughter Blood Phantom to let you go there, and it will see if you are worthy of obtaining the Asura Demon Bloodline Crystal Essence. If you succeed in obtaining it, it will boost your strength significantly, and you will become stronger than the other asura demons. This way, your chances of becoming the next Asura Demon God will be wide open, and you can replace that guy in the future."
*Slap*

Nalan Wangzi slapped Tian Shuixiang on the back. "This kind of opportunity will not come twice, so you should not waste it. Since the Slaughter Blood Phantom deemed no one worthy of it, including Shang Zhanluo, then this is your best chance. Moreover, your situation will be much better if you succeed in reaching the demon god rank, and you can live more peacefully and safely with your wife."
"Alright, let’s go there."

Shang Luohu and the four asura guardians looked at Zhang Fei and the others as soon as they arrived at the Blood Sea, but they were shocked because the Slaughter Blood Phantom suddenly surfaced once again before taking Tian Shuixiang into the sea.
However, the Slaughter Blood Phantom didn’t take Zhang Fei with it, which confused Shang Luohu and the four asura guardians.
"Zhang Xiaolong." Zhang Fei turned to Shang Luohu. "Our guardians want to spar with you."
Zhang Fei wasn’t too surprised by that. "I have no problem with that, but my cultivation is far below theirs, so it wouldn’t be fair if we fought using our cultivation, right?"
"Yes." Shang Luohu nodded at Zhang Fei. "Don’t worry, they won’t be using their cultivation or full strength, and you guys will be fighting using your raw strength."
Zhang Fei nodded slightly before looking at the four guardians. "So, which one of you wants to fight me first?"
"Me." Shang Xijiao immediately stepped forward while clasping his six hands together. "I—Gah!"
Shang Xijiao hadn’t finished speaking when Zhang Fei had already attacked and knocked him several steps back, causing the jaws of the other three guardians to drop.

Shang Luohu also stood dumbfounded at her spot, and her eyes repeatedly blinked as she couldn’t see Zhang Fei’s movement. Moreover, Shang Xijiao’s physique was quite big and strong, and he could knock him back several steps with just one punch.

Unfortunately, none of them knew that Zhang Fei mastered eight body cultivation techniques, and the majority had already reached the max level, making his body and raw strength far above other cultivators.
Nalan Wangzi’s lips curled up seeing their expressions, but she didn’t say anything and walked to Shang Luohu’s side, standing there.
Shang Xijiao rubbed his stomach as he stared at Zhang Fei. "Your punch was really hard for a cultivator at your level, kid."

"My punch just now wasn’t even ten percent of my raw strength, senior." Shang Xijiao was stunned when she heard that, but Zhang Fei quickly stood in front of her and punched her in the stomach once again.
"Gah!" Unlike before, Zhang Fei’s second punch didn’t knock Shang Xijiao back, but it sent him flying quite a distance.
Shang Xijiao hurriedly stabilized himself, but Zhang Fei once again moved in front of him and delivered a barrage of punches, forcing him to cover his face and chest with his six hands.

’Shit! His punches got faster and stronger every time he hit me.’ Shang Xijiao tried to find an opening to counterattack, but Zhang Fei didn’t give him the chance to do so and used his absolute condition ability to further enhance his strength and speed. ’Damn it! If he keeps pushing me like this, Beixuan and the others will definitely laugh at me.’

Shang Xijiao immediately flew high into the sky to avoid him, but Zhang Fei swiftly chased after him. He did not loosen up his attack on the male asura demon; instead, he attacked him even faster and harder, causing bruises to start appearing all over his body.

Below, Shang Beixuan and the other two guardians looked up to watch their battle in the air, and they rubbed their eyes several times to make sure they were not seeing things wrong, as Zhang Fei continued to pressure Shang Xijiao.

Shang Luohu frowned deeply as he watched their fight, but then he turned to Nalan Wangzi. "How can your lover fight like that? His speed and raw strength are too ridiculous for a demon cultivator of his level. Shang Xijiao may not be the strongest, but he is still very strong, yet your lover can push him that far."

"Haha." Nalan Wangzi softly laughed. "You underestimate my lover too much, Empress Luohu. Shang Xijiao may be strong, but Jian Kuang is stronger than him, and my lover sparred with that sword maniac every day before. Not only him, but the speed demon, Su Shentian, is one of his sparring opponents, and you should know how fast his speed is, right?"
Shang Luohu was shocked when he heard that. "How did your lover know the sword maniac and the speed demon?"

"They met in the Forbidden Land, and they were attracted to my lover’s abilities; thus, they came to him and challenged him to a spar, and they sparred every day for over a month." Nalan Wangzi then looked up at the sky. "If my lover were serious, he could defeat Shang Xijiao quickly, but he didn’t want to hurt his pride, so he still held back."
Hearing that, Shang Luohu turned his gaze to the battle in the air, and he could see that Zhang Fei was indeed still holding himself back. ’This young demon is truly unbelievable!’
’Fuck!’ Shang Xijiao cursed inwardly as he still hadn’t managed to land a single blow on Zhang Fei; instead, his body was filled with the bruises of his attacks.
Shang Xijiao decided to use a little more strength, but Zhang Fei quickly teleported away, and a bloody red figure manifested behind him.
Shang Xijiao instantly froze as soon as he saw the bloody red figure behind Zhang Fei. ’What the hell! Could it be the manifestation of his killing intent and bloodlust?’

chapters.title: Chapter 1261: Fight The Other Two
paragraphs: "You’re wrong." Shang Xijiao raised an eyebrow at Zhang Fei, who pointed at the bloody red figure behind him. "This one is the embodiment of my bloodlust, and I have not used my killing intent."
"Are you fucking kidding me?" Shang Xijiao asked in a loud, incredulous tone.
Zhang Fei shrugged his shoulders, but a jet-black figure suddenly appeared behind him, causing Shang Xijiao to fall dumbstruck.

’What the hell is with this brat!’ Shang Xijiao was visibly shaken by the appearance of the jet-black figure, which was the embodiment of Zhang Fei’s killing intent. ’His killing intent and bloodlust are far more intense than what he displayed when the Slaughter Blood Phantom appeared earlier!’
Below them, Shang Luohu and the other three asura guardians were also frightened by the two figures behind Zhang Fei, especially after they realized the origins of the two.
"Do you believe me now?" Zhang Fei asked casually.
Shang Xijiao nodded at Zhang Fei. "How can you simultaneously manifest and restrain your killing intent and bloodlust?"

"The sword maniac, Jian Kuang, taught me to manifest both." Shang Xijiao was surprised to hear that name from Zhang Fei. "As for how I can restrain my killing intent and bloodlust, it’s because I use both every day, even when I sleep. Thus, it’s not difficult for me to restrain both, and I can use them whenever I want."

Shang Xijiao furrowed his brows because Zhang Fei’s words really made no sense to him. It was impossible for a demon born from blood and battle like him to use killing intent and bloodlust while sleeping, and both of them would spiral out of control if he did that.

Zhang Fei shook his head slightly. "Naturally, I didn’t succeed on the first try, and both went out of control when I tried it the first time. However, I kept repeating the process, and I managed to do it after decades of trying."

"Decades, huh?" Shang Xijiao muttered to himself. "You’re still in your early forties, and normal cultivators start cultivating at 16. However, you couldn’t use your bloodlust and killing intent at that time, and you need to reach a certain stage to be able to use them. Furthermore, your killing intent and bloodlust are abnormal, which proves that you’ve killed a lot in the past. According to my calculations, you’ve only mastered both for about two decades or slightly longer."

"Unfortunately, you’re wrong about that, senior." Shang Xijiao looked at Zhang Fei in disbelief. "Believe it or not, I’ve been able to use my killing intent and bloodlust since my cultivation was in the Ten Mortal Realms, and I’ve continued to hone both of them to this day. I no longer remember how many living beings I’ve killed directly or indirectly because their number was too numerous; otherwise, my killing intent and bloodlust wouldn’t be this strong."
Shang Xijiao didn’t doubt Zhang Fei because cultivators could only hone their killing intent and bloodlust through battle and killing, and he also used the same method to hone his.

However, Shang Xijiao doubted that Zhang Fei could have killed so many at such a young age; nevertheless, he could tell that his killing intent and bloodlust were much stronger than his own, indicating that he had killed far more than he had in the past. "Aren’t you afraid that we or the others will kill you for exposing yourself like this?"

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed softly and canceled both. "Naturally, I am aware of the risks, but I have decided not to hide anymore, and I will face anyone who comes to kill me. If all of you wanted to kill me, you guys would have done it from the start. However, it is too late because the Slaughter Blood Phantom is now on my side, and it will attack you if you try to kill me."
"What a shameless brat!" Shang Xijiao grumbled. "Let’s continue our fight."
"Sure!"
In an instant, Zhang Fei and Shang Xijiao engaged in fierce combat once again, but he continued to gain the upper hand over the male asura demon, frustrating him.

After that, he straightened his clothes.
"Since you’re exhausted and it’s already late, I’ll take you to the Blood War City to rest, and we’ll go to the Blood Forest early in the morning."
"Alright."
They were already in a room at a fairly luxurious inn, and they lay side by side on the bed, with Nalan Wangzi curled up in Zhang Fei’s embrace.
"How long will it take for Tian Shuixiang to absorb the item?"
"I don’t know how long the process will take." Nalan Wangzi nodded slightly to Zhang Fei.
"However, you don’t need to worry about Tian Shuixiang because my fourth clone is there with him, and I will know when the process is complete."
Nalan Wangzi immediately closed her eyes and tried to rest, but Zhang Fei remained awake, monitoring the area.

He also thought about the fox statue in the Blood Forest, as his actions there would surely be discovered by Shang Zhanluo once he fused with one of the ten-tailed fox souls. ’Mei, which soul do you think is in that forest?’
[Master, you have obtained his lust and pride souls, and his sloth soul is in the Floral Mirage Domain.
Meanwhile, his wrath soul is in the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain, so the possibility is that one of his greed, gluttony, or envy souls is in the forest.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1263: Blood Forest
paragraphs: In their palace, Shang Zhanluo listened to Shang Luohu’s report on Zhang Fei’s ability to defeat three of the five Asura Guardians, which shocked him.

Shang Zhanluo truly did not expect Zhang Fei to be able to match two of them and only narrowly lose to one. Although they fought without their cultivation or full strength, he felt that his feat was truly impressive, and no cultivator at his level could accomplish such a feat.

"I gave him permission to enter the Blood Forest." Shang Zhanluo looked at Shan Luohu with a frown. "There aren’t any secrets in the forest, and he just wanted to hone his fighting skills, so I let him go there."

Shang Zhanluo had no problem with that, but he felt that Zhang Fei would not be able to face those bloodthirsty beasts. "Are you sure Zhang Xiaolong won’t die there? Where is Shang Xiuluo now? What about that female demon? Have you found out her true identity?"

"I don’t know whether Zhang Xiaolong will die or not, but it was his wish, so let him bear the consequences. As for Shang Xiuluo, the Slaughter Blood Phantom brought him to the bottom of the lake, but I don’t know the reason behind it. By the way, he no longer wants to use his past name, and he prefers to be called Tian Shuixiang." Shang Zhanluo raised an eyebrow for a moment, but he quickly ignored it, and Shang Luohu informed him of something else. "I can’t reveal the identity of that female demon because I don’t know how she concealed her true face and aura, but I think she used a special artifact to do so."

"Forget it then." Shang Zhanluo then let out a soft sigh. "I don’t have time to deal with those people, and I’m thinking of going to the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain myself, as I don’t believe that Shang Hongyan and Shang Liang will be able to do their tasks. If Mo Shentian manages to find Wu Mian’s real body, our asura demon race will be doomed, and I won’t let that happen."

Shang Luohu was surprised by Shang Zhanluo’s sudden decision. "Are you sure you want to do that? If Mo Shentian finds out that you’re intentionally following him, he might turn against you, and our asura demon race will be in jeopardy if anything bad happens to you."
"Aren’t you looking down on me too much?" Shang Zhanlu shook his head in response. "If Mo Shentian can defeat me, do you think he will restrain himself from attacking us?"

Shang Luohuo felt helpless upon hearing that. "Alright, I won’t stop you if you insist on going to that domain, but you better be careful because the four perils are stronger than all the demon races."
"I know." Shang Zhanluo disappeared instantly.
Shang Luohuo immediately went to rest, but he continued to wonder about Zhang Fei’s true identity because there had never been a transcendent lust demon with nine tails like him.
Early in the morning, Zhang Fei brought Nalan Wangzi to the entrance of the Blood Forest and immediately showed the guard there the token that Shang Luohu had given him yesterday.
The guard was a little surprised by Zhang Fei’s identity, but he didn’t stop him because of Shang Luohu’s token.
Not long after Zhang Fei and Nalan Wangzi entered the Blood Forest, Shang Zhui appeared in front of the entrance, and he immediately followed them according to Shang Luohu’s request.

The Blood Forest stretched across the Slaughter Blood Domain, and no ordinary tree could survive there. Its towering trunks were made not of wood, but of crimson bone-like bark, and its leaves dripped with blood instead of dew. It is said that each tree is nourished by the essence of countless fallen warriors, their blood seeping into its roots until the forest itself is filled with their hatred.

The air was filled with a mist of blood, so thick it stuck to the skin like armor, yet corroded the souls of any living creature who entered it. Whispers drifted through the mist—echoes of slaughtered lives, cries, laughter, and screams all at once, maddening intruders who dare trespass. The ground pulsed faintly and carried the life essence of the dead.

The beasts and trees born here were unique, and they were fused with the bloodlust of the living creatures that died within. Some trees uprooted themselves to hunt intruders, and their roots became blood-drenched tendrils. Others sprout Blood Flowers, releasing intoxicating scents to lure victims before devouring them whole. Legends say that a colossal ancient tree lived within the Blood Forest, and each of its branches harbored the spirits of asura demons who died in the past.

The Asura Demon Race regarded the Blood Forest as a trial ground, and young demons who sought strength were cast into its depths. If they survived the whispers, the mist, and the beasts, their bloodline awakened to greater slaughter intent. If they fail, their essence becomes nourishment for the forest.
At the heart of the forest lies an underground river of pure blood essence that feeds the entire land, and many believed it directly connects to the Blood Sea.
[Master, Shang Zhui has also entered this forest, and he is monitoring you two from afar.]

’I’m sure Shang Zhanluo or Shang Luohu sent Shang Zhui to monitor us. Since he is Tian Shuixiang’s father, and he clearly chose to side with us, we don’t need to worry about him.’ Zhang Fei then released his soul domain and summoned the demon extermination sword, followed by Nalan Wangzi, who also summoned her sword. "Oh? Your sword is also a spirit weapon, huh?"

"Haha." Nalan Wangzi showed her grey sword to Zhang Fei. "This soul eater sword was a gift from my grandfather, but I rarely use it, as its spirit is difficult to control. Since Shang Luohu will recognize me if I use my main weapon, I will use this sword for now. By the way, I’ve heard that there is an ancient colossal tree living in this Blood Forest, and the asura demon race called it the Blood Tree King."

"The Blood Tree King, huh?" Zhang Fei immediately checked the Blood Forest area through the map, finding the tree living in the heart of the forest, which was still far from their location. Additionally, he saw countless red dots on the map, indicating that all creatures living in the forest were hostile.

However, Zhang Fei was confused because the red dots were divided into three bright categories, and such a thing had never happened before. ’What happened to the map, Mei? Why do these red dots have three different colors?’

[I can’t say for sure, Master. However, I think the dimmer red indicates weak enemies, and the brighter red indicates strong enemies, especially since the name of the Blood Tree King is also marked by the brighter red. Master, the statue of the ten-tailed fox is hidden underground, precisely under that ancient tree.]

’Fuck!’ Zhang Fei inwardly cursed, as the Blood Tree King was definitely not weak. His main purpose in coming to the Slaughter Blood Domain was to look for the statue of the ten-tailed fox, but it was actually hidden under such a powerful creature. ’Can you scan the power of that ancient tree, Mei?’
[Master, the Blood Tree King’s strength is equivalent to Long Wuzhao’s in the Celestial God Realm, and its demon rank is also at the Demon God Rank.]
’Holy fudge!’ Zhang Fei inwardly shouted. ’How can I defeat that tree if it’s as powerful as Long Wuzhao!? Do you think Bing Xingying can open a void crack to get in there?’
[Master, the only way is to ask Bing Xingying to try it first, and you will know the result later.]
*Tap*
Nalan Wangzi patted Zhang Fei’s shoulder. "What happened? Why is your expression so strange? Is there something bothering you?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei used telepathy to tell Nalan Wangzi about the location of the statue of the ten-tailed fox. "Forget it! Let’s go there first."

"Alright." Nalan Wangzi followed behind Zhang Fei, but several bloodthirsty beasts suddenly attacked them. Fortunately, all the beasts in the outer perimeter of the forest weren’t too strong, and the two of them were able to kill them without much difficulty.

In the distance, Shang Zhui noticed the demon extermination sword in Zhang Fei’s hand. "This kid is truly mysterious! He’s a demon, but he wields a sword specifically created for slaying demons. Furthermore, his sword is clearly a spirit weapon, but I can sense two different auras from it, which means it has two souls. What exactly is his purpose in coming to this forest? I don’t believe he came here to train, and I’m sure he has other goals. However, I’ve explored every area of this forest thousands of times in the past, but I’ve never found anything interesting here."

Shang Zhui immediately moved to follow Zhang Fei and Nalan Wangzi, but the two of them went into an area filled with bloodthirsty beasts, which made him even more confused about their purpose in going to the forest.

Zhang Fei’s primary goal in coming to the Blood Forest was to find the statue of the ten-tailed fox, but he also wanted to train there. Furthermore, he didn’t yet have a solution to defeat the Blood Tree King, and he was still waiting for Bing Xingying’s true body to inspect the heart of the forest through the void, so he didn’t rush to go there.

chapters.title: Chapter 1264: Wan Jiang/Jia Xianzu Arrival
paragraphs: *Swoosh... Swoosh...*

The demon extermination sword flew back and forth, killing all the bloodthirsty demon beasts that stood in Zhang Fei’s path. Some of those that escaped the sword’s path died immediately upon entering the range of his sword domain.
Meanwhile, Nalan Wangzi’s soul eater sword moved to eat the souls of those bloodthirsty demon beasts that died due to Zhang Fei’s sword and sword domain.
"This is why I rarely use my Soul Eater Sword because I can’t control it. It always moves as it pleases when it sees many souls falling before it." Nalan Wangzi helplessly spoke.

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "It happened because you never tried to understand the spirit inside your sword, so it wasn’t willing to follow your orders. In my opinion, your sword spirit isn’t truly mature yet, and it’s still at a rebellious age. Unlike your sword spirits, my twin sword spirits were already mature, and they’ve always helped me ever since. After the Gang Zhishou taught me how to communicate with them, our relationship became closer."

Nalan Wangzi turned to Zhang Fei. "How can you communicate with your twin sword spirits? Even though I have become the master of my soul eater sword, my sword spirit has never been willing to reveal itself."

"Just like other living beings, a spirit weapon has its own soul space, and its spirit resides within it. If your sword spirit is not willing to reveal itself to you, you must meet it inside there." Zhang Fei then asked for the Demon Extermination Sword to be returned to him, but the Soul Eater Sword was unwilling to return when Nalan Wangzi asked it to. "Hey, brat! If you dare disobey her order to return, I will dissolve you with my flames, and I will turn you into a lump of metal."
The soul eater sword stopped flying and turned toward Zhang Fei, but it trembled as soon as he used his golden crow flame, making Nalan Wangzi smile in amusement.

"Come here!" Zhang Fei said in a commanding tone, and the Soul Eater Sword immediately flew in front of him like a docile creature. He immediately grabbed his hilt and rubbed the blade. "You better not doubt my words, little brat. I’m a supreme-rank blacksmith, and my golden crow flame can melt everything. Or would you rather die and turn into a lump of metal?"
*Zing... Zing... Zing...*
The soul eater sword trembled even more when Zhang Fei channeled a bit of his golden crow flame into it, and its spirit immediately shot out from within.

Nalan Wangzi fell dumbstruck as soon as he saw the spirit of the soul eater sword because he was a boy around six years old. His body was completely black with two red eyes, two small horns on the top of his head, and a short tail behind his hips.
"Heh! As expected!"
"Big brother! Please don’t burn me or turn me into a lump of metal!" The boy begged Zhang Fei with teary eyes. "I... I will definitely listen to my master’s orders."
Zhang Fei shook his head slightly. "What’s your name?"
"My... my creator gave me the name Hun Jian."
"Hun from soul and Jian from sword, huh?" Zhang Fei channeled his soul power into Hun Jian’s body, startling him. "If you don’t want to suffer, you must listen to her orders. Do you understand?"

"I understand, Big Brother." Hun Jian nodded his head strongly before moving to Nalan Wangzi’s side and sitting on his shoulder. "Master, please forgive me, okay? From now on, I will always listen and carry out your orders."

Nalan Wangzi grabbed Hun Jian, brought him before her, and rubbed his head. "It’s okay, you don’t need to remember the past. From now on, the two of us will work together to defeat our opponents, and my brother-in-law will help you to become stronger."
"Yes, Master." Hun Jian immediately entered the soul eater sword again and brought the sword floating to Nalan Wangzi’s side.
Nalan Wangzi felt relieved at this, and she gave Zhang Fei a soft kiss. "Thank you."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed softly. "Let’s continue; we must—hmm?"
"What happened?" Nalan Wangzi asked.
"Wait a minute." Zhang Fei furrowed his brows. "An underground river of pure blood essence, huh?"
Nalan Wangzi was surprised to hear that. "Did you find an underground river in this forest?"

"Not me." Zhang Fei shook his head slightly. "According to someone, there is an underground river of pure blood essence that stretches from the Blood Sea to the heart of this forest, but that area is filled with countless wandering evil souls of those who died in this domain long ago."
’Can that underground river take us to that place?’

’Not really.’ Zhang Fei released a soft sigh. ’According to her, the underground river can indeed reach that place, but that place is protected by something strong. She couldn’t see inside, so she couldn’t be sure whether the statue of the ten-tailed fox was there. The number of those wandering evil souls was too numerous, and they were too powerful. They would attack anyone who entered there at once, leaving me uncertain if my soul level was sufficient to confront them all at once. Your cultivation is indeed high, but your soul level is not yet as high as your cultivation, and you will definitely die if you enter there.’
Nalan Wangzi did not doubt Zhang Fei, as he was more experienced than her in the soul cultivation path. ’So, how are you going to get in there? Are you going to ask Hun Di and the others for help?’

Zhang Fei shook his head slightly. ’My master can help me fight those wandering evil souls because his soul level is high now, but my senior brothers and senior sisters are not yet capable of going in there. I can use my eternal flame to protect myself, but I still won’t be able to fight that many of them.’
’So, what are your plans now?’

’Hmm?’ Zhang Fei looked toward the heart of the Blood Forest. ’Let’s set aside the underground river for now, and we’ll try going to that area first. The Blood Tree King’s strength is strong, but I will meet it first, and I hope he’ll be willing to let me in. If he won’t let me in, I’ll find another way to get in. Furthermore, there is still one other problem that I have to think about a solution for, as it will bring big problems for us.’

’What kind of problem is that?’ Zhang Fei led Nalan Wangzi on their journey while telling her several things, especially about the process and phenomenon that might occur if he merged with one of the ten-tailed fox souls.
As before, Zhang Fei used his sword and soul domain to fight the bloodthirsty demon beasts, and the demon extermination sword continued to hover around the area, killing them.

After Zhang Fei threatened him, Hun Jian no longer dared to move as he pleased, and he allowed Nalan Wangzi to control the movements of the soul-eating sword. Every time she killed a bloodthirsty demon beast, her sword immediately consumed its soul.
Just like before, Shang Zhui was still following the two from a distance, but their previous conversation confused him, especially regarding Zhang Fei’s golden crow flame.

Normally, demons were afraid of this golden crow flame because it could incinerate them, but Zhang Fei possessed it. As an experienced demon, Shang Zhui was certain that he also possessed the golden crow bloodline; otherwise, he wouldn’t have used the golden flame.

Shang Zhui was also curious about how Zhang Fei was able to find the underground river of pure blood essence, including the identity of the woman who helped him find it. "Does this kid really want to challenge the Blood Tree King? That old tree is truly powerful. I’ve challenged it several times, but it always defeated me in just a few attacks. Even Shang Zhanluo has never managed to defeat it with his current strength, let alone this kid. I hope he’s not reckless in challenging that old tree; otherwise, he will die in its hands."
Meanwhile, Jia Xianzu had just arrived outside the Passion Moonlit Temple, and Zhang Fei [5] immediately met him before taking him to the sect. "Are all your matters finished?"
"Yes." Jia Xianzu nodded at Zhang Fei [5]. "I just returned from the Emerald Bamboo Sect to inform Li Tianyu and Lan Yueru of my resignation from the sect."

"That’s good." Zhang Fei [5] then led him to the area where the natural races lived. "Xun’er and Mei’er are going to other domains with some of my wives, as they still don’t know much about this realm. Since you are a fairy race, I will take you to them, and I hope you can help them to develop themselves."
"Did you bring many fairy races from the Three Mortal Realms?"

"Not really." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly. "There are too many natural races in the Three Mortal Realms, but I don’t know any of them. Most of them come from the Sky Jade Realm, the Nine Stars Realm, and the Sovereign Heaven Realms."

Before long, they arrived at the fairy race’s residential area, and Zhang Fei introduced Jia Xianzu to them. The representative from the Sky Jade Realm was Zefyr’s grandfather, Oliver. The representative from the Nine Stars Realm was Lei Ting. Jia Yuyan represented the Sovereign Heaven Realm, but the old fairy already knew her.

From now on, I will always listen and carry out your orders."
Nalan Wangzi grabbed Hun Jian, brought him before her, and rubbed his head.
"It’s okay, you don’t need to remember the past.
From now on, the two of us will work together to defeat our opponents, and my brother-in-law will help you to become stronger."
"Yes, Master." Hun Jian immediately entered the soul eater sword again and brought the sword floating to Nalan Wangzi’s side.
Nalan Wangzi felt relieved at this, and she gave Zhang Fei a soft kiss.
"Thank you."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed softly.
"Let’s continue; we must—hmm?"
"What happened?" Nalan Wangzi asked.
"Wait a minute." Zhang Fei furrowed his brows.
"An underground river of pure blood essence, huh?"
Nalan Wangzi was surprised to hear that.
"Did you find an underground river in this forest?"
"Not me." Zhang Fei shook his head slightly.

"According to someone, there is an underground river of pure blood essence that stretches from the Blood Sea to the heart of this forest, but that area is filled with countless wandering evil souls of those who died in this domain long ago."
’Can that underground river take us to that place?’
’Not really.’ Zhang Fei released a soft sigh. ’According to her, the underground river can indeed reach that place, but that place is protected by something strong.
She couldn’t see inside, so she couldn’t be sure whether the statue of the ten-tailed fox was there.
The number of those wandering evil souls was too numerous, and they were too powerful.
They would attack anyone who entered there at once, leaving me uncertain if my soul level was sufficient to confront them all at once.
Your cultivation is indeed high, but your soul level is not yet as high as your cultivation, and you will definitely die if you enter there.’
Nalan Wangzi did not doubt Zhang Fei, as he was more experienced than her in the soul cultivation path. ’So, how are you going to get in there?
Are you going to ask Hun Di and the others for help?’

Zhang Fei shook his head slightly. ’My master can help me fight those wandering evil souls because his soul level is high now, but my senior brothers and senior sisters are not yet capable of going in there.
I can use my eternal flame to protect myself, but I still won’t be able to fight that many of them.’
’So, what are your plans now?’
’Hmm?’ Zhang Fei looked toward the heart of the Blood Forest. ’Let’s set aside the underground river for now, and we’ll try going to that area first.
The Blood Tree King’s strength is strong, but I will meet it first, and I hope he’ll be willing to let me in.
If he won’t let me in, I’ll find another way to get in.
Furthermore, there is still one other problem that I have to think about a solution for, as it will bring big problems for us.’

’What kind of problem is that?’ Zhang Fei led Nalan Wangzi on their journey while telling her several things, especially about the process and phenomenon that might occur if he merged with one of the ten-tailed fox souls.
As before, Zhang Fei used his sword and soul domain to fight the bloodthirsty demon beasts, and the demon extermination sword continued to hover around the area, killing them.
After Zhang Fei threatened him, Hun Jian no longer dared to move as he pleased, and he allowed Nalan Wangzi to control the movements of the soul-eating sword.
Every time she killed a bloodthirsty demon beast, her sword immediately consumed its soul.
Just like before, Shang Zhui was still following the two from a distance, but their previous conversation confused him, especially regarding Zhang Fei’s golden crow flame.
Normally, demons were afraid of this golden crow flame because it could incinerate them, but Zhang Fei possessed it.
As an experienced demon, Shang Zhui was certain that he also possessed the golden crow bloodline; otherwise, he wouldn’t have used the golden flame.
Shang Zhui was also curious about how Zhang Fei was able to find the underground river of pure blood essence, including the identity of the woman who helped him find it.
"Does this kid really want to challenge the Blood Tree King?
That old tree is truly powerful.
I’ve challenged it several times, but it always defeated me in just a few attacks.
Even Shang Zhanluo has never managed to defeat it with his current strength, let alone this kid.
I hope he’s not reckless in challenging that old tree; otherwise, he will die in its hands."
Meanwhile, Jia Xianzu had just arrived outside the Passion Moonlit Temple, and Zhang Fei [5] immediately met him before taking him to the sect.
"Are all your matters finished?"
"Yes." Jia Xianzu nodded at Zhang Fei [5].
"I just returned from the Emerald Bamboo Sect to inform Li Tianyu and Lan Yueru of my resignation from the sect."
"That’s good." Zhang Fei [5] then led him to the area where the natural races lived.
"Xun’er and Mei’er are going to other domains with some of my wives, as they still don’t know much about this realm.
Since you are a fairy race, I will take you to them, and I hope you can help them to develop themselves."
"Did you bring many fairy races from the Three Mortal Realms?"
"Not really." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly.
"There are too many natural races in the Three Mortal Realms, but I don’t know any of them.
Most of them come from the Sky Jade Realm, the Nine Stars Realm, and the Sovereign Heaven Realms."
Before long, they arrived at the fairy race’s residential area, and Zhang Fei introduced Jia Xianzu to them.
The representative from the Sky Jade Realm was Zefyr’s grandfather, Oliver.
The representative from the Nine Stars Realm was Lei Ting.
Jia Yuyan represented the Sovereign Heaven Realm, but the old fairy already knew her.

chapters.title: Chapter 1265: Beiming Youhuang Join In
paragraphs: Since Qing Qiu’er, Yan Jinwu, and Sima Huiqing were going to other domains with his other wives, Zhang Fei [5] took Jia Xianzu to the mountaintop. "This sect has changed compared to the past, and it looks more like a sanctuary now. You brought so many natural races and beast races from the Three Mortal Realms, and two demon races from this realm have also joined you."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that. "The Soul-Devouring Demon Race is my in-laws, so I invited them to join me, and my mother-in-law immediately agreed. As for the Eternal Night Demon Races, I was able to persuade Ye Mingran to join me because of my relationship with Ye Futian and his daughter."

"I see." Jia Xianzu nodded in understanding. "I still didn’t expect that Shang Xiuluo and Ye Zhiye had been by your side for so long, but that young asura demon wouldn’t be able to help you persuade the Asura Demon Race to join you. Although Shang Zhui’s status is quite high, he doesn’t have the authority to decide, and all decisions are in Shang Zhanluo’s hands. You must use your strength to defeat him if you want him to join you, as his demon race honors the strongest."
"I know." Zhang Fei [5] released a soft sigh. "In fact, my real body is in the Slaughter Blood Domain now, and I already sparred with three of the five asura guardians yesterday."
"Hmm?" Jia Xianzu frowned.

"I don’t have any other choice, okay?" Zhang Fei [5] was helpfully responsive. "One of the souls of the ten-tailed fox lives in that domain, precisely in the underground chamber at the heart of the Blood Forest, so I went there to meet him. Unfortunately, the Blood Tree King, an ancient colossal tree with strength comparable to Long Wuzhao, guards that location. With my current strength, I will certainly die in its hands if I fight it, so I have to think of something to persuade it to allow me to enter there."
"Are there other paths to enter the underground chamber?"

"There is one, but that place is also full of danger." Zhang Fei [5] then shared the information about the underground river of pure blood essence that he got from Bing Xingying’s real body with Jia Xianzu. "Those wandering evil souls are much stronger than the ones I faced in the Nine Hells Darkland Realm in the past, and their numbers are simply too numerous. There aren’t many powerful cultivators on my side, so I have to think twice about entering that place."

Jia Xianzu immediately released his soul, surprising Zhang Fei [5]. "As you can see, my soul level is at the perfection stage of the divine soul level, so I can help you fight those wandering evil souls. However, we can’t go there with just the two of us, and we need the help of other people."
"Do you know other powerful soul cultivators?"

"Beiming Youhuang is a soul cultivator, and her soul level has also reached the divine soul level." Zhang Fei [5] naturally remembered about that, and he was able to suppress her back then because she was unprepared. If she were in a ready state, he would never be able to suppress her. "If you need help from other soul cultivators, you can go to the Immortal Soul Palace because their members are soul cultivators. The strongest among them is Hun Lingwu, and his cultivation has already reached the Three-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm."

Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow because Luo Yunxiao had once told him about Hun Lingwu, but she had said that he wasn’t exactly a decent person and that he was such a jealous old man. "I think we shouldn’t go there because that old man isn’t a good person, and Yunxiao told me that he would most likely attack me if he found out about me."
"Haha." Jia Xianzu laughed at that. "Yunxiao is right about Hun Lingwu, but you cannot generalize the members of the Immortal Soul Palace. Many of them are decent people, and I know some of them."

"Still, it’s too risky. Indeed, we can go there without meeting Hun Lingwu, but he is their leader, and he can hear about me from them." Jia Xianzu agreed with Zhang Fei [5]. "Even though I want to meet and merge with one of the souls of the ten-tailed fox soon, I would rather not take such a risk because there are so many people by my side, so I will think of another way to enter that place."
Jia Xianzu abruptly looked outside. "They’ve arrived."
Soon, Fang Roulan landed before them, with Beiming Youhuang and Hua Xiang’er behind her. "Elder Zhang, Senior Beiming wanted to see you, so I brought them here."
"Thank you, Elder Fang. I’ve been waiting for their arrival." Fang Ruolan nodded slightly to Zhang Fei [5] before flying away. "Will you join me too?"

"Yes." Beiming Youhuang replied with a nod. "A few days ago, Yunxiao contacted me and explained many things to me, and I’ve been thinking about this matter since then. I have withdrawn from the Star Cloud Pavilion, and I will join this sect from today."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in satisfaction. "What about you, Senior Xiang’er?"

"Do you need to ask that?" Hua Xiang’er shook her head in response. "My master decided to join you, and my junior sister is your wife. Furthermore, Senior Jia Xianzu and his three disciples, including my little sister, also joined you. Therefore, I decided to follow them to this sect."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] softly laughed. "In that case, welcome to the sect, and Elder Yin Huayan will take care of the identities of you two after this."
Both women nodded to Zhang Fei [5] before Beiming Youhuang asked him. "Why are there only female dual cultivators in this mountain now? Where are those male dual cultivators?"

"Actually, there are still many men in this sect, but all of them live below the mountain." Zhang Fei [5] then pointed into the distance. "I took over the Blazing Union Sect some time ago, and I decided to divide the elders and disciples into two. Thus, there are only female elders and disciples in this sect, and all the men live in that sect now."
"Why?" Both women were confused by Zhang Fei [5]’s decision.

"This sect has the Celestial Yin Lake, and the Blazing Union Sect has the Celestial Yang Lake." Beiming Youhuang could immediately understand Zhang Fei [5]’s intention to divide them. "Since there are no male dual cultivators here, the two of you can stay and cultivate in peace here, and you can use the Celestial Yin Lake behind the mountain. However, my residence is also there, and almost all of my wives live there now."
"Oh?" Beiming Youhuang was surprised to hear that. "You finally decided to take them out, huh?"

"They have been living in seclusion for more than two decades, and they have been training really hard during those times. Therefore, I brought them out so they can gain firsthand experience, and I hope they will be more capable and mature as cultivators. Right now, they are going to several domains, and several seniors from this sect accompanied them." Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to Hua Xiang’er. "Senior Xiang’er, you can go to see Elder Yin Huayan first, and I will take the two of them to another place to do something."
Hua Xiang’er was not interested in Zhang Fei [5]’s personal affair, so she immediately left the three of them.
"Where are we going?"
Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened a gate, confusing Beiming Youhuang and Jia Xianzu. "Go in first, and you two will know our destination."
"Isn’t this—"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Beiming Youhuang before enveloping them with his aura, and he immediately brought the two of them away to the Endless Night Crucible using the Nine Cloud Steps.

"There." Zhang Fei [5] pointed to the Moon Flame at the top of the black stone stele. "I need the flame to perfect my fire technique, but I can’t face those spectral beasts myself, so I brought you two here."
Beiming Youhuang turned to Zhang Fei [5]. "Didn’t you get the Eternal Flame back in the Forbidden Land? That flame should be able to get rid of these spectral beasts, right?"

"No." Zhang Fei [5] replied with a soft sigh. "I did get the Eternal Flame, but I only got a tiny fragment of it. It’s useful against other living beings, but it’s useless against these spectral beasts."
"Have you tried it before?" Jia Xianzu asked.

"Not yet." Zhang Fei [5] then opened his palm and summoned the Eternal Flame before throwing it towards the spectral beast at the very front, but his flame disappeared before it could hit it. He then tried to use his other flames, but the result was the same, and they immediately disappeared. "See? I don’t know what exactly happened, but I felt there was something in this crucible, and it dispelled my flames. Since you two are strong soul cultivators, I brought you here to help me fight them. If I manage to get the Moon Flame, my flame power will increase again."
"Hmm?" Jia Xianzu raised an eyebrow for a moment before extending his hand forward. "Let me try something."
"Me too." Beiming Youhuang also extended her hand forward.
Both of them frowned as their attacks disappeared before they hit the beast. "You’re right, there’s something inside this crucible."
