chapters.title: Chapter 1266: The Moon Flame’s Spirit
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] let out a heavy sigh. "The Silver Moon Clan is one of the first two ancient clans, and they would never leave any of their sacred places unprotected; however, I am unsure about the type of protection they used for this crucible. Back then, the natural races and some humans entered this place; their strength was quite high, but they almost died at the hands of these spectral beasts."
"Did their attacks disappear like ours?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "Since our attacks are also useless, I think the only solution to approach the Moon Flame is to distract these spectral beasts away. However, they cannot leave this crucible, and their speed is also fast, so our space for movement is limited."

Zhang Fei [5] suddenly remembered someone, and he opened the gate before disappearing inside, confusing Jia Xianzu and Beiming Youhuang. Soon, he returned to that place together with Jian Kuang and Zhuxian Sheng. "Do you have news from Su Shentian?"
"No." Jian Kuang shook his head in response. "That guy’s movements are unpredictable, and he changes domains too frequently. So, what are we going to do here? Why did you bring us here?"
"He must need our help to deal with those beasts." Zhuxian Sheng pointed at the crucible.
"Hmm?" Jian Kuang looked at those spectral beasts. "What kind of beasts are those? I’ve never encountered beasts like them before."
"Spectral beasts." Zhang Fei [5] then told them the purpose of bringing them there before pointing at the Moon Flame. "I need that flame, but these spectral beasts guard it."

Jian Kuang summoned his sword and slashed it toward the nearest spectral beast, but his expression changed to shock as soon as his sword qi disappeared before it could hit the beast. "What the fuck? How can my attack disappear?"

"Let me try something." Zhuxian Sheng summoned the black spear that Feng Yao gave him some time ago, and he threw it toward the front spectral beast. To their surprise, the spear directly pierced through the beast’s body, causing it to disappear instantly. "As expected."
"Did you use your time abilities to deactivate the protection in that place?" Zhang Fei [5] asked.

"No." Zhuxian Sheng shook his head slightly. "Actually, there’s no protection in that place, and the protection you’re referring to lies with these beasts themselves. If you use qi or ranged attacks, their barrier will activate automatically to dispel your attack, but it won’t activate if you use physical attacks, which means we have to attack them at close range. However, there are too many of them and the area is too narrow, so—"

"Hey, look at that." They saw the spectral beast, which Zhuxian Sheng had previously killed, suddenly reappear. "That beast is alive again, and the pause is only a few seconds. If we attack them from close range, they will eventually surround us, and we will be overwhelmed to face them all at once. We can attack them up close, but we can’t kill them; instead, we have to defend while luring them away from the flame, and Zhang Fei [5] will move to take it. However, our numbers are too few compared to theirs, so you should bring your other four clones here to help us distract them."

"My fourth clone is cultivating in the Blood Sea in the Slaughter Blood Domain right now, and he has to monitor Tian Shuixiang, who is fusing with his ancestor’s bloodline, so I can’t bring him here." Zhang Fei [5] then summoned the other three clones out of the training space before asking Zhuxian Sheng. "Can you slow down their movements using your time abilities?"

Zhuxian Sheng supported his chin in thought. "Honestly, my ability to control time isn’t perfect yet, and there are too many of them. I can only stop their movements for one or two seconds, and there is a delay of a few seconds before I can use it again, so you guys should not depend on me."

"It’s alright, we won’t rely on your ability to control time, and you can use it if one of us is in a pinch." After Zhuxian Sheng agreed, they immediately moved to the crucible, but they did not right away enter that area. Despite this, the spectral beasts stood ready to stop them, and their killing intent surged as if they were eager to kill.
"Beasts from the ancient era are indeed different! They are terrifying." Beiming Youhuang nodded in agreement with Jia Xianzu. "So, how are we going to get inside?"
Zhang Fei [1] moved to Beiming Youhuang’s side, as she was the slowest among them. Feltia [2] stood beside Jian Kuang, as he was not a speed cultivator but a sword cultivator.

Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to Jia Xianzu and Zhuxian Sheng. "Since you both have high speed, you can split up, and my third clone will lure the others. Once these spectral beasts chase after you, I will immediately move to take the Moon Flame."
After they agreed, they entered the crucible at the same time before scattering in five different directions. As they expected, those spectral beasts also scattered to chase them.
Like their original plan, Jian Kuang and the others did not attack or kill the spectral beasts, and they only defended against the beasts’ attacks while running away.
However, Zhang Fei [5] saw that some of the spectral beasts were not chasing Jia Xianzu and the others; instead, they floated before the Moon Flame to guard it.

Since he couldn’t use the Demon Extermination Sword because his real body was using it to fight those bloodthirsty demon beasts, Zhang Fei [5] chose to use the Abyss Demon Halberd. After that, he teleported before those spectral beasts, which immediately attacked him with a torrent of poison.
"Poison, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] smirked slightly without avoiding the poison. After all, he has poison immunity, and the beasts’ poison is completely useless against him.

Seeing that, the spectral beasts immediately attacked Zhang Fei [5] using another attack, but their attack only hit the illusion. Soon, ten other illusions appear in front of the beasts, infuriating them and attacking the illusions directly.
Below them, Zhang Fei [1], Feltia [2], and Zhang Xiaolong [3] also used the clone illusion steps, creating thirty illusions that confused the spectral beasts.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] had already teleported above the Moon Flame, but an attack suddenly appeared out of nowhere and struck him, propelling him backward. "Shit! Where did that attack just now come from?"
[Master, the attack just now came from the Moon Flame itself. The flame has apparently given birth to a spirit, and it doesn’t want you to take it.]

"A spirit, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] muttered as he flew away because those spectral beasts charged at him. He immediately activated his soul domain to restrict the beasts’ movements, but it was not very useful. He decided to activate his lust domain, and he used the fourth effect to absorb their power. Additionally, he used the fifth effect, casting illusion upon them.
Seeing that his plan was working, Zhang Fei [5] immediately used the Reversal Mirror Technique, and several mirrors appeared around him, including the golden mirror.

Zhang Fei [5] approached the Moon Flame again, but the flame immediately attacked him like before. However, he activated the golden mirror and reversed the attack, causing it to strike back into the flame.

"Ahhh!" A woman’s scream rang in Zhang Fei [5]’s ear, and soon a woman with silver hair like a moon shot out of the Moon Flame. She furiously stared at him, but she didn’t dare to attack him directly after being hit by her own attack just now. "You! Who are you? How could you reverse my attack?"

Zhang Fei [5] did not immediately answer her; instead, he dodged the spectral beasts attacking from below, which then flew up to hover between him and the Moon Flame’s spirit. "As expected! They’re here to protect you, huh?"

"Humph!" The woman snorted at Zhang Fei [5]. "Their souls belong to members of the Silver Moon Race who died in the past, and they chose to protect me after their death because I was the most important treasure in their race. Now tell me, who are you? Why do you want to take my flame?"

Zhang Fei [5] transformed into his complete fox form with nine tails dancing behind him, leaving the woman stunned for a moment. However, she was shocked when ten flames appeared around him, and she could immediately recognize them.

"The Phoenix Flame, the Soul Flame, the Dragon Flame, the Sky Flame, the Earth Flame, the Blood Flame, and the Eternal Flame." The woman then looked at the other three. "The Golden Crow Flame, the Vermilion Flame, and the Icy Cold Flame."

Huo Diqiu came straight out of the Earth Flame, surprising the spirit of the Moon Flame. "Hehehe! Big Sis, please don’t be angry with my master. He needs your flame to perfect his fire technique, and you can see for yourself that he already possesses seven of the ten Heavenly Flames. Currently, only your Moon Flame, the Sun Flame, and the Chaotic Flame are left, so I hope you can give your flame to him."

"No!" The spirit of the Moon Flame immediately refused. "I belong to the Silver Moon Race, and I have sworn allegiance to them. Even though they are extinct, I will never betray my oath, and I will continue to protect this domain in their stead."

"The Silver Moon Clan is one of the first two ancient clans, and they would never leave any of their sacred places unprotected; however, I am unsure about the type of protection they used for this crucible.

"Did their attacks disappear like ours?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them.
"Since our attacks are also useless, I think the only solution to approach the Moon Flame is to distract these spectral beasts away.
However, they cannot leave this crucible, and their speed is also fast, so our space for movement is limited."
Zhang Fei [5] suddenly remembered someone, and he opened the gate before disappearing inside, confusing Jia Xianzu and Beiming Youhuang.
Soon, he returned to that place together with Jian Kuang and Zhuxian Sheng.
"Do you have news from Su Shentian?"
"No." Jian Kuang shook his head in response.
"That guy’s movements are unpredictable, and he changes domains too frequently.
So, what are we going to do here?
Why did you bring us here?"
"He must need our help to deal with those beasts." Zhuxian Sheng pointed at the crucible.
"Hmm?" Jian Kuang looked at those spectral beasts.
"What kind of beasts are those?
I’ve never encountered beasts like them before."
"Spectral beasts." Zhang Fei [5] then told them the purpose of bringing them there before pointing at the Moon Flame.
"I need that flame, but these spectral beasts guard it."
Jian Kuang summoned his sword and slashed it toward the nearest spectral beast, but his expression changed to shock as soon as his sword qi disappeared before it could hit the beast.
"What the fuck?
How can my attack disappear?"
"Let me try something." Zhuxian Sheng summoned the black spear that Feng Yao gave him some time ago, and he threw it toward the front spectral beast.
To their surprise, the spear directly pierced through the beast’s body, causing it to disappear instantly.
"As expected."
"Did you use your time abilities to deactivate the protection in that place?" Zhang Fei [5] asked.
"No." Zhuxian Sheng shook his head slightly.
"Actually, there’s no protection in that place, and the protection you’re referring to lies with these beasts themselves.
If you use qi or ranged attacks, their barrier will activate automatically to dispel your attack, but it won’t activate if you use physical attacks, which means we have to attack them at close range.
However, there are too many of them and the area is too narrow, so—"
"Hey, look at that." They saw the spectral beast, which Zhuxian Sheng had previously killed, suddenly reappear.
"That beast is alive again, and the pause is only a few seconds.
If we attack them from close range, they will eventually surround us, and we will be overwhelmed to face them all at once.
We can attack them up close, but we can’t kill them; instead, we have to defend while luring them away from the flame, and Zhang Fei [5] will move to take it.
However, our numbers are too few compared to theirs, so you should bring your other four clones here to help us distract them."

"My fourth clone is cultivating in the Blood Sea in the Slaughter Blood Domain right now, and he has to monitor Tian Shuixiang, who is fusing with his ancestor’s bloodline, so I can’t bring him here." Zhang Fei [5] then summoned the other three clones out of the training space before asking Zhuxian Sheng.
"Can you slow down their movements using your time abilities?"
Zhuxian Sheng supported his chin in thought.
"Honestly, my ability to control time isn’t perfect yet, and there are too many of them.
I can only stop their movements for one or two seconds, and there is a delay of a few seconds before I can use it again, so you guys should not depend on me."

"It’s alright, we won’t rely on your ability to control time, and you can use it if one of us is in a pinch." After Zhuxian Sheng agreed, they immediately moved to the crucible, but they did not right away enter that area.
Despite this, the spectral beasts stood ready to stop them, and their killing intent surged as if they were eager to kill.
"Beasts from the ancient era are indeed different!
They are terrifying." Beiming Youhuang nodded in agreement with Jia Xianzu.

chapters.title: Chapter 1267: Blood Tree King
paragraphs: "Can you stop these spectral beasts first?" The Moon Flame’s spirit frowned at Zhang Fei [5], who immediately returned to his human form. "I won’t take your flame by force, and I just want to talk to you."
The Moon Flame’s spirit nodded slightly, and those spectral beasts stopped chasing Jian Kuang and the others, relieving them.
Jian Kuang and the others floated to Zhang Fei’s [5] side, and his other three clones returned to the training space.
The Moon Flame’s spirit looked at them with a frown. "Two fairies, a human, and a special human."
"A special human?" Jian Kuang and the two fairies looked at Zhuxian Sheng, who shrugged his shoulders.

"Apart from the time element, he also has the Ancestral Battle Saint Physique, so I said that he is a special human." Zhuxian Sheng inwardly sighed because it was his secret, but the Moon Flame’s spirit revealed it to them. She then asked Zhang Fei [5]. "What do you want to talk to me about?"

"The Silver Moon Clan isn’t extinct." The Moon Flame’s spirit clearly didn’t believe Zhang Fei [5] because she witnessed the destruction of that race in the past, but he immediately summoned Yin Yue’s soul out of his soul world, which shocked her. "Do you believe me now?"
"How... how is this possible? How... how can your soul still be here, Master? How... how can you be with him?" The Moon Flame’s spirit questioned Yin Yue with a stutter.

Yin Yue let out a soft sigh and rubbed her head. "Yin Ling, I did die at that time, but Guang Zhiyi preserved my soul, so I still exist now. She imprisoned my soul in the castle, and you can’t leave this place because my body was destroyed, so you don’t know that I was always there."
"Why... why Guang Zhiyi—"

"Ling’er, you remember my mistake, right?" Yin Ling nodded to Yin Yue. "Back then, Guang Zhiyi was fulfilling her duty as the guardian of the ancient races, so you don’t need to blame her since all those incidents happened because of my fault."
"But—"

"No buts, okay?" Yin Yue turned to Zhang Fei [5]. "My soul is too weak right now, and I’m staying with him because he can help me strengthen it. Once my soul is fully strengthened, I will reshape my body, and I will revive our Silver Moon Clan. However, it won’t happen anytime soon, and I have to wait several decades for my soul to recover to its original state."

"Hua... Hua... I... I’m glad you still exist, master." Yin Ling hugged her and cried as hard as she could, and Yin Yue hugged her back in silence while rubbing her head, as she had no words to calm her down.

Jia Xianzu and Beiming Youhuang exchanged glances for a moment before smiling in relief, but their expressions changed once they remembered their past, especially the death of the previous Fairy King. Unfortunately, they had no evidence or power to take revenge against Jia Zizhen, and they were forced to exile themselves for so many years.
Zhang Fei [5] and the others immediately moved away from Yin Yue and Yin Ling, giving them space and time to vent their feelings.
Jian Kuang patted Zhang Fei [5]’s shoulder. "You should have summoned this woman earlier, so we wouldn’t have had to deal with these spectral beasts."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that. "To be honest, I was unaware that Moon Flame possessed a spirit prior to her attack on me, and I only discovered their connection today. If I knew all that from the start, I would have summoned her long ago."
Jian Kuang could only shake his head before looking at some distant area. "Can her clan really rise again? She’s the only one left of her clan, right?"

"Why do you have to ask that, Senior Jian?" Zhuxian Sheng responded with a shake of his head. "As long as this senior still exists, her clan still has a chance to rise again through her. However, her clan may not be as strong as it was in the past, and it will take a very long time to bring it back to its past glory."

Jian Kuang nodded in agreement with Zhuxian Sheng before speaking to Zhang Fei [5]. "Hey, kid! Why don’t you take her as your woman? Your existence is too special, so I’m sure your descendants with her will be extraordinary, and they might even surpass all cultivators in the future."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that. "Would you believe me if I had no interest in Yin Yue?"
"No!" The four people shouted at Zhang Fei [5], particularly since he was the most lustful man they had ever met.

Zhang Fei [5] helplessly sighed at their reaction. "I don’t know what will happen in the future, but I really don’t have any interest in her right now, and I took her with me because I sincerely want to help her come back to life. Furthermore, my wives are numerous now, and I barely have time for them."
Even though Zhang Fei [5] said that, Beiming Youhuang and the others still didn’t believe him, and they were convinced that he would take Yin Yue as his wife someday.
Sometime later, Yin Ling stopped crying, and Yin Yue brought her before Zhang Fei [5]. "Ling’er, I—"

"No!" Yin Ling immediately refused Yin Yue because she understood her wishes. "If he wants my Moon Flame, he has to help you come back to life first. However, I won’t hand over my flame to him because you are my master, and I will only give him a fragment of my flame then."
"But—"

"Alright, you don’t need to force her." Zhang Fei [5] stopped Yin Yue before speaking to Ying Ling. "Since she is your master, I will not force you to choose me to be your master, and a fragment of your Moon Flame is enough for me. Instead of spending time alone in this place, what if I send you into my soul world? This way, you can accompany her there, and the two of you won’t feel bored together."
"Huh?" Ying Ling looked at Zhang Fei [5] with repeated winks. "Do... do you really have a soul world?"

Instead, Yin Yue answered Yin Ling. "Zhang Fei [5] does have a soul world, and it’s already a perfect world. However, there are still no humans or other races there, except for the beast races for now. Therefore, let him take you and the Moon Flame into his soul world, and we will spend some time together there."

"Alright." Yin Ling stretched out her hand toward the Moon Flame, and it immediately shot out in front of them. She then spoke to Zhang Fei [5]. "Since my master asked me like that, you can send us into your soul world now."
Zhang Fei [5] enveloped Yin Yue, Yin Ling, and the Moon Flame with his aura before sending them into his soul world.
Jia Xianzu and Beiming Youhuang suddenly spoke to Zhang Fei [5]. "Send us to your soul world; we might be able to do something about it."

Since Jia Xianzu and Beiming Youhuang were fairies, and they had a close relationship with nature, like other natural races, Zhang Fei [5] fulfilled their request by sending both of them to his soul world.
Zhang Fei [5] looked at the spectral beasts that had become docile. ’What do you think if I send them to my soul world as well, Mei?’
[Master, I don’t recommend that because the evil soul of the nine-tailed fox is also there, and he will become stronger if he absorbs them, which will be a big problem for you.]

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding before bringing Jian Kuang and Zhuxian Sheng back to the Moonlite Passion Sect, and he asked them to train the disciples again. Thereafter, he entered his soul world, as he was curious about what Jia Xianzu and Beiming Youhuang were planning for it.

Zhang Fei and Nalan Wangzi had moved deeper into the Blood Forest, and they had almost reached the heart of the forest. They didn’t enter the area and looked at the colossal tree that towered in the middle.

The Blood Tree King is the overlord of the Blood Forest, a colossal existence that has stood since the first battles of the Asura Demon Race. Legends say it sprouted from the lifeblood of the first Asura Demon God, watered by the blood of millions who perished in the earliest wars.

Its trunk is wider than the city walls, its crown covers the crimson sky, and its roots stretch deep into the veins of the earth, drinking the blood in the underground river of pure blood essence that connects to the Blood Sea. Its bark is like a living shield of hardened blood crystals, and each leaf drips with the thick blood essence.

Unlike ordinary blood creatures, the Blood Tree King is no mere beast but a demonic entity with will and consciousness. It rules the entire Blood Forest as its domain, and all the creatures within the forest are under its command. In its presence, the line between life and death disappears—fallen warriors are absorbed into its roots, their bodies transformed into nutrients, their blood essence woven into new shoots.
Zhang Fei held his breath after Mei displayed the Blood Tree King’s status, and Nalan Wangzi hugged his arm tightly, as its presence terrified her.
"Who dares invade my forest?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1268: Run Away
paragraphs: ’We should leave.’ Nalan Wangzi spoke through voice transmission.

Zhang Fei agreed with Nalan Wangzi and wanted to take her away, but countless tree roots quickly emerged from the ground and trapped the two of them. They looked up at the Blood Tree King, who looked down at them.
’Crap!’ Nalan Wangzi inwardly cursed.

Unlike her, Zhang Fei still relaxed under the pressure of the Blood Tree King. He used tree control and plant manipulation, which he mimicked from Janette and Lillea long ago, to remove those tree roots.

Zhang Fei then took Nalan Wangzi to teleport away from the Blood Tree King, but it shot many sharp tree branches toward them. He used forest manipulation, and the tree under them grew tall, blocking its attacks.
*Roar*
The Blood Tree King released a furious roar because its attacks failed to hit them. It summoned those powerful bloodthirsty demon beasts to hunt the two, and some of them immediately flew after them.
The Blood Tree King also tried to block them from escaping, but Zhang Fei’s three abilities prevented it from attacking them, causing it to become even more furious.
"Why didn’t you use those abilities from the start, brother-in-law?" Nalan Wangzi asked in an annoyed tone.

Zhang Fei kept teleporting to avoid the pursuit of those powerful bloodthirsty demon beasts. "If I had used them from the start, the Blood Tree King would have noticed us, and it would have attacked us long ago."
Nalan Wangzi nodded slightly. "How did you come to possess the abilities of the Dryad Race?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei looked back and saw the Blood Tree King already far behind them. "I have a special ability to mimic other demons’ abilities, and I mimicked them from three different Dryads because they are useful for diversion and alchemy.
Several flying bloodthirsty demon beasts suddenly blocked the path ahead of them, shocking Zhang Fei.
’The speed of these flying beasts is quite fast so they can keep up with my teleportation ability.’ Zhang Fei opened his palm and threw his eternal flame at them.

Those flying bloodthirsty demon beasts tried to counterattack Zhang Fei with their blood abilities, but their attacks evaporated upon contact with his eternal flame, and they hurriedly flew away as soon as the flame nearly touched their bodies.

Zhang Fei used his golden crow flame, shaped it into a jagged disc, and threw it at them. Despite their superior strength, those flying bloodthirsty demon beasts panicked seeing his attack, and they flew faster than before.

Zhang Fei smirked slightly and controlled his flame with his aura, allowing it to chase after the beasts. He summoned the demon extermination sword, channeled his flame element into it, and slashed it toward them. "Last move: Ashen Bloom!"
*Swoosh*

A flurry of petals made of sword intent bloomed from nothing, and it hurtled towards those flying bloodthirsty demon beasts while destroying everything in its path, including tree branches controlled by the Blood Tree King from a distance.
Once again, Zhang Fei slashed his sword, but he slashed it behind them, specifically towards the Blood Tree King’s location. "Last move: Sever the Heavenly Path!"
*Swoosh*

A giant golden sword shot out from Zhang Fei’s sword and hurtled towards the Blood Tree King. Unfortunately, the difference in their strength was simply too great, and it shattered his attack directly.
Zhang Fei had already predicted that the Blood Tree King could easily destroy his attack, but he didn’t think too much about it, and he used the nine cloud steps directly.
*Roar*

The Blood Tree King released a furious roar once again after Zhang Fei and Nalan Wangzi disappeared from its sight, but it immediately ordered all the plants and bloodthirsty demon beasts to search for their whereabouts.
Up in the sky, Shang Zhui’s gaze focused on Zhang Fei, who had already brought Nalan Wangzi to the outer perimeter of the Blood Forest.

"His second flame is obviously the golden crow flame, but I can’t recognize his first flame. How did he obtain both flames? Unfortunately, his first flame was only a fragment, not the complete one like his golden crow flame, so he couldn’t use its power to its full potential. If he had the complete one, he could destroy this forest in the blink of an eye, and the Blood Tree King would also die in his hands." Shang Zhui then turned his gaze to the heart of the Blood Forest, and he could see that the colossal tree was fully enraged. "What does that kid really want in this forest? Why does he have to challenge that old tree?"
Shang Zhui released a soft sigh before flying away, catching up with Zhang Fei and Nalan Wangzi.
Zhang Fei and Nalan Wangzi had just left the Blood Forest, but Shang Zhui appeared before them and took the two of them away with him.

Soon, they arrived at Shang Zhui’s private quarters, and he questioned Zhang Fei directly. "What are you really looking for in the Blood Forest? Do you know that you made a huge mistake by enraging the Blood King Tree?"

"Aren’t you mistaken about that, senior?" Zhang Fei turned the question around. "You’ve been observing us since we entered the forest, so you should have noticed that we had no intention of disturbing the Blood Tree King. However, it attacked us first, prompting me to retaliate in order to escape. Besides, I wasn’t looking for anything in the forest, and I just wanted to train there. Since the beasts in the area around the heart of the forest were strong, I went there to fight them, but that tree noticed our arrival and tried to trap us.

Since he had been watching them from the start, Shang Zhui had no doubt that Zhang Fei was indeed seeking training. However, he doubted that he was looking for something in the forest because he had previously mentioned the underground river, and he believed the thing he was looking for was related to it.
Nalan Wangzi immediately spoke to Shang Zhui. "Uncle Zhui, we are indeed looking for something in the forest, but it has nothing to do with your asura demon race."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei turned to Nalan Wangzi, who asked him not to worry about Shang Zhui. ’I hope you’re right, or I’ll make new enemies.’
’Trust me, okay?’ Zhang Fei nodded slightly to Nalan Wangzi.
Shang Zhui asked them. "What exactly are you looking for there? How do you know about the underground river?"

"Sorry, Uncle Zhui. I can’t tell you the details because it’s too sensitive, but I can assure you that it has nothing to do with your race, and it won’t cause any chaos in this domain." Shang Zhui furrowed his brows, but Nalan Wangzi still had no intention of telling him about the statue of the ten-tailed fox hidden beneath the heart of the Blood Forest. "Do you know a safe route to go to the underground river?"

"No." Shang Zhui shook his head in response. "If you want to go there, you have only two paths to choose from, with the first one located beneath the Blood Tree King. As for the second one, you have to dive into the Blood River, and you will find a small cave that connects the two places. However, that place is filled with powerful wandering evil souls, and both of you will die if you rashly enter it."

Zhang Fei already knew about it, but he was still considering taking the second path because the Blood Tree King was furious with him, so it was impossible for him to take the first path. "Can the Slaughter Blood Phantom take me there, senior?"

"Hmm?" Shang Zhui frowned at Zhang Fei, but he then nodded to him. "Since the Slaughter Blood Phantom likes you, I think you can try asking its help to take you there, and those wandering evil souls shouldn’t dare attack you if it’s with you."
Nalan Wangzi then asked Zhang Fei, "Do you want to try going there via the second route now?"

"No." Zhang Fei shook his head slightly. "Tian Shuixiang is still in there, and the Slaughter Blood Phantom is still assisting her, so it won’t be able to help me. Therefore, I’ll wait until they’re done, and then I’ll try to get it to take me there."
"What exactly is my son doing in there?" Shang Zhui asked.
Zhang Fei first examined the room. "Can anyone hear us here?"
"No." Shang Zhui shook his head slightly. "Not even Shang Zhanluo or Shang Luohu can eavesdrop on us, so you don’t need to worry about them."

"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding before telling Shang Zhui about the Asura Demon Bloodline Crystal Essence, which shocked him. "At first, I wanted to obtain that crystal, but the Slaughter Blood Phantom refused my request. Instead, I persuaded that phantom to give it to Tian Shuixiang, and he is in the process of absorbing it now. Honestly, I don’t know whose bloodline in the crystal essence it belongs to, but I’m sure your son will become truly powerful in the future, and he will probably be able to surpass Shang Zhanlui."

Shang Zhui fell into deep thought for a long time after hearing all that. "If your words are true, that bloodline should belong to the first Asura Demon God. If that’s true, my son will not only surpass Shang Zhanluo, but he might even reach the Primordial Demon Rank in the future, which no one has ever achieved before."

chapters.title: Chapter 1269: Soul-Devouring Domain
paragraphs: After speaking with Shang Zhui, Zhang Fei immediately left the place, accompanied by Nalan Wangzi, who then asked him. "Where are we going now? We can’t fight the Blood Tree King, and you also have to wait for the Slaughter Blood Phantom to finish helping Tian Shuixiang before you can go to the underground river."
"We’ll go to another domain for now, and we’ll return here once Tian Shuixiang finishes."
"Where?"

"The Sky Pillar Domain." Nalan Wangzi turned to Zhang Fei with surprise. "Qing Qiu’er and the others said that this domain is the most advanced in this realm, and I need some items to create those teleportation devices, so we’ll go there to have a look."

Nalan Wangzi nodded slightly. "Since you want to go to that domain, I can’t accompany you because they have demon detectors. My disguise artifact can’t help me disguise my identity, so they’ll notice my presence the moment I set foot in that domain. Therefore, you must send me back, and I will lend my artifact to Gong Ren and the others."
"We should leave this domain first, and I’ll send you back afterward." Zhang Fei hugged Nalan Wangzi’s waist, but she suddenly stopped him. "What’s wrong?"
Nalan Wangzi let out a soft sigh. "My mother just sent me a voice transmission, and Mo Taizi is waiting for me in our domain, so I have to go home."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei frowned at that. "I’m curious what Mo Taizi wants from you, so I’ll accompany you."
"Haha." Nalan Wangzi softly laughed. "You are such a possessive and overprotective man, did you know that?"
Zhang Fei shrugged in response. "All my women are important to me, and I will never allow any man to approach any of you. Mo Taizi may be your fiancé, but I am your true man."
"I haven’t agreed to be your woman, remember?"

"Do you think I care whether you agree or not?" Zhang Fei’s response stunned Nalan Wangzi. "If I say that you are my woman, then you are. Furthermore, I have seen every inch of your body, so you are my woman."
"Hahaha!" Nalan Wangzi laughed out loud, lightly punching Zhang Fei’s chest. "You are such a shameless lust demon!"

Zhang Fei hugged Nalan Wangzi’s waist and took her away from the Slaughter Blood Domain directly. Since the Soul-Devouring Domain was located in the same main domain, they didn’t need to go to the border, and he took her there directly.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Soul-Devouring Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]

The Soul-Devouring Domain is a place of horror and reverence, a land where every step is shadowed by the cries of the dead. Endless soul fog blackens the skies, and fractured bones from forgotten eras cover the ground. Unlike the Slaughter Blood Domain, which thrives on flesh and blood, the Soul-Devouring Domain feeds on the spirits of the dead, turning resentment, fear, and hatred into its lifeblood.

In this domain, every breath carries the whispers of lost souls. Ghostly wails sweep across the land, and shadows twist unnaturally as if alive. This land is filled with Soul Abysses—bottomless chasms where countless spirits swirl like stormy tides, drawn to eternal torment. Within these abysses dwell Soul-Devouring Ghosts, born of pent-up resentment, capable of tearing a soul apart with a single scream.
This domain is tainted, shrouded by drifting soul clouds, which constantly rain blackened flames. These flames do not burn flesh but burn the soul, leaving nothing but an empty husk.
"Aren’t you going to transform yourself into one of my race?" Nalan Wangzi, who had already removed her disguise, asked.
Zhang Fei looked at her. "There’s no need for that, right? Will your demon race be hostile to me?"

"No." Nalan Wangzi shook her head. "However, Mo Taizi is a different story, and my race has never had any contact with lust demons. If he saw you now, he would be suspicious of us, and he would report us to Mo Shentian."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and transformed himself into a member of the soul-devouring demon race. However, he did not transform himself into a male one but a female one, making Nalan Wangzi laugh out loud.

"Hahaha!" Nalan Wangzi laughed while clutching her stomach. "You are ridiculous, brother-in-law! Why did you turn into a female demon? However, you’re prettier than other female demons, and the male demons will definitely be crazy about you."
Zhang Fei just shook his head. "So, where do you live?"

"Over there." Nalan Wangzi pointed toward the center of the domain. "We live within the Soul Abyss, and that area is filled with wandering souls that protect us, so there aren’t many demons from other races who dare to disturb us."
"Alright! Let’s go now!" Zhang Fei activated his soul domain before bringing Nalan Wangzi to the center of that domain.

Unlike the Asura Demon God, who resides in a palace, the Soul-Devouring Demon God resides within an abyss, surrounded by walls formed from the souls of the living creatures who died in the domain, making the area utterly terrifying due to their wailing.
Nalan Wangzi immediately took Zhang Fei to the only huge black mansion in the middle of the abyss, with many souls flying around it.
The guards at the entrance appeared confused upon seeing Zhang Fei, as they couldn’t recognize him; however, they remained silent because he came together with Nalan Wangzi.

When they arrived inside the mansion, Zhang Fei saw Nalan Shizhe sitting on a large chair that was almost like a throne. Since Nalan Wangzi had already informed her about him, she was not confused when she saw him, but she felt that he was too reckless because Mo Taizi was present there. ’This kid! Why did he insist on coming here? Isn’t he afraid that Taizi will see through his disguise?’

However, Zhang Fei looked relaxed as he walked to an empty chair before sitting down, his gaze focused solely on Mo Taizi. As usual, Mei immediately informed him of the male demon’s strength, causing him to momentarily raise an eyebrow. ’3-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm, huh? He is the second prince of the Celestial Demon Race, but he is already that strong, so the first prince should be even stronger.’
Mo Taizi looked calm as he observed him, but Zhang Fei’s disguise was simply too perfect, preventing him from knowing his true identity.
In Mo Taizi’s eyes, Zhang Fei was no different from other female demons, and he did not show the slightest interest in him even though he was disguised as a female demon.
"Why did you suddenly come here without contacting me first, Taizi?" Nalan Wangzi asked while sitting next to Zhang Fei.

Mo Taizi immediately explained to Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Shizhe the reason for his sudden arrival, causing not only the two women but also Zhang Fei to frown. "Wangzi, you surely know that I don’t want to do this, right? However, I cannot disobey my father’s order, and he demands that we both marry once he returns from the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain. Therefore, I hope you are willing to accept this decision and prepare for our marriage; otherwise, you and your demon race will suffer from his wrath."

"What exactly is Mo Shentian doing in the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain? Why did he suddenly decide to go there?" Nalan Shizhe naturally already knew the Celestial Demon God’s reason for going to the domain, as Zhang Fei had already informed those close to him about Mo Taizi’s meeting with Xie Heilong and Xie Zhi in the Endless Night Dungeon some time ago.

Mo Taizi shook his head at her. "Aunt Shizhe, you should already understand my father’s character, right? He never discussed his plans in detail with me or my brothers, so we don’t know why he decided to go to that domain."
’What a liar!’
Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Shizhe were startled when Zhang Fei suddenly spoke up, asking them to prepare something. Although the two women were confused by his request, they still agreed with his idea.
Nalan Shizhe then questioned Mo Taizi. "When will your father return to your domain?"

"I can’t say for sure, Aunt Shizhe." Mo Taizi replied with a shake of his head. "My father could return at any time, and he wants to see that Wangzi and my wedding preparations are ready by then. Therefore, I hope you two can prepare everything starting today, and we will hold our wedding as soon as we return."
"Do you really want this, Taizi?" Nalan Wangzi asked.

Mo Taizi released a sigh before answering her. "Wangzi, I understand your feelings, but I cannot disobey my father. Even after we get married, I will never touch you as long as you don’t want it, so I hope you are willing to understand my decision."

"Alright, we will start preparing for our wedding, but we can’t prepare it in a hurry." Mo Taizi was relieved by Nalan Wangzi’s answer. "I want our wedding to be the best, so we need to make the best preparations. However, we don’t know when your father will return, so you can ask him about it first."

"I’ll try contacting my father later, and I’ll inform you both as soon as I get an answer." Mo Taizi then stood up. "Since you two have agreed, I will return to my domain now, and I will make all the necessary preparations according to the traditions of my race."

Therefore, I hope you are willing to accept this decision and prepare for our marriage; otherwise, you and your demon race will suffer from his wrath."
"What exactly is Mo Shentian doing in the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain?

Why did he suddenly decide to go there?" Nalan Shizhe naturally already knew the Celestial Demon God’s reason for going to the domain, as Zhang Fei had already informed those close to him about Mo Taizi’s meeting with Xie Heilong and Xie Zhi in the Endless Night Dungeon some time ago.
Mo Taizi shook his head at her.
"Aunt Shizhe, you should already understand my father’s character, right?
He never discussed his plans in detail with me or my brothers, so we don’t know why he decided to go to that domain."
’What a liar!’
Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Shizhe were startled when Zhang Fei suddenly spoke up, asking them to prepare something.
Although the two women were confused by his request, they still agreed with his idea.
Nalan Shizhe then questioned Mo Taizi.
"When will your father return to your domain?"
"I can’t say for sure, Aunt Shizhe." Mo Taizi replied with a shake of his head.
"My father could return at any time, and he wants to see that Wangzi and my wedding preparations are ready by then.
Therefore, I hope you two can prepare everything starting today, and we will hold our wedding as soon as we return."
"Do you really want this, Taizi?" Nalan Wangzi asked.
Mo Taizi released a sigh before answering her.
"Wangzi, I understand your feelings, but I cannot disobey my father.
Even after we get married, I will never touch you as long as you don’t want it, so I hope you are willing to understand my decision."
"Alright, we will start preparing for our wedding, but we can’t prepare it in a hurry." Mo Taizi was relieved by Nalan Wangzi’s answer.
"I want our wedding to be the best, so we need to make the best preparations.
However, we don’t know when your father will return, so you can ask him about it first."
"I’ll try contacting my father later, and I’ll inform you both as soon as I get an answer." Mo Taizi then stood up.
"Since you two have agreed, I will return to my domain now, and I will make all the necessary preparations according to the traditions of my race."

chapters.title: Chapter 1270: Wailing Soul Forest
paragraphs: "So, what’s your plan to solve this problem?"

Zhang Fei informed Nalan Shizhe and Nalan Wangzi about his plans for the Celestial Demon Race, which caused both of them to stare at him in shock. "Please summon a male demon with a cultivation level equivalent to hers."
"Are you—"

Zhang Fei nodded to Nalan Wangzi. "As long as we use a member of your demon race, I am confident that Mo Shentian will not notice, since all of you have very similar auras, with the exception of my mother-in-law. To make the disguise more perfect, I will implant most of your memories in him to avoid their suspicions."
"How do you do that? As far as I remember, a lust demon can’t manipulate other people’s memories." Nalan Shizhe spoke skeptically.
"Haha." Zhang Fei softly laughed. "Mother-in-law, have you ever met someone with three identities like me?"
"Never." Nalan Shizhe contacted a member of their race. "He’ll be here soon."
Soon, a male soul-devouring demon came to them, and Mei informed Zhang Fei that his strength and aura were indeed similar to Nalan Wangzi.
"Qinghe, I need you to help us with something." Nalan Qinghe seriously listened to Nalan Shizhe’s explanation before turning to Zhang Fei in shock. "Are you willing to accept this task?"
"I will accept the task, Demon God."
"Good!" Nalan Shizhe moved in front of Nalan Qinghe and sealed his cultivation so Zhang Fei could carry out his plans. "You can do it now."
"Alright." Zhang Fei stood in front of Nalan Qinghe, touched his chest, and used his body modification ability on him.
Nalan Qinghe experienced excruciating pain as his body began to undergo transformation, but he didn’t comment or complain about it, and he endured the pain until he transformed into Nalan Wangzi.

Nalan Shizhe observed Nalan Qinghe, and she nodded in satisfaction because his appearance and aura completely matched her first daughter’s, reassuring her that Mo Shentian and the people of the Celestial Demon Race would never know that he was actually a male demon.
"Wangzi, stand by his side, and I’ll copy your memories before implanting them in him." Nalan Shizhe sighed inwardly, knowing that her first daughter had also fallen for Zhang Fei.

Nalan Wangzi walked to Nalan Qinghe’s side, but Nalan Huanzi suddenly walked in. "Huh? How can you split into two people, sister? Who is this female demon? Why have I never seen her before in our race?"
"I didn’t split in two." Nalan Wangzi pointed at Nalan Qinghe. "He is Qinghe, and Zhang Fei transformed him into me."

Nalan Wangzi’s answer made Nalan Huanzi stunned for a moment before looking at Zhang Fei, who immediately returned to his transcendent lust demon form. "You are a cheater, brother-in-law. Your ability to transform into other demon races is impressive, making it difficult for me to recognize you. So, what happened here? Why did you transform Qinghe into my sister?"

"Mo Taizi came here earlier, and he forced your sister to marry him." Mo Huanzi furrowed his brows in response to Nalan Shizhe. "Mo Shentian is getting more and more impatient, and he asked Taizi to force us to hand her over to him."
Nalan Huanzi nodded slightly. "So, you’re going to use Qinghe as a substitute for my sister? Won’t Mo Shentian and the others notice his disguise?"

"Don’t worry, no one will recognize him." Zhang Fei grabbed the heads of Nalan Qinghe and Nalan Wangzi before using his memory manipulation to copy his sister-in-law’s memories into the male demon’s mind, but he didn’t copy everything, especially her memories regarding his training space and the people around him.
Nalan Shizhe and Nalan Huanzi did not say anything, waiting for Zhang Fei to complete his plans for Nalan Qinghe and Nalan Wangzi.

A while later, Zhang Fei had copied Nalan Wangzi’s memories and implanted them into Nalan Qinghe’s mind. However, he had another idea, and he used his other demon abilities to implant something into the male demon’s body. "It’s done."
"Hmm?" Nalan Shizhe and Nalan Huanzi watched Nalan Qinghe for a while before asking him many questions, especially regarding Nalan Wangzi.

Nalan Qinghe immediately answered their questions according to Nalan Wangzi’s memories, which convinced Nalan Shizhe and Nalan Huanzi that Mo Shentian wouldn’t notice his disguise. "Leave first, Qinghe. I’ll summon you when Mo Taizi comes here again, and you’ll take my daughter’s place then."
"Yes, Demon God."
After Nalan Qinghe left, Nalan Shizhe immediately asked Zhang Fei. "Did you do something to Qi Qingxiu? The last time I met her, she seemed angry when she talked about you."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed while rubbing his nose. "I already used my dream abilities on Qi Qingxiu when I brought her to the Starry Sky Realm, and we spent quite a lot of time there together."

After Zhang Fei said that, Nalan Shizhe, Nalan Wangzi, and Nalan Huanzi stared at him with incredulous looks. Unlike him, the three of them were familiar with Qi Qingxiu’s character and abilities, including her ability to control the seven emotions that made Mo Shentian and Shang Zhanluo fear her.

Zhang Fei shrugged his shoulders. "Naturally, I used my dream abilities when Qi Qingxiu wasn’t aware of it; otherwise, she would have killed me. Her strength and ability to control the seven emotions are indeed terrifying, but I no longer need to fear her because I can send her subconsciously into a dream whenever I want, so she will never be able to attack me."

"Hahaha!" Nalan Wangzi laughed out loud after hearing that. "You are truly a shameless and bold lust demon, brother-in-law! There have never been any male demons who dared to do such a thing to Qi Qingxiu in the past, and all of them immediately fled as soon as she showed her anger."

Nalan Shizhe nodded in agreement with her first daughter before speaking. "Even Qiongqi didn’t dare to force Qi Qingxiu, even though he had been infatuated with her for a long time. In fact, she beat that evil beast to a pulp in the past, and he didn’t dare come to her again since then. If he knew you had done something to her, he would definitely come to you to attack you."

"Sooner or later I will face the four perils, especially Taotie. Therefore, I have no problem if Qiongqi comes to me, but I’m sure he won’t do so anytime soon, especially since no one will ever know that I’ve used my abilities on Qi Qingxiu." Zhang Fei then opened the portal to the training space, and Nalan Yushu hurriedly walked out of it.
"Mother!" Nalan Yushu immediately hugged Nalan Shizhe, making her smile. "Hehehe! I miss you, mother."
"I miss you too, Yushu." Nalan Shizhe hugged her second daughter back. "Since you’re here, you should stay here for a few days to accompany me, okay?"

Nalan Yushu nodded slightly before releasing Nalan Shizhe from her embrace. "It’s been a long time since I returned to our domain, so I’ll stay here for a few days, and I want to cultivate in the Wailing Soul Forest."
"What is the Wailing Soul Forest?" Zhang Fei asked.

Nalan Shizhe immediately explained the details of the Wailing Soul Forest to Zhang Fei. "The most precious item in that place is the Phantom Soul Lotus, and it will strengthen our souls if we consume it. However, the lotus is filled with hatred and resentment from those evil souls, which will affect us if we don’t cleanse them first. Unlike other races, we don’t need to cleanse them, and we can devour them directly. The rarest is the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus, which blooms once every thousand years."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei’s eyes lit up upon hearing that. "Is the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus available now?"

Nalan Shizhe shook her head at Zhang Fei. "I don’t know if it’s available now, and we should go there to check first. Even if it is available, you won’t be able to pick it directly, especially since a Soul Wraith Lord always guards it. Therefore, you have to defeat it first to be able to pick the lotus, and its strength is equivalent to the Blood Tree King in the Blood Forest of the Slaughter Blood Domain."

"Sigh." Zhang Fei released a heavy sigh after hearing that. "Wangzi and I had previously visited the Blood Forest, and that Blood Tree King attacked us. Luckily, it couldn’t move on its own, so we were able to escape from it."

"Hmm?" Nalan Shizhe frowned after hearing that, and she turned to Nalan Wangzi, who immediately explained the situation. "You both were reckless for challenging the Blood Tree King, and you were fortunate to escape from it. Unlike that tree, the Soul Wraith Lord can move freely, and it can summon all the souls within this domain, so you should reconsider seeking the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus."
"Can you help my husband to get the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus, mother?" Nalan Yushu asked.

"I can’t be sure because the Soul Wraith Lord was born at the same time as the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus, and their powers differ each time they appear, so we’ll have to go check out the Wailing Soul Forest first to be certain." Nalan Shizhe then led them out of her mansion. "Let’s go there now, and we will check whether the lotus is available or not."
After they exited the Soul Abyss, Zhang Fei immediately enveloped them with his aura and brought them to the Wailing Soul Forest using his nine cloud steps.

chapters.title: Chapter 1271: Enter The Forest
paragraphs: The Wailing Soul Forest lies in the northernmost part of the Soul-Devouring Domain, a land where death itself dwells. The trees are born not from soil and water, but from the essence of souls and resentment; their bark is as black as charred bones, and their branches are wrapped in translucent, ghostly veils that sway without wind. From afar, the forest seems alive with a faint glow; they are not fireflies but wandering souls, forever bound to the trees that imprison them.

This forest’s name comes from the endless wails of wandering souls that drift through the shadows. Every tree trunk hums mournful cries, every leaf trembles with spectral screams, and every gust of wind carries the wails of thousands of souls. The sound doesn’t echo in the ears; it directly pierces through the mind, which drags intruders into an endless despair that devours their souls.

According to the legend, once every thousand years, the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus blooms in the heart of the forest, a flower formed from the endless resentment of wandering souls. However, a powerful being is always born alongside its bloom, which serves as its guardian.

The Soul Wraith Lord is the sovereign of the Wailing Soul Forest, and it commands endless Soul Wraiths that roam the forest. However, its appearance never lasted long, and it disappeared again as the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus withered in seven days, waiting for it to bloom.

Zhang Fei and the other three arrived in front of the Wailing Soul Forest, where he discovered hundreds of thousands, or even millions, of red dots on the map. The map showed countless red dots not only in the forest but also throughout the entire area of the Soul-Devouring Domain. "This forest is much scarier than the Blood Forest! That forest is filled with bloodthirsty demon beasts, but this forest is filled with wandering souls, all of which are evil."

"Hahaha." Nalan Wangzi laughed at that. "Now you understand why our ancestors chose this domain, right? These evil wandering souls are indeed frightening for others, but they are the nutrients and guardians of our soul-devouring race, and we have lived side by side ever since."

Zhang Fei nodded to Nalan Wangzi. "As I told you before, I once absorbed countless of them in the Nine Hells Darkland Realm to increase my soul power, so these wandering evil souls are also nutrients for me. However, the wandering evil souls in that realm are not as strong as those in this forest. Since I’m not a soul-devouring demon like you guys, I doubt if I can absorb too many of them."
"What did you feel when you absorbed those wandering demon souls back then?" Nalan Shizhe asked him.

"Hatred, grudge, malice, and various other negative emotions." Zhang Fei opened his palm and summoned the Soul Flame, which shocked Nalan Shizhe, Nalan Wangzi, and Nalan Huanzi. "I obtained this flame in that domain, and it was guarded by the wandering soul demon who was born from the collection of countless wandering evil souls. Fortunately, I possessed the light element from my heavenly fox bloodline, and some people helped me to purify those souls; otherwise, those negative emotions would have already taken over me, and I would never have reached this realm."

"Unfortunately, your people are still too weak, so you can’t bring them into this domain to help you. If you want to absorb these wandering souls, you’ll have to use your abilities to do so." Zhang Fei smiled at Nalan Shizhe, who then observed the Soul Flame. "As I recall, this flame should be one of the ten heavenly flames, right?"

"You’re right, mother-in-law." Zhang Fei then summoned his other six heavenly flames, shocking Nalan Shizhe further. "Phoenix flame, dragon flame, soul flame, sky flame, earth flame, blood flame, and the eternal flame. I need the other three to perfect my fire technique, and I’ve found the moon flame, but I haven’t been able to get it. The sun flame should be in the Zenith Sun Sanctum, but the dungeon won’t open until another thousand years. As for the chaotic flame, I still don’t have any information about its whereabouts."
"How did you manage to collect them, brother-in-law? Where did you find the eternal flame?" Nalan Huanzi asked in a perplexed manner as he stared at the eternal flame.

"As a heavenly fox, I can move between realms easily, but I must have been to my destination to do so." Zhang Fei removed all the flames and opened a gate to the Starry Sky Realm, and Nalan Shizhe directly entered it after he realized that it connected them to the Three Mortal Realms.

Nalan Huanzi immediately followed his mother, causing Nalan Yushu and Nalan Wangzi to shake their heads. However, the two immediately returned to their side a few minutes later, and Nalan Shizhe asked Zhang Fei. "Did you send Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu to that realm?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei closed the gate instantly. "If you didn’t find them there, they must have gone elsewhere to search for Wu Mian’s true body. However, I doubt he hid his true body there, as it would only hinder his cultivation, and I suspect he hid it in one of the domains in this realm."

Nalan Shizhe nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei. "However, we’ve been searching for Wu Mian’s true body throughout all the demon domains for so many years, but our efforts have never yielded any results. That’s why Ye Mingran suspects he’s hiding his true body in the Three Mortal Realms."

"If that’s the case, let them try looking for it there. However, there are simply too many demon realms there, so they have to visit and check them one by one, which will waste a lot of time, especially due to the large difference in time flow." Zhang Fei then summoned the demon extermination sword, which immediately vibrated in excitement after feeling the presence of those wandering evil souls.
Nalan Huanzi took several steps back as he stared at the demon extermination sword. "What kind of sword is that? Why does it give me a dreadful feeling?"
"A sword created specifically to kill demons." Nalan Shizhe muttered under her breath.

"That’s right." Zhang Fei released the demon extermination sword, and the sword immediately flew into the sky, chasing the wandering evil souls above them before absorbing them. "The blacksmith created my sword to kill Xereth, as he had slaughtered his family and the people of the Starry Sky Realm. I wanted to kill that demon, but he was Taotie’s subordinate, so I didn’t kill him and imprisoned him in the Star Tower."

Nalan Shizhe released a soft sigh. "Sooner or later, Taotie will notice that his subordinate is missing, but fortunately, he cannot descend to the Three Mortal Realms because Long Wuzhao and those people will move to stop him."
"I know that." Zhang Fei asked the demon extermination sword to return to him. "Where does the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus usually bloom, mother-in-law?"

"It usually blooms in the heart of this forest, but the location is quite deep. We can’t fly in it because of the many natural traps, so we have to go there on foot." Nalan Shizhe then led them into the Wailing Soul Forest. "Do you want to fight and absorb these wandering evil souls?"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei thought about it first, as the system couldn’t detect the strength of those wandering souls. Instead, he activated his soul domain before capturing the soul closest to them.
"Mother, he—"
"You don’t need to worry, big brother." Nalan Yushu immediately stopped Nalan Huanzi. "Try to pay attention to my husband first."

Nalan Huanzi nodded slightly and observed his brother-in-law, but he was surprised when Zhang Fei used his light domain, which helped him purify the wandering soul before it was absorbed by him. "That’s fast!"

"Hehe." Nalan Yushu giggled at her big brother’s reactions. "My husband’s light element has long reached the peak stage, and his mastery of the light elemental law has also reached the perfection stage; therefore, you shouldn’t be surprised that he could purify that wandering soul so quickly."

After absorbing it, Zhang Fei moved again to capture another wandering evil soul. He captured not just one, but ten, and he immediately used his light domain to purify them before absorbing them. ’Mei, do you think I can reach the immortal soul level if I absorb all the wandering evil souls in this domain?’

[Master, I don’t have any information about the immortal soul level, but I can guarantee that your soul level will instantly break through to the perfection stage of the divine soul level if you absorb all the wandering evil souls in this forest.]
Zhang Fei choked when he heard that because the wandering evil souls in the Wailing Soul Forest were simply too numerous, and their strength grew higher the deeper he moved.
After he absorbed the ten, Zhang Fei turned to the others. "Let’s move faster, and I will absorb these wandering evil souls while we walk inside."

Nalan Shizhe and her three children immediately followed Zhang Fei, while Nalan Yushu mimicked her husband’s actions by devouring the wandering evil souls. After all, she had been dead for a long time, and she hadn’t come back alive for a very long time, so she was eager to devour them.
Nalan Shizhe, Nalan Wangzi, and Nalan Huanzi did not follow their actions, and they protected the two by driving away powerful wandering souls who tried to approach and attack them.

However, its appearance never lasted long, and it disappeared again as the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus withered in seven days, waiting for it to bloom.
Zhang Fei and the other three arrived in front of the Wailing Soul Forest, where he discovered hundreds of thousands, or even millions, of red dots on the map.
The map showed countless red dots not only in the forest but also throughout the entire area of the Soul-Devouring Domain.
"This forest is much scarier than the Blood Forest!
That forest is filled with bloodthirsty demon beasts, but this forest is filled with wandering souls, all of which are evil."
"Hahaha." Nalan Wangzi laughed at that.
"Now you understand why our ancestors chose this domain, right?
These evil wandering souls are indeed frightening for others, but they are the nutrients and guardians of our soul-devouring race, and we have lived side by side ever since."
Zhang Fei nodded to Nalan Wangzi.
"As I told you before, I once absorbed countless of them in the Nine Hells Darkland Realm to increase my soul power, so these wandering evil souls are also nutrients for me.
However, the wandering evil souls in that realm are not as strong as those in this forest.
Since I’m not a soul-devouring demon like you guys, I doubt if I can absorb too many of them."
"What did you feel when you absorbed those wandering demon souls back then?" Nalan Shizhe asked him.
"Hatred, grudge, malice, and various other negative emotions." Zhang Fei opened his palm and summoned the Soul Flame, which shocked Nalan Shizhe, Nalan Wangzi, and Nalan Huanzi.
"I obtained this flame in that domain, and it was guarded by the wandering soul demon who was born from the collection of countless wandering evil souls.

Fortunately, I possessed the light element from my heavenly fox bloodline, and some people helped me to purify those souls; otherwise, those negative emotions would have already taken over me, and I would never have reached this realm."
"Unfortunately, your people are still too weak, so you can’t bring them into this domain to help you.
If you want to absorb these wandering souls, you’ll have to use your abilities to do so." Zhang Fei smiled at Nalan Shizhe, who then observed the Soul Flame.
"As I recall, this flame should be one of the ten heavenly flames, right?"
"You’re right, mother-in-law." Zhang Fei then summoned his other six heavenly flames, shocking Nalan Shizhe further.
"Phoenix flame, dragon flame, soul flame, sky flame, earth flame, blood flame, and the eternal flame.
I need the other three to perfect my fire technique, and I’ve found the moon flame, but I haven’t been able to get it.
The sun flame should be in the Zenith Sun Sanctum, but the dungeon won’t open until another thousand years.
As for the chaotic flame, I still don’t have any information about its whereabouts."
"How did you manage to collect them, brother-in-law?
Where did you find the eternal flame?" Nalan Huanzi asked in a perplexed manner as he stared at the eternal flame.

"As a heavenly fox, I can move between realms easily, but I must have been to my destination to do so." Zhang Fei removed all the flames and opened a gate to the Starry Sky Realm, and Nalan Shizhe directly entered it after he realized that it connected them to the Three Mortal Realms.
Nalan Huanzi immediately followed his mother, causing Nalan Yushu and Nalan Wangzi to shake their heads.
However, the two immediately returned to their side a few minutes later, and Nalan Shizhe asked Zhang Fei.
"Did you send Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu to that realm?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei closed the gate instantly.
"If you didn’t find them there, they must have gone elsewhere to search for Wu Mian’s true body.
However, I doubt he hid his true body there, as it would only hinder his cultivation, and I suspect he hid it in one of the domains in this realm."
Nalan Shizhe nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei.
"However, we’ve been searching for Wu Mian’s true body throughout all the demon domains for so many years, but our efforts have never yielded any results.
That’s why Ye Mingran suspects he’s hiding his true body in the Three Mortal Realms."
"If that’s the case, let them try looking for it there.

However, there are simply too many demon realms there, so they have to visit and check them one by one, which will waste a lot of time, especially due to the large difference in time flow." Zhang Fei then summoned the demon extermination sword, which immediately vibrated in excitement after feeling the presence of those wandering evil souls.
Nalan Huanzi took several steps back as he stared at the demon extermination sword.
"What kind of sword is that?
Why does it give me a dreadful feeling?"
"A sword created specifically to kill demons." Nalan Shizhe muttered under her breath.
"That’s right." Zhang Fei released the demon extermination sword, and the sword immediately flew into the sky, chasing the wandering evil souls above them before absorbing them.
"The blacksmith created my sword to kill Xereth, as he had slaughtered his family and the people of the Starry Sky Realm.
I wanted to kill that demon, but he was Taotie’s subordinate, so I didn’t kill him and imprisoned him in the Star Tower."
Nalan Shizhe released a soft sigh.
"Sooner or later, Taotie will notice that his subordinate is missing, but fortunately, he cannot descend to the Three Mortal Realms because Long Wuzhao and those people will move to stop him."
"I know that." Zhang Fei asked the demon extermination sword to return to him.
"Where does the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus usually bloom, mother-in-law?"
"It usually blooms in the heart of this forest, but the location is quite deep.
We can’t fly in it because of the many natural traps, so we have to go there on foot." Nalan Shizhe then led them into the Wailing Soul Forest.
"Do you want to fight and absorb these wandering evil souls?"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei thought about it first, as the system couldn’t detect the strength of those wandering souls.
Instead, he activated his soul domain before capturing the soul closest to them.
"Mother, he—"
"You don’t need to worry, big brother." Nalan Yushu immediately stopped Nalan Huanzi.
"Try to pay attention to my husband first."
Nalan Huanzi nodded slightly and observed his brother-in-law, but he was surprised when Zhang Fei used his light domain, which helped him purify the wandering soul before it was absorbed by him.
"That’s fast!"
"Hehe." Nalan Yushu giggled at her big brother’s reactions.

"My husband’s light element has long reached the peak stage, and his mastery of the light elemental law has also reached the perfection stage; therefore, you shouldn’t be surprised that he could purify that wandering soul so quickly."
After absorbing it, Zhang Fei moved again to capture another wandering evil soul.

He captured not just one, but ten, and he immediately used his light domain to purify them before absorbing them. ’Mei, do you think I can reach the immortal soul level if I absorb all the wandering evil souls in this domain?’

[Master, I don’t have any information about the immortal soul level, but I can guarantee that your soul level will instantly break through to the perfection stage of the divine soul level if you absorb all the wandering evil souls in this forest.]
Zhang Fei choked when he heard that because the wandering evil souls in the Wailing Soul Forest were simply too numerous, and their strength grew higher the deeper he moved.
After he absorbed the ten, Zhang Fei turned to the others.
"Let’s move faster, and I will absorb these wandering evil souls while we walk inside."
Nalan Shizhe and her three children immediately followed Zhang Fei, while Nalan Yushu mimicked her husband’s actions by devouring the wandering evil souls.
After all, she had been dead for a long time, and she hadn’t come back alive for a very long time, so she was eager to devour them.
Nalan Shizhe, Nalan Wangzi, and Nalan Huanzi did not follow their actions, and they protected the two by driving away powerful wandering souls who tried to approach and attack them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1272: Soul Pond
paragraphs: Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui stood by the Blood Sea, and they wanted to check on Tian Shuixiang at the bottom. However, they abandoned it because they didn’t want to anger the Slaughter Blood Phantom.
"Do you know where they went?"

Shang Zhui shook his head slightly. "I’ve tried asking them about their next destination, but they’ve kept quiet, and I think it has something to do with Zhang Xiaolong’s residence. He doesn’t want people to know about his true identity, so he deliberately hides everything. Are you thinking about investigating him?"

"Hmm?" Shang Luohu looked at Shang Zhui for a moment before shaking her head. "That kid’s cultivation is at the Celestial Lord Realm, but he managed to escape from the Blood Tree King, which means he is not a simple cultivator. Since my husband is currently following Mo Shentian, I am considering going to the Temptation Valley in the Endless Domain."
Shang Zhui looked shocked when he heard that. "Are you thinking about meeting Xie Yao and Xie Yan?"

"Yes." Shang Luohu replied with a nod. "I have never met a nine-tailed lust demon before, and Zhang Xiaolong’s demon form has kept me curious for the past two days. Only they can answer my curiosity, as they are demon gods of the lust demon race. Even though their fighting skills are not as good as those of my husband and the other demon gods, we cannot underestimate them."
"That’s true." Shang Zhui nodded in agreement. "I will accompany you to meet them so I can help you if Xie Yao has malicious intentions toward you."

Shang Luohu immediately flew away, followed by Shang Zhui. "We have to go now, or we will waste a lot of time. It is never simple for other demon races to find the Temptation Valley, let alone enter it."

As night fell, the Wailing Soul Forest area became darker and colder, making it difficult to see the natural traps within. Nalan Shizhe asked Zhang Fei and Nalan Yushu to stop absorbing the wandering evil souls, and she led them to an area with fewer evil souls.
"Mother, there’s a soul pond in the area ahead, right?"
"Yes." Nalan Shizhe nodded to her second daughter. "Countless souls lived in the pond, but they aren’t evil like the souls wandering in this forest, so we will rest there."
Nalan Yushu then turned to Zhang Fei. "Husband, that pond is similar to the one in the Nine Hells Darkland Realm. I think we can absorb them to strengthen our souls."
"We—"

"You two can’t absorb those souls." Nalan Yushu and Zhang Fei looked at Nalan Shizhe directly. "As I said before, those souls aren’t evil like these wandering evil souls, and they guard something at the bottom of the pond."
"What exactly are they guarding, Mother? Since we were little, you’ve always forbidden us from devouring those souls, but you’ve never told us the reasons." Nalan Wangzi asked.

"Those souls protect our ancestor’s corpse." Nalan Shizhe’s answer shocked her three children. "The souls in the pond look harmless, but they are much stronger than these wandering evil souls. In fact, they are the souls of our ancestor’s loyal followers, who gathered there to protect her corpse. Her corpse is unusual, and it is still intact even though she has been dead for millions of years. If the corpse demons of the Nine Nether Demon Race find her corpse, they could use it to control or even destroy our demon race. Thus, I never told you anything about it, and only the demon gods of our race know the truth. However, I’ve heard that their artifact was lost tens of thousands of years ago, and they still haven’t managed to find it to this day."
"You mean this artifact, right, mother-in-law?"
Nalan Shizhe looked at the small black coffin in Zhang Fei’s hand. "How did this Corpse-Refining Coffin end up in your hands? Where did you find it?"
"We found it near the Blood Sea, mother."

Nalan Shizhe looked at her first daughter in disbelief, prompting Zhang Fei to explain the truth to her. "Ma Kuangyu found this artifact by accident, and he hid it in the Slaughter Blood Domain. The people of the Nirvana Sky Main Domain knew that he found this artifact, but they didn’t know that this was the Corpse-Refining Coffin. Sheng Yaohun from the Spirit Temple ordered them to kill him and destroy his Ma Clan after declaring them heretics, but in reality, they were the heretics, and the demons from the Nine Nether Demon Race transformed them into various demons."

"Put away the artifact first and don’t let anyone know that it’s in your possession." After Zhang Fei stored it back into the system inventory, Nalan Shizhe spoke again. "Back then, the corpse demons used the coffin to transform the villagers into their kind, but they were unfortunate because the winged race caught them in the act and summoned their higher-ups to attack. As a result, the coffin disappeared for tens of thousands of years, and they thought that those winged races had destroyed it, but it turns out it’s in your hands now. Therefore, you must keep and guard it well, as it will cause many problems if it falls into the hands of those corpse demons again. Do you understand?"
"I understand." Zhang Fei then asked Nalan Shizhe about something else. "Mother-in-law, have you ever heard of the Nine Yin Soul Banner?"
"Huh?" Nalan Shizhe’s expression turned shocked upon hearing that. "Don’t tell me the Nine Yin Soul Banner is also in your hands now."

"I’ve seen the Nine Yin Soul Banner in the past, but someone snatched it from me when I wanted to take it." Nalan Shizhe furrowed her brows, and Zhang Fei told her about the matter, including the appearance of Yuan Xiajie, who snatched the banner and kidnapped Wang Yin. "That woman came from the Yuan Clan, one of the ancient clans. I wanted to find her to save my friend, but I had difficulty finding information about her hiding place. The only person who knew about her hiding place was Feng Yao, but she was unwilling to tell me because that woman was stronger than Long Wuzhao."

"Since Empress Huo has already said it like that, you should listen to her and forget about that woman for now; instead, you should focus on your cultivation to reach her level." Nalan Shizhe then continued leading them toward the soul pond. "The truth is that the Nine Yin Soul Banner once belonged to the previous Heavenly Fiend Demon God, and Tian Qiye ganged up on him along with several grand elders of the winged race. They defeated him and stole the banner from him, but he knew that they couldn’t destroy it, and he was sure they hid it somewhere. Back then, his injuries were severe, and he ordered the current Heavenly Fiend Demon God to find the Banner because it was their race’s mainstay artifact, but he never expected that they sent it to the Three Mortal Realms, and he never looked for it in there. Since it had fallen into the hands of someone from the ancient race, I was sure that he would never succeed in finding it."
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement. "Oh, I just remembered something. Where do the lust demons of this realm live, Mother-in-law?"

"They live in the Temptation Valley in the Endless Domain." Nalan Shizhe then explained to Zhang Fei about the demon race, their habitat, and their leader. "You must be careful if you want to go to that domain; otherwise, you’ll get lost in the endless illusion, and you’ll have difficulty leaving it."

"I understand." Zhang Fei did not take Nalan Shizhe’s warning lightly, but he was also not too worried about it because he possessed the Illusion Negation ability that he mimicked from the Black Amaris long ago.

After walking for some time, they finally arrived at the soul pond Nalan Shizhe had previously mentioned. Zhang Fei immediately took out some firewood and built a bonfire using his eternal flame, preventing it from dying out and keeping the wandering evil souls away from their location.

Nalan Yushu crouched by the pond, where countless souls swirled inside like a whirlpool. The look in her eyes showed that she was eager to devour the souls inside, but she didn’t do it after her mother had mentioned all that.
Nalan Yushu tried to dip her hand into the pond, but those souls stopped her and hit it back, causing her to fall backwards. "Huh? Why are they attacking me?"

"I told you not to do anything to these souls, but you didn’t listen to me." Nalan Yushu turned to Nalan Shizhe, who was already standing by her side. "Never mind you; these souls never let me enter this pond, and they attacked me in the past because I insisted on entering it. Fortunately, their attacks were not fatal; otherwise, I would have suffered serious injuries back then. Therefore, you should forget your wishes for these souls, or they will be furious and attack you."
"I know." Nalan Yushu sat down while hugging her legs, staring at the souls inside the pond.
Nalan Wangzi sat by Nalan Yushu’s side and embraced her. "Is there another way into this pond, Mother?"
"No." Nalan Shizhe shook her head in response. "Honestly, I’m curious to see the bottom, but I won’t try again."
Hearing that, Zhang Fei walked to their side and crouched beside the pond. "Let me try it."
