chapters.title: Chapter 1273: Soul Devouring Ancestor
paragraphs: Before Zhang Fei could dip his hand into the soul pond, several souls had already come out from within and pulled him in.
"Zhang Fei!"
"Husband!"
"Brother-in-law!"
Nalan Shizhe, Nalan Yushu, and Nalan Wangzi shouted in shock before jumping into the pond. However, the souls inside hit the three of them, sending them flying backwards.
Nalan Huanzi, who was in the distance, immediately ran over to them. "What happened to my brother-in-law?"
Nalan Shizhe hurriedly got up and ran to the side of the soul pond, followed by her three children. However, a soul bubble covered the pond, preventing them from approaching.
"Mother, he—"

Nalan Shizhe shook her head at her second daughter. "We can’t do anything right now, Yushu. This has never happened before, but you don’t have to worry because these souls are not evil. Perhaps, there’s something inside Zhang Fei’s body that attracted their attention, and they took the initiative to bring him into the pond."
"Are you sure he will be okay, mother?"

Nalan Shizhe let out a heavy sigh before answering her eldest daughter. "I can’t say anything now because I’ve never been there, but Zhang Fei should be fine. Have you fallen in love with him now too?"

"Haha! I haven’t completely fallen in love with him, but we’ve been intimate a few times, and I’ve also used his Yang Qi to strengthen my body." Nalan Wangzi gave Nalan Shizhe a bottle of Zhang Fei’s Yang Qi. "Try it, and you will know that it is precious."
Nalan Yushu glanced at Nalan Wangzi, who winked at her. She then looked at their mother, who hesitated for a moment before drinking it.
Nalan Huanzhi didn’t say anything, but he felt strange because his mother and two sisters drank Zhang Fei’s Yang Qi. ’I hope our mother won’t fall for him.’
"How do you feel?"

Nalan Shizhe nodded slightly. "His Yang Qi is truly precious, and it is much stronger than all items that contain Yang Qi. No wonder all his wives’ cultivation increased that fast, even though they only dual cultivated with him."

"Drink it again." Nalan Wangzi gave her mother another bottle of Zhang Fei’s Yang Qi, which she immediately drank down. "The more of his Yang Qi we consume, the greater the effect and the stronger our bodies become. In fact, our relationship hasn’t gone that far, and I always drink his Yang Qi through bottles like this."
Nalan Shizhe nodded in understanding and turned toward the soul pond again. ’What do these souls really want from Zhang Fei?’

Zhang Fei floated down to the bottom of the Soul Pond, and he could hear many voices coming from all the souls inside as if they wanted to tell him something, but he couldn’t understand their language.

Zhang Fei activated his soul domain and enveloped the entire area within the pond, causing those souls to transform into their old forms. "Are you all the souls of the soul-devouring demon race that lived far in the past?"
"You’re right, young man." A male demon nodded to Zhang Fei. "We have been waiting for your arrival for a long time, the successor of the ten-tailed fox."

Zhang Fei furrowed his brows after hearing that, but this was not the first time he had met people who had direct connections with Hu Tianlang in the past. Feng Yao obviously had a direct connection with the old fox, and he met Tian Kongquaan and Yan Huo in the Sovereign Heaven Realm. In the Paradise Realm, Yin Yue and Tian Taiyang met the old fox in the past, and the past soul-devouring demon race was the same. "Did you all gather here because of the old fox’s request?"

"Yes." The male demon nodded again. "The ten-tailed fox met our demon god before she died, and he helped her preserve her corpse at the bottom of this pond. He asked us to guard her corpse and not allow anyone to enter here except his future successor, and he also left something in our souls that allows us to recognize your identity immediately."

’What exactly does the old fox plan? Why did he arrange so many things for his successor? I’ve tried asking his benevolent soul about it, but he said he doesn’t have complete memories of his past, and he always asks me to collect all the pieces of his soul first.’ Zhang Fei then asked him. "Did the old fox say something else to you?"

"Young man, we were just servants of our demon god, so the ten-tailed fox didn’t say anything to us." The male demon pointed downwards. "Our demon god is waiting for you below, and you will know everything after you talk to her."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding as he looked down, but his senses and Mei couldn’t probe that deep.

A while later, Zhang Fei finally arrived at the bottom of the pond, where he found a black coffin in its center. After the souls left him, a female soul emerged from the coffin, but she immediately struck his chest, causing his body to fall backwards.

Zhang Fei was completely shocked because the female soul could force his soul out of his body with just a light attack. However, her next action shocked him further, as he split his soul into four: his human soul, his fox soul, his lust demon soul, and his calamity demon dragon soul. ’Tch! The soul of a former demon god is indeed different.’
"Hmm?" The female demon raised an eyebrow after she saw Zhang Fei’s four souls. "In the past, Hu Tianlang told me that you would have three souls, but you actually had four."
Zhang Fei shook his head at her. "I don’t know what the old fox told you in the past, but I only had three souls before, and I got my fourth soul not too long ago."
"I see." The female demon nodded slightly. "Your fourth soul should be the one and only Calamity Demon Dragon, right?"

paragraphs: [Daily quest I: Absorb 10,000,000 Qi.]

[Reward: Celestial daily pack x1]
Nalan Ziyue was surprised when Morgana walked out of the training space, proving that Zhang Fei did have a witch demon by his side.

"I’m uncertain whether the members of her race will be willing to meet her due to her low cultivation, but I’ll teach her how to find them, and you can figure out a solution yourself later." Zhang Fei nodded to Nalan Ziyue, who immediately touched Morgana’s forehead and shared the method with her. "You can use that method to track their whereabouts, but as I said before, they won’t necessarily be willing to meet you because of your low cultivation. Even if they were willing to meet you, your cultivation isn’t sufficient to match the Demon Soul Elixir."

Morgana smiled bitterly at Nalan Ziyue’s words, as she didn’t have all of Zhang Fei’s advantages, nor was she a dual cultivator like him. Furthermore, she had stayed in the Three Mortal Realms for too long, so her current cultivation lagged far behind her.

"I don’t think it’s a big deal, and you can cultivate in my space for now. With the difference in the time flow, I’m sure you can break through to the Five Celestial Realms faster." Zhang Fei sent Morgana back into the training space before asking Nalan Ziyue. "Do you have anything else for me?"
Nalan Ziyue closed the coffin first. "Take my corpse with you, and this coffin will preserve it until the time comes for you to use it."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei was confused. "Could you please explain why I need to use your corpse?"

"I don’t have an answer for you." Nalan Ziyue’s soul suddenly faded. "My time is up, and I will disappear after this. Back then, Hu Tianlang told me that his successor would need my corpse for something in the future, but he didn’t explain the details to me. If you want to know about his grand plan, you just need to evolve into the ten-tailed fox, and you will have all the answers to your questions then."
Zhang Fei’s lips twitched at that. "Does this mean your original soul has been reincarnated?"

"Yes." Nalan Ziyue nodded in response. "The moment I died, Hu Tianlang helped my original soul reincarnate, but I don’t know the identity or location of my reincarnation. Perhaps, you will meet her in the future, or maybe she is already by your side now."

"What—" Nalan Ziyue smiled mysteriously before disappearing, making Zhang Fei sigh heavily. He then looked up, and all the souls in the pond began to disappear one by one. "I can’t promise you anything, but I will strive hard to lead your soul-devouring race to a much better life in the future."
"The successor of the ten-tailed fox, thank you and farewell."

Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh before looking at the coffin and touching it. "What exactly did the old fox have planned with Nalan Ziyue’s corpse? Why did he deliberately preserve her corpse for me? What should I do with this corpse now?"

[Master, I think the safest place to hide this corpse is your soul world, so you should send it there now. As for its use, I can’t think of anything for now, but the ten-tailed fox won’t leave anything useless for you. Therefore, you don’t need to think too much about it for now, and you just need to wait for the time to get the answer.]
"Yeah." Zhang Fei immediately sent the coffin into his soul world before using his nine cloud steps to get out of the pond.
"Zhang Fei!"
"Husband!"
"Brother-in-law!"

Nalan Shizhe and her three children exclaimed simultaneously as soon as Zhang Fei shot out of the pond, and Nalan Yushu immediately grabbed his shoulders, checking him up and down. "Did something happen to you there?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei softly laughed and pecked her lips. "Nothing happened to me, so you don’t need to worry this much, okay?"
"Phew." Nalan Yushu breathed a sigh of relief and hugged him tightly. "I’m really scared if something happens to you, but I’m relieved that you came back safely."

"I know you care about me, but I’m fine." Zhang Fei turned to Nalan Shizhe, who was stunned to see the empty pond after those souls disappeared. "Mother-in-law, I met Nalan Ziyue down there, and she—"
"What?" Nalan Shizhe abruptly looked at him, exclaiming in shock. "Did you really meet our ancestor down there?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at Nalan Shizhe before recounting his previous encounter with Nalan Ziyue to them, which shocked all of them. "As for her corpse and coffin, I keep both of them in my soul world, so no one will be able to find them."

Nalan Shizhe frowned for a moment before sighing softly. "I didn’t expect that my soul-devouring race was already connected to you long before you met Yushu, let alone about the connection between my ancestor and the ten-tailed fox."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed in response. "I myself never thought that the relationship between us had been established even before I became a cultivator, but unfortunately, I was still too weak to fulfill the ten-tailed fox’s hope of becoming a peacemaker, and it still took me a very long time to be able to reach that level."

Nalan Shizhe nodded in agreement. "I don’t know how or how long it will take you to reach that level, but I’m sure you’ll eventually reach it one day. Right now, there’s no point in thinking about that. You just need to cultivate more diligently while building your own strength in this realm, so everything will be ready when you reach that level."
"Yeah, you’re right," Zhang Fei then asked her. "Do you know the situation in the Heavenly Fiend Domain, Mother-in-law?"
"Hmm?" Nalan Shizhe and the others frowned at Zhang Fei, prompting him to explain why he wanted to go to the Heavenly Fiend Domain.

Nalan Wangzi then spoke. "What if we take him to those black markets, Mother? We might be able to find the Infernal Blood Core and the Demon Soul Elixir there, so he won’t have to risk facing the Infernal Fiend. Furthermore, the Heavenly Fiend Demon God, Sha Mo, will definitely be aware of his presence in his domain, which will be even more risky for him."

"Demon God Sha Mo is the most fierce among all demon gods, and his brute strength is too terrifying." Nalan Huanzi then looked at Zhang Fei. "Brother-in-law, I can’t measure your physical strength because I’m not a body cultivator like you, but I advise you to flee immediately if you encounter him. If one of his fists strikes you, it will crush all your bones, leaving you permanently crippled."
"How much difference is there between Sha Mo’s strength compared to Shang Zhanluo?"

Nalan Huanzi patted Zhang Fei’s shoulder. "Brother-in-law, Shang Zhanluo became the second strongest of all the demon gods due to a secret technique from his Asura demon race. In contrast to him, Sha Mo possessed pure brute strength, and the Asura Demon God would have lost completely to him if he had not used a secret technique."

"Huanzi is right." Nalan Shizhe waved her hand and created a qi screen, displaying the battle between the two demon gods as they fought for the status of the second strongest. "As you can see for yourself, Shang Zhanluo almost lost the battle, but he managed to turn the situation around after he used his secret technique. Without it, he would never be able to become the second strongest among all demon gods. Therefore, you must be completely careful if you really want to go to the Heavenly Fiend Domain, and you must immediately escape from there if Sha Mo appears in front of you."

Zhang Fei nodded to Nalan Shizhe as he seriously watched the battle between the two demon gods on the qi screen. "Sha Mo’s brute strength is indeed terrifying, but I think he’s still weaker than Long Wuzhao."

"Long Wuzhao is recognized as the strongest cultivator for a good reason, you know?" Nalan Shizhe removed the qi screen after the battle between the two demon gods was over. "He is the only five-clawed golden dragon in this universe, and his dragon’s physique is the strongest. Therefore, you can’t compare Sha Mo with him, as the dragon emperor can easily defeat him."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh, but he was confident that he could match Long Wuzhao and Sha Mo in the future, as he was the only Calamity Demon Dragon in their universe, which had power equal to the five-clawed golden dragon. Moreover, he will evolve into the ten-tailed fox in the future, and the old fox was once a primordial being.

"Hehe." Nalan Yushu giggled and hugged his arm. "Once you reach the Celestial God Realm, the Demon God Rank, and evolve into the ten-tailed fox, there will be no one in this universe who can be your match."

Zhang Fei just smiled when he heard that because it was still far beyond his reach. "Let’s rest first, and we will continue our journey when the sun rises. I hope the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus has bloomed inside there."

chapters.title: Chapter 1275: Ku Shenzu 1st Mentioned
paragraphs: Inside Zhang Fei’s soul world, three souls stood beside Nalan Ziyue’s coffin. "What exactly are your plans for the female corpse inside, Hu Tianlang?"

Hu Tianlang shook his head at Yin Yue. "As I told that kid before, I don’t have complete memories of my past, so I don’t remember my goal of preserving her corpse. He just needs to find all the pieces of my soul, and he will get my past memories then."
"Even though I can’t recognize it, I’m sure this coffin is a special artifact, and you made it specifically for the female corpse." Tian Taiyang spoke, observing the coffin.

"Yeah." Hu Tianlang let out a soft sigh before looking away. "I hope he can collect the rest of my soul as soon as possible, but he will have to face several dangers to get them, especially my wrath soul."
"What exactly do those two fairies want to do?" Yin Yue asked, looking in another direction, where Jia Xianzu and Beiming Youhuang were cultivating.

Hu Tianlang answered her directly. "The fairy race is nature’s closest friend, and they want to help that kid grow in this soul world. They can’t do it directly because they aren’t Luo Yunxiao, and they need to familiarize themselves with this soul world first."
"I still can’t believe that your special physique didn’t fall into Zhang Fei’s possession, but instead, it fell into the possession of one of his wives."

"Haha." Hu Tianlang laughed at that. "Everything that happens in our lives is predetermined by fate, and we can’t change anything. We can change some things through our hard work, but some things can never be changed, including my special physique choice of choosing Luo Yunxiao as its new master. Even though that kid doesn’t have my physique, she can help him in all his future battles, and no one can defeat them combined."
Yin Yue let out a heavy sigh. "Some people have the opportunity to change their destiny, but they are too stubborn to listen to the advice of others, and I am one of them. If—"

"It’s all in the past, so you don’t need to continue regretting your decision back then." Hu Tianlang then looked at the two souls beside him. "For now, you two just need to focus on strengthening your souls, and you can rebuild your two clans after you reshape your bodies."
"Yeah." After that, the three left the coffin and returned to their location, where Yin Yue and Tian Taiyang focused on cultivating their souls.

Once the forest was quite lit, Nalan Shizhe led Zhang Fei and her three children to continue their journey. The heart of the Wailing Soul Forest was far from their current location, and they still had to deal with naturally occurring traps in every area they passed. Furthermore, the wandering evil souls became stronger with each step they took.

Although the wandering evil souls weren’t a problem for them, especially with Nalan Shizhe by their side, those traps still presented them with some problems and hindered their journey, especially the misleading traps.

Zhang Fei, as usual, let the demon extermination sword roam freely, absorbing the wandering evil souls that obstructed their path. However, he wielded it when they crossed paths with stronger souls, and he used his soul domain to weaken them before the sword could absorb them.

Just like the demon extermination sword, Nalan Yushu moved actively to devour those wandering evil souls, and Nalan Huanzi protected her by her side because her cultivation was not as high as in the past.
Nalan Shizhe was surprised when Nalan Wangzi released her soul eater sword, and Hun Jian controlled the sword to eat those wandering evil souls. "Since when did the sword obey you?"

"Hehe." Nalan Wangzi giggled, pointing at Zhang Fei, who was fighting with the wandering evil souls in the distance. "Two days ago in the Blood Forest, my brother-in-law forced the spirit out by force and threatened him with turning the sword into a lump of metal, which would destroy both of them. After all, he was a supreme-rank blacksmith, and it was easy for him to do that, which is why Hun Jian chose to obey me."

Nalan Shizhe nodded in understanding as she looked at Zhang Fei. "He possesses several identities and numerous abilities, and no cultivator like him has ever existed in the past. If he doesn’t act recklessly and continues to develop himself, he will definitely succeed in reaching the peak of cultivation one day in the future."

"You’re right, mother." Nalan Wangzi nodded in agreement. "He is actually a cautious person, and he always plans everything in detail before executing it. However, he is still no different from us or other cultivators, and he still often makes careless mistakes."

"Haha." Nalan Shizhe laughed softly. "If others dare to claim they’ve never made careless mistakes, then they’re utter hypocrites. Let alone Zhang Fei, even Long Wuzhao and I, who have lived for so long, still often make careless mistakes. Mistakes are part of our life, and we will unknowingly make them even with all the most careful planning. The most important thing is that we must take lessons from our mistakes, and we must improve ourselves so that we don’t repeat the same mistakes. However, many people are too hypocritical to see their own mistakes or correct them, and they would rather insult others for their mistakes."
"Hypocrites are everywhere." Nalan Wangzi turned to her mother. "Was your decision about our father not a mistake?"

"No." Nalan Shizhe denied it directly. "Your father and I never loved each other, and I myself have no desire to have a husband by my side. Although I didn’t want to have a husband, I wanted to have children, and I chose him to be the father of my children, which he agreed to until the three of you were born."
"What about now?"
Nalan Shizhe raised her eyebrows. "Are you thinking of taking me to my son-in-law’s side?"

"Haha." Nalan Wangzi laughed at that. "Actually, Yushu and I discussed this matter some time ago, and we’ve considered several things before deciding on it. We want to see you live happier than you are now, but we know that we can’t force you."

"Who told you that my life was unhappy?" Nalan Shizhe asked back while shaking her head. "I’m no different from women in general, but I’m also different from them. Some women do need the presence of men in their lives, but I don’t need them. Since I was little, I’ve been used to relying on myself, and I managed to reach this level because of my own hard work. Therefore, I don’t need a husband by my side to love or help me, as I can do everything myself. Besides, I have the three of you by my side, and your presence always makes my life happy and complete. I will never be interested in having a husband, so you and Yushu should forget about that idea."

Nalan Wangz didn’t say anything and sighed in her heart, but she didn’t want to give up, and she thought of some plans to entice her mother. ’I can’t do it alone, so I have to talk to my brother-in-law and Yushu about this matter later.’
While Zhang Fei was busy with those wandering evil souls, his other clones were preoccupied with the daily quests, but it wasn’t difficult for them to complete them.

With their busy activities in the forest, the day passed quickly, and it was already nightfall again. The entire forest area became too dark for them to continue their journey, so Nalan Shizhe asked them to rest first.

Like the previous day, Zhang Fei built a bonfire using his eternal flame, where he gathered with Nalan Shizhe and Nalan Huanzi. He sent Nalan Yushu and Nalan Wangzi to the training space, as the two women wanted to clean themselves.
Nalan Huanzi was curious about Zhang Fei’s training space, but Nalan Shizhe forbade him to ask anything, as the less people knew about his private space, the better for him.
"This forest is really wide, and there are too many traps in it. If you hadn’t led us, we would have been lost here, mother-in-law."

Nalan Shizhe smiled upon hearing that. "Actually, I once got lost in this forest when I was young because I forced myself to enter alone, and I almost died at the hands of those powerful wandering evil souls. Fortunately, the previous demon god saved me, so I’m still alive now."
"What exactly happened to the previous soul-devouring demon god? Is she dead?" Zhang Fei curiously asked.

"The previous demon god is still alive now, but she no longer interferes in our race’s affairs, and she prefers to seclude herself in the Ten Hell Monarch Domain with several others." Nalan Shizhe’s answer surprised Zhang Fei. "Not many of the previous demon gods are still alive, only four to be exact. The other three are former demon gods of the Celestial Demon Race, the Seven Emotions Demon Race, and the Torture Demon Race."
"Torture Demon Race?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow.

Nalah Shizhe nodded at him. "The name ’Torture Demon Race’ is not their original race name; it was given to them by people because of their tendency to torture victims. I don’t know their original race name, but they are the vilest among the ten demon races. Their current demon god is Ku Shenzu, and he is the most disgusting among the ten demon gods."

chapters.title: Chapter 1276: Qian Yan 1st Mentioned
paragraphs: "How strong is Ku Shenzu, mother-in-law?"

"Would you believe me if I said that Ku Shenzu is the weakest among the ten demon gods?" Nalan Shizhe’s answer puzzled Zhang Fei, as some people had told him that Qi Qingxiu was the weakest among them. "Qingxiu isn’t the weakest among us, but that disgusting man is the weakest. However, he has many terrible abilities, especially his torture domain. Not many of us can defeat him when he activates his domain; only Mo Shentian, Shang Zhanluo, Sha Mo, and Jiu Mozu dare to face him. I once tried to spar with him, but I couldn’t withstand his domain."

Nalan Shizhe created a few qi screens, each of which showed the battle of several demon gods against Ku Shenzu in the past. She didn’t say anything else and let Zhang Fei watch all the fights herself, but she seriously observed his expression as she watched them. ’Oh? He remained calm even though he witnessed such fierce fights.’

Unlike Zhang Fei, Nalan Huanzi didn’t watch the other demon gods fight against Ku Shenzu. He wasn’t afraid of his actions, but he didn’t like seeing his disgusting appearance. ’Tch! I don’t understand how a disgusting creature like him can exist!’

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei frowned as soon as he saw Ku Shenzu activate his torture domain, which was filled with various types of torture tools. "This guy really likes torturing his victims, huh? Furthermore, those tools move freely according to his wishes, and they can continue to pursue their targets."

Nalan Shizhe pointed at one of the screens. "Did you see that guillotine? The guillotine is Ku Shenzhu’s main weapon, and it’s a soul weapon. It will cut your soul straight through, but you won’t die from it; instead, your soul will break and split into pieces."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei frowned deeper. "The soul is a fundamental part of living beings, even though we do not die if it attacks us. If our soul is damaged and split into several pieces, we will no longer be whole, and we will become like the living dead."

"That’s right," Nalan Shizhe replied with a nod. "Apart from the guillotine, Ku Shenzu still has several other torture tools, and one of them is a whip. His whip is an ancient artifact, and it will cause all the injuries you have experienced in the past to resurface, even if they have already been fully recovered. I was once hit by it, and all my past injuries reappeared, which forced my predecessor to come out of her seclusion to protect our race until I recovered."
"Such a terrifying artifact exists, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered under his breath.

"As you already know, the cultivation world has always been mysterious, and there are far too many secrets within it." Zhang Fei nodded approvingly at Nalan Shizhe, who immediately dispelled those qi screens. "Ku Shenzu’s torture domain and artifacts are indeed terrifying, but I don’t think they’re a significant problem for you. With your speed in bringing us to this forest yesterday, I can say that your speed surpasses most of the demon gods, and his speed pales in comparison to yours. Therefore, I’m sure you won’t face any significant difficulties if you fight with him, as he will never succeed in capturing you."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed awkwardly in response. "Honestly, I’m afraid of dying, so I always focus on training my speed. Now I have many people by my side, and that makes me even more afraid of dying because it will make them sad. Then, what about the strength and abilities of the Thousand-Eyes Demon God?"
"The Thousand-Eyes Demon God, Qian Yan, is the only demon beast among the ten demon gods." Nalan Shizhe created a qi screen, showing the figure of the demon god.

The Thousand-Eyes Demon God is a grotesque and majestic abomination of a demon beast. His massive, serpentine body stretches hundreds of meters long, covered in black scales. Thousand eyes sprout from his shoulders, back, and tail. Each eye has a different color, shape, and size. His main head bears a gaping maw filled with jagged teeth and a single colossal eye on his forehead. His ten limbs end in clawed, chitinous talons.

Zhang Fei took a deep breath as soon as he saw Qian Yan’s demon beast form. "This guy is the most terrifying demon beast I have ever seen, and his thousand eyes make him even more terrifying. Unfortunately, his body is simply too big, so I’m sure his speed is very slow when he uses his beast form."

"Qian Yan is indeed the slowest among all the demon gods, whether he uses his human or demon form. However, his attack power is one of the greatest, and his movements can cause earthquakes and various other disasters." Zhang Fei seriously observed the eyes one by one, and he frowned when he realized something, prompting Nalan Shizhe to explain some things about their abilities. "Compared to all the eyes on his body, you should be more worried about the colossal eye on his forehead, as it has various abilities."
"What is one of his middle eye’s abilities, mother-in-law?"

"Qian Yan can see through space." Zhang Fei turned to Nalan Shizhe directly. "I don’t know where you get your private space or how it works, but you should never open it when he’s around. Once he finds your private space, he can track your whereabouts forever, and you will never hide from him again. The worst thing is that he can still attack you with his other eye abilities, even when you hide in your private space. You must be aware of the risks if that happens, right?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded with a solemn expression. "So, Qian Yan can only find my space if he has seen it once, right?"

"Yes," Nalan Shizhe then told him something else. "Qian Yan’s middle eye also has the ability to absorb the souls of any living creatures that directly look into it when activated, so you should avoid making direct eye contact with his middle eye. When he uses that ability, his middle eye will turn ash-black, so you’ll know when he’s about to use it. I have no information about the other abilities of his middle eye, so I can only tell you this much."
Zhang Fei nodded with a heavy sigh. "He is worthy of the title of demon god, as his middle eye’s abilities are simply terrifying, and he also has great strength thanks to his massive body."

"Even though he is terrifying, Qian Yan rarely attacks other living beings, but he is also a vengeful one. If other living beings attack his race, he will hunt them down until he kills them." Nalan Shizhe suddenly remembered something. "Zhang Fei, you still have to be careful of him, as he has connections with the four perils."

Zhang Fei wasn’t too surprised about that, as demon beasts were no different from other beasts, and the four perils were immortal beasts, so they could easily subdue Qian Yan. "If he has a relationship with them, why doesn’t Mo Shentian use him to build a relationship with them? Wouldn’t it be easier for him if he used him?"

"They never got along with each other, and the two of them were like mortal enemies." Zhang Fei was surprised to hear that from Nalan Shizhe. "Mo Shentian is the strongest, and he also has the ability to bend reality. But Qian Yan is no pushover, and his middle eye can counter his ability."
"So, Mo Shentian has tried to subdue Qian Yan before?"

Nalan Shizhe nodded slightly. "Mo Shentian’s ambition to unite all the demon races under him has been long-standing, and he has attacked all of us before. He killed many of Qian Yan’s race members, but he never succeeded in subduing him, and they have become mortal enemies since then."

"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Although Qian Yan is weaker than Mo Shentian, he has many advantages, especially with his middle eye abilities. What about the Lust Demon Race, Mother-in-law?"

Shang Shizhe shook her head. "I’ve never had any contact with them, so I don’t know much about their abilities. Their leaders are Xie Yao and Xie Yan, and both of them are demon gods like me. Since you are a lust demon yourself, you shouldn’t have any problems when dealing with them, even though your cultivation and demon rank are below theirs."
"I hope so." Zhang Fei then opened the portal to the training space, allowing Nalan Yushu and Nalan Wangzi to come out of it.
After that, they discussed a few other things, but Zhang Fei asked Nalan Shizhe the most questions, especially since she was a demon god and had much more experience than him.
[Daily quest I: Absorb 10,000,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1000 purple jewels.]
[Daily Quest II: Absorb 10,000,000 demon essence.]
[Reward: 1000 advanced-grade demon cores.]
[Daily Quest III: Absorb 10,000,000 beast essence.]
[Reward: 1000 advanced-grade beast cores.]
[Daily Quest IV: Killing 1000 beasts/demon beasts in the Celestial Lord or above.]
[Reward: Celestial daily pack x1]

As soon as the sun rose, Nalan Shizhe led Zhang Fei and the others on their way. However, their journey became increasingly difficult due to the presence of the stronger wandering evil souls, coupled with far more deadly traps in the forest.
Nalan Shizhe even had to constantly help them keep those wandering evil souls at bay; otherwise, they would attack Zhang Fei and her three children.

"Compared to all the eyes on his body, you should be more worried about the colossal eye on his forehead, as it has various abilities."
"What is one of his middle eye’s abilities, mother-in-law?"
"Qian Yan can see through space." Zhang Fei turned to Nalan Shizhe directly.
"I don’t know where you get your private space or how it works, but you should never open it when he’s around.
Once he finds your private space, he can track your whereabouts forever, and you will never hide from him again.
The worst thing is that he can still attack you with his other eye abilities, even when you hide in your private space.
You must be aware of the risks if that happens, right?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded with a solemn expression.
"So, Qian Yan can only find my space if he has seen it once, right?"
"Yes," Nalan Shizhe then told him something else.
"Qian Yan’s middle eye also has the ability to absorb the souls of any living creatures that directly look into it when activated, so you should avoid making direct eye contact with his middle eye.
When he uses that ability, his middle eye will turn ash-black, so you’ll know when he’s about to use it.
I have no information about the other abilities of his middle eye, so I can only tell you this much."
Zhang Fei nodded with a heavy sigh.
"He is worthy of the title of demon god, as his middle eye’s abilities are simply terrifying, and he also has great strength thanks to his massive body."
"Even though he is terrifying, Qian Yan rarely attacks other living beings, but he is also a vengeful one.
If other living beings attack his race, he will hunt them down until he kills them." Nalan Shizhe suddenly remembered something.
"Zhang Fei, you still have to be careful of him, as he has connections with the four perils."
Zhang Fei wasn’t too surprised about that, as demon beasts were no different from other beasts, and the four perils were immortal beasts, so they could easily subdue Qian Yan.
"If he has a relationship with them, why doesn’t Mo Shentian use him to build a relationship with them?
Wouldn’t it be easier for him if he used him?"
"They never got along with each other, and the two of them were like mortal enemies." Zhang Fei was surprised to hear that from Nalan Shizhe.
"Mo Shentian is the strongest, and he also has the ability to bend reality.
But Qian Yan is no pushover, and his middle eye can counter his ability."
"So, Mo Shentian has tried to subdue Qian Yan before?"
Nalan Shizhe nodded slightly.
"Mo Shentian’s ambition to unite all the demon races under him has been long-standing, and he has attacked all of us before.
He killed many of Qian Yan’s race members, but he never succeeded in subduing him, and they have become mortal enemies since then."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.
"Although Qian Yan is weaker than Mo Shentian, he has many advantages, especially with his middle eye abilities.
What about the Lust Demon Race, Mother-in-law?"
Shang Shizhe shook her head.
"I’ve never had any contact with them, so I don’t know much about their abilities.
Their leaders are Xie Yao and Xie Yan, and both of them are demon gods like me.
Since you are a lust demon yourself, you shouldn’t have any problems when dealing with them, even though your cultivation and demon rank are below theirs."
"I hope so." Zhang Fei then opened the portal to the training space, allowing Nalan Yushu and Nalan Wangzi to come out of it.
After that, they discussed a few other things, but Zhang Fei asked Nalan Shizhe the most questions, especially since she was a demon god and had much more experience than him.
[Daily quest I: Absorb 10,000,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1000 purple jewels.]
[Daily Quest II: Absorb 10,000,000 demon essence.]
[Reward: 1000 advanced-grade demon cores.]
[Daily Quest III: Absorb 10,000,000 beast essence.]
[Reward: 1000 advanced-grade beast cores.]
[Daily Quest IV: Killing 1000 beasts/demon beasts in the Celestial Lord or above.]
[Reward: Celestial daily pack x1]
As soon as the sun rose, Nalan Shizhe led Zhang Fei and the others on their way.
However, their journey became increasingly difficult due to the presence of the stronger wandering evil souls, coupled with far more deadly traps in the forest.
Nalan Shizhe even had to constantly help them keep those wandering evil souls at bay; otherwise, they would attack Zhang Fei and her three children.

chapters.title: Chapter 1277: The Heart Of The Forest
paragraphs: Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui have been in the Endless Domain for two days now, but they kept wandering around in circles, struggling to find a way out of the illusion that trapped them.
"Tch! This domain always makes things difficult for everyone." Shang Luohu spoke with annoyance before turning to Shang Zhui. "Have you managed to locate the source of this illusion?"

Shang Zhui shook his head slightly. "There are too many illusions in this domain, and this misleading formation is one of the most troublesome; therefore, we have no choice but to move forward while examining our surroundings for now."
"Unfortunately, there are no array masters in our asura demon race; otherwise, I would have brought one here." Shang Luohu helplessly spoke as she started walking forward again.

Shang smiled at that. "Since the time of our ancestors, our Asura demon races have always focused on raw physical strength and war, and no one has been interested in studying other cultivation paths."

"Yeah." Shang Luohu nodded in agreement. "Actually, humans, beasts, and natural races are much better than our demon races. Many of them don’t focus on a single cultivation path, and some of them pursue multiple cultivation paths simultaneously, such as Zhang Xiaolong. Currently, our asura demon race is superior to many of them, but we don’t know what will happen in the future. We don’t need to discuss beast races because many of them are stronger than us, but I’m afraid that the human and natural races will surpass us one day if we continue to like this."

"Unfortunately, changing something that has been ingrained in us since the time of our ancestors is not easy." Shang Luohu nodded to Shang Zhui. "Furthermore, my emperor has no desire to change the situation of our Asura Demon Race, and his only goal is to surpass Mo Shentian, making him not care about other things. If we want our race to change, we must choose a new leader who cares more about other things, but that is not an easy thing either."
Shang Luohu let out a soft sigh. "Has my husband told you about the new demon god candidates from our race?"

"Not yet." Shang Zhui replied with a shake of his head. "Currently, there are three of our younger generation who have the ability to be his successor, but they are not yet ready to succeed him, and they still need hundreds, if not thousands, of years to reach his level. Thus, I think it’s still too early to think about this, and we have to discuss everything again after they reach his level."
"You’re right." Shang Luohu turned to him. "What about your son? Is he worthy of being one of the successor candidates?"

"Haha." Shang Zhui responded with a wry laugh. "In the past, my son was chosen as one of the candidates for our future leader, but his decision to run away with Ye Zhiye changed everything. His cultivation and demon rank lag behind those three, so he must catch up to them first to prove his worth. If he cannot catch up and surpass them, then he is not worthy of being one of the candidates."

Although Shang Luohu was his empress, Shang Zhui did not intend to reveal certain details about Tian Shuixiang, particularly his status as an alchemy god. He was familiar with the personalities of their race members, and he knew that the other three candidates would target his son.

Shang Luohu nodded slightly. "Your son may be far behind those three now, but I am confident that he will catch up or even surpass them. Moreover, Ye Zhiye is his wife, and their relationship might help us repair our relationship with Ye Mingran and her Eternal Night Demon Race."
"I hope the same."
Thereafter, Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui moved faster to find a way out of the illusion that trapped them, but they were unaware that two people were watching them from a great distance.
"Hey! Aren’t they Shang Luohu and Shang zhui, Xie Yao? What are they doing in our domain?" A woman with a smooth, pale, playful face asked the man beside her, looking at a crystal ball.

The woman has wide eyes with two pink pupils, long lashes shadow her gaze, a sharp nose, and a pair of thick lips form a seductive smile. She has a pair of curved horns on the sides of her head and two small, pink wings behind her back. Her pink hair flowed down her back. Her figure was tall and curvaceous, her breasts were massive, her curves were perfectly refined, and her long legs were slender and smooth.

In contrast, Xie Yao has dark silver hair left to flow freely, two sharp horns pointing upwards, and two dark silver wings. His face was sharp and serious with two silver eyes and a sharp nose, and his figure was really tall. "They are indeed Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui, Xie Yan. It’s unusual for Shang Zhanluo to let his wife go to another domain accompanied by only one guardian, let alone to our domain."

"Hehehe." Xie Yan giggled as she floated behind Xie Yao and hugged him from behind. "Isn’t this a great opportunity? Shall we bring Shang Luohu here to have some fun? Asura demons are known to have strong physiques, so I’m sure he’s strong enough to serve both of us at once."

Xie Yao shook his head slightly and moved her to his lap. "Naturally, I want to try having fun with Shang Luohu, but I’m not that crazy yet. Although all the illusions in this domain can protect us from other races, Shang Zhanluo is different from them, and his strength is far too great for us. If he finds out we did something to his wife, I’m sure he’ll bring the other four guardians here, and they will destroy this domain with their superior strength to kill us."
"That’s true." Xie Yan nodded in agreement. "However, I’m curious about their reason for coming here, and they seem eager to meet us."
Xie Yao narrowed his eyes, observing Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui’s movements. "Let them work hard to break out of those illusions first, and we’ll meet them when they make it to this valley."
"Alright! Forget them and have fun again."
"Hahaha!"

Time passed quickly, and it took them another three days to reach the heart of the Wailing Soul Forest. Zhang Fei actually asked Bing Xingying’s real body to take them to that place, but she couldn’t do that, forcing them to walk.

Over the past few days, Zhang Fei absorbed the wandering evil souls in the forest, and he also allowed the demon extermination sword to absorb them. Nalan Yushu was the same as her husband, but he didn’t do it alone, and Nalan Huanzi always helped her.

Nalan Wangzi didn’t absorb the wandering evil souls, but he let Hun Jian control his soul-eater sword to eat them. Meanwhile, Nalan Shizhe solely focused on protecting them, as the evil souls continued to grow stronger the deeper they went.

When they arrived at their destination, Zhang Fei was disappointed that the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus wasn’t there. Even so, he found thousands of Phantom Soul Lotuses in that place, giving him a slight sense of satisfaction.
"I guess we’re not lucky, husband." Nalan Yushu hugged Zhang Fei’s arm.

"Phew." Zhang Fei exhaled heavily. "Although we didn’t manage to find the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus, there are a lot of these Phantom Soul Lotuses, and I can use them to strengthen all the demons by my side."
"Brother-in-law, you should bring them here instead of picking them, as the effects will be much better if they consume these lotuses immediately after picking them." Nalan Wangzi spoke.

"Wangzi is right, Zhang Fei." Nalan Shizhe agreed with his eldest daughter. "The effects of the Phantom Soul Lotus will be significantly reduced if you waste time consuming it, so you should bring your women here, and I will protect them from these wandering evil souls."
"Mei, are there any items that can be used to create protection in this place?"

[Master, there are some items available for that purpose, but you currently lack enough golden jewels to purchase them, as their prices are exorbitant. If you use items below that grade, those wandering evil souls will destroy them instantly. Moreover, Nalan Shizhe is powerful enough to protect them, so you don’t need to waste jewels on that. If you are not confident in her strength to protect them all, you can bring Chi Yan and the others out of the beast space to protect them.]
Nalan Yushu asked him, "What are you waiting for, husband?"
"Alright, I’ll bring them here now." Zhang Fei immediately opened the portal to the training space.
Soon, the sight of so many women walking out of the training area astonished Nalan Shizhe and Nalan Huanzi.

From his main harem, Zhang Fei only summoned Zhang Lingxue, Ru Xue, Zhang Lin, Feng Yichen, Janette, Ling Long, Ling Xiannu, Tian Gongzhu, and Tian Jianxia because they were the only ones who had the darkness element. All the wives of his five clones, who were possessors of the darkness element, also joined them.

Zhang Fei also summoned all of his allies with the darkness element, such as Tang Ying, Qian Ying, Ju Yingzhi, Xin Yanluo, and many others. He decided to summon Tianguo and all the evil beasts out of the beast space, which shocked Nalan Shizhe and Nalan Huanzi further.

chapters.title: Chapter 1278: Sudden Change
paragraphs: ’Brother-in-law, how did you manage to find so many beautiful women? How did you manage to get them together and get along so well?’ Nalan Huanzi wondered in his heart. There wasn’t a hint of jealousy or lust in his eyes, and he simply admired the woman’s beauty.

Even though Ye Mingran had already told her that Ye Futian, Long Wuzhao, and several others captured those evil beasts for Zhang Fei, Nalan Shizhe was still quite shocked by their presence, especially since some of them possessed strength equal to hers, and some others were almost at her level.

’It is no surprise that he previously dared to venture into the Slaughter Blood Domain! These beasts are stronger than most asura demons, but not as strong as Shang Zhanluo.’ Nalan Shizhe turned her attention to Ling Xiannu. "Where did you meet her, Zhang Fei? She was born on the night when Yin reaches its peak, right?"

"You’re right, mother-in-law." Zhang Fei nodded at her. "Actually, the body she currently possesses is not her real body; instead, her past identity is that of a dark fairy whom I met in the Fairy Pond located in the Nine Stars Realm. Back then, I told my acquaintance, who was kidnapped by Yuan Xiajie, that I wanted to create the Nine Yin puppet, and she helped me find her body. Since she couldn’t wait to reshape her body, I allowed her to use it."

"I see." Nalan Shizhe then spread her aura throughout the area, preventing those wandering evil souls from approaching them. "You guys can pluck these Phantom Soul Lotuses to strengthen your souls, but you must do it one at a time. If you absorb several lotuses at once, the negative emotions in them will affect you, and no one can help you remove them."
"Yes." Immediately, everyone picked a lotus, sat down cross-legged, released their souls, and began to absorb it.
Although Nalan Shizhe was protecting them, Zhang Fei still ordered the evil beasts to stand guard around them, just in case something unexpected happened.

Nalan Yushu immediately joined them, but the black lotus in the souls of all Zhang Fei’s women confused Nalan Shizhe. "Those black lotuses come from the dual soul cultivation technique I got from Qing Qiu’er, but not everyone can learn it because it requires absolute and unwavering trust in their partners."
"I see." Nalan Shizhe nodded in understanding. "Aren’t you going to absorb these lotuses?"

Zhang Fei shook his head slightly. "My soul level is already at the half-perfection stage of the divine soul level, so these lotuses are less useful to me than those wandering evil souls. Moreover, their soul powers are far below mine, so I will let them absorb these lotuses."

"You’re right, these lotuses are indeed much more beneficial to them." Nalan Shizhe suddenly noticed something unusual about one of Zhang Fei’s women before pointing at Zhang Lingxue. "How can she absorb the lotus so quickly? Moreover, the technique she uses to absorb it is quite similar to our soul-devouring techniques."
"Haha." Zhang Fei softly laughed. "Mother-in-law, Lingxue is a new beast race, a Phoenix Devouring Beast to be precise, and she possesses some devouring abilities like your demon race."
Nalan Shizhe turned to Zhang Fei with a raised eyebrow. "Since when was there a Phoenix Devouring Beast race?"

"Lingxue is the only one of her kin." Zhang Fei’s answer confused Nalan Shizhe, as no living creature could be born without parents. "At first, she already had a few drops of phoenix origin bloodline given to her by Feng Yao, and I used a special method to turn her into a beast. Unexpectedly, that beast bloodline fused with her phoenix bloodline, and she turned into the Phoenix Devouring Beast because of it."
"Empress Huo?" Nalan Shizhe was surprised.

Zhang Fei nodded at her. "You may not realize it, but Feng Yao is a pure fire phoenix in this lifetime. She and Lingxue are like siblings, and she gave her the phoenix origin bloodline because of her talent in alchemy."
"So, your wife is also an alchemy god like you, right?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei looked at Zhang Lingxue with a smile as she began to devour several more lotuses. "Apart from her, there are eight other god-rank alchemists by my side, including Tian Shuixiang."

Nalan Shizhe massaged her forehead after hearing that. "I don’t understand how you managed to gather them all on your side, but I advise you not to be too conspicuous in this realm, and you should hide them from the public. There are countless sects and clans in this realm, and not all of them are good. Many of them are jealous and greedy, and they will join forces to attack your sect if it stands out too much. Moreover, those alchemists are not the only ones, right? I’m sure you still have people who are experts in other fields, such as blacksmithing and others, right?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded in response. "Otherwise, I wouldn’t build so many halls in my sect, right? Honestly, I’m starting to understand the situation in this realm, and I deliberately didn’t make them all appear in public. Like my alchemy hall, Lin Jingxia and Tian Shuixiang will be responsible for taking care of it. Lingxue and the others will not remain there; instead, they will perform alchemy in my private space, while the business hall handles the sale of our pills."

"Having two alchemy masters in one sect is normal, so you were correct to allow them to manage your alchemy hall. Moreover, Tian Shuixiang is Shang Zhui’s son, and he wouldn’t stand idly by if other races attacked his son. By the way, tell me more about your sect." Zhang Fei immediately explained to Nalan Shizhe about all the halls in the Moonlit Passion Sect, including the people responsible for each hall. "One or two caretakers per hall is the best choice, and people won’t be too wary of your sect if they end up hearing about everything."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei then asked her. "Do you have a beast tamer acquaintance, mother-in-law? I’ve built the hall for it, but I don’t have the right person to manage it yet. My sect is open to all races, so it doesn’t matter if your acquaintance is a demon."

"I don’t have any acquaintances with a beast tamer." Nalan Shizhe tried to search through her memories about it. "Instead, you should go to Ye Futian; I remember he has an acquaintance who is an expert in beast taming. Since you are his grand disciple, I’m sure he won’t mind introducing you to that person."

"My grandmaster is currently in the Three Mortal Realms, so I will wait for him to return before meeting him." Zhang Fei suddenly felt a change in the area around them, and the air temperature quickly decreased.
Nalan Shizhe, Nalan Wangzi, Nalan Huanzi, and the evil beasts also noticed the change. "Mother, this—"
"Yes." Shang Shizhe nodded to her first daughter. "This is one of the signs the thing will appear soon, but I can’t confirm its location before it appears."
"The thing?"

Nalan Wangzi immediately informed Zhang Fei. "The thing is the amalgamation of the wandering evil souls, and it usually appears in a different form with each appearance. Last time, it took the form of the Evil Three-Eyed Crow Beast, and its power was quite terrifying, especially its soul abilities."

"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Basically, it resembles the wandering soul demon I encountered in the Nine Hells Darkland Realm, but it is much stronger because the wandering evil soul in this domain possesses greater power."

"Look over there!" Zhang Fei and the others looked in the far east in the direction Nalan Huanzi was pointing, where a vortex of countless evil souls was starting to form. "Doesn’t this mean that thing will appear there, mother?"

"Yes." Nalan Shizhe took out a device, and a silverish-black light shot into the sky after she activated it, which was a danger signal for members of his race. "Zhang Fei, I have to go to that area and wait for that thing to appear; otherwise, my demon race members won’t be able to deal with it."
"It’s okay; you can go there, mother-in-law." Zhang Fei looked at those evil beasts. "Xie Heilong and the others should be strong to protect them from these wandering evil souls."
Nalan Shizhe agreed with him. "I’ll come back after I stop that thing."
Since they couldn’t fly in the forest, Zhang Fei opened the gate to the domain, and Nalan Shizhe immediately disappeared into it. "Aren’t you two going to follow her?"
"Brother-in-law, it’s no different from committing suicide if we follow our mother," Nalan Huanzi replied with a bitter smile.

Nalan Wangzi then told him. "Brother-in-law, that thing has power equal to our mother’s, so only she can handle it. Even if she is overwhelmed by it, the previous demon god will appear to help her, so you don’t need to worry about her."
Zhang Fei returned his gaze to the vortex that was getting bigger and stronger. ’Do you think my soul power is enough to deal with that thing, Mei?’
[Master, I can’t estimate it now, and we have to wait for the thing to appear first. As soon as it appears, I will scan its power, and I will tell you the results.]
’Alright.’ While waiting, Zhang Fei went hunting the wandering evil souls, but he didn’t go too far because most of them were stronger than him.

sentences.text: ’Brother-in-law, how did you manage to find so many beautiful women?
How did you manage to get them together and get along so well?’ Nalan Huanzi wondered in his heart.
There wasn’t a hint of jealousy or lust in his eyes, and he simply admired the woman’s beauty.

Even though Ye Mingran had already told her that Ye Futian, Long Wuzhao, and several others captured those evil beasts for Zhang Fei, Nalan Shizhe was still quite shocked by their presence, especially since some of them possessed strength equal to hers, and some others were almost at her level.
’It is no surprise that he previously dared to venture into the Slaughter Blood Domain!
These beasts are stronger than most asura demons, but not as strong as Shang Zhanluo.’ Nalan Shizhe turned her attention to Ling Xiannu.
"Where did you meet her, Zhang Fei?
She was born on the night when Yin reaches its peak, right?"
"You’re right, mother-in-law." Zhang Fei nodded at her.
"Actually, the body she currently possesses is not her real body; instead, her past identity is that of a dark fairy whom I met in the Fairy Pond located in the Nine Stars Realm.
Back then, I told my acquaintance, who was kidnapped by Yuan Xiajie, that I wanted to create the Nine Yin puppet, and she helped me find her body.
Since she couldn’t wait to reshape her body, I allowed her to use it."
"I see." Nalan Shizhe then spread her aura throughout the area, preventing those wandering evil souls from approaching them.
"You guys can pluck these Phantom Soul Lotuses to strengthen your souls, but you must do it one at a time.
If you absorb several lotuses at once, the negative emotions in them will affect you, and no one can help you remove them."
"Yes." Immediately, everyone picked a lotus, sat down cross-legged, released their souls, and began to absorb it.
Although Nalan Shizhe was protecting them, Zhang Fei still ordered the evil beasts to stand guard around them, just in case something unexpected happened.
Nalan Yushu immediately joined them, but the black lotus in the souls of all Zhang Fei’s women confused Nalan Shizhe.
"Those black lotuses come from the dual soul cultivation technique I got from Qing Qiu’er, but not everyone can learn it because it requires absolute and unwavering trust in their partners."
"I see." Nalan Shizhe nodded in understanding.
"Aren’t you going to absorb these lotuses?"
Zhang Fei shook his head slightly.
"My soul level is already at the half-perfection stage of the divine soul level, so these lotuses are less useful to me than those wandering evil souls.
Moreover, their soul powers are far below mine, so I will let them absorb these lotuses."
"You’re right, these lotuses are indeed much more beneficial to them." Nalan Shizhe suddenly noticed something unusual about one of Zhang Fei’s women before pointing at Zhang Lingxue.
"How can she absorb the lotus so quickly?
Moreover, the technique she uses to absorb it is quite similar to our soul-devouring techniques."
"Haha." Zhang Fei softly laughed.
"Mother-in-law, Lingxue is a new beast race, a Phoenix Devouring Beast to be precise, and she possesses some devouring abilities like your demon race."
Nalan Shizhe turned to Zhang Fei with a raised eyebrow.
"Since when was there a Phoenix Devouring Beast race?"
"Lingxue is the only one of her kin." Zhang Fei’s answer confused Nalan Shizhe, as no living creature could be born without parents.
"At first, she already had a few drops of phoenix origin bloodline given to her by Feng Yao, and I used a special method to turn her into a beast.
Unexpectedly, that beast bloodline fused with her phoenix bloodline, and she turned into the Phoenix Devouring Beast because of it."
"Empress Huo?" Nalan Shizhe was surprised.
Zhang Fei nodded at her.
"You may not realize it, but Feng Yao is a pure fire phoenix in this lifetime.
She and Lingxue are like siblings, and she gave her the phoenix origin bloodline because of her talent in alchemy."
"So, your wife is also an alchemy god like you, right?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei looked at Zhang Lingxue with a smile as she began to devour several more lotuses.
"Apart from her, there are eight other god-rank alchemists by my side, including Tian Shuixiang."
Nalan Shizhe massaged her forehead after hearing that.
"I don’t understand how you managed to gather them all on your side, but I advise you not to be too conspicuous in this realm, and you should hide them from the public.
There are countless sects and clans in this realm, and not all of them are good.
Many of them are jealous and greedy, and they will join forces to attack your sect if it stands out too much.
Moreover, those alchemists are not the only ones, right?
I’m sure you still have people who are experts in other fields, such as blacksmithing and others, right?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded in response.
"Otherwise, I wouldn’t build so many halls in my sect, right?
Honestly, I’m starting to understand the situation in this realm, and I deliberately didn’t make them all appear in public.
Like my alchemy hall, Lin Jingxia and Tian Shuixiang will be responsible for taking care of it.
Lingxue and the others will not remain there; instead, they will perform alchemy in my private space, while the business hall handles the sale of our pills."
"Having two alchemy masters in one sect is normal, so you were correct to allow them to manage your alchemy hall.
Moreover, Tian Shuixiang is Shang Zhui’s son, and he wouldn’t stand idly by if other races attacked his son.
By the way, tell me more about your sect." Zhang Fei immediately explained to Nalan Shizhe about all the halls in the Moonlit Passion Sect, including the people responsible for each hall.
"One or two caretakers per hall is the best choice, and people won’t be too wary of your sect if they end up hearing about everything."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei then asked her.
"Do you have a beast tamer acquaintance, mother-in-law?
I’ve built the hall for it, but I don’t have the right person to manage it yet.
My sect is open to all races, so it doesn’t matter if your acquaintance is a demon."
"I don’t have any acquaintances with a beast tamer." Nalan Shizhe tried to search through her memories about it.
"Instead, you should go to Ye Futian; I remember he has an acquaintance who is an expert in beast taming.
Since you are his grand disciple, I’m sure he won’t mind introducing you to that person."

"My grandmaster is currently in the Three Mortal Realms, so I will wait for him to return before meeting him." Zhang Fei suddenly felt a change in the area around them, and the air temperature quickly decreased.
Nalan Shizhe, Nalan Wangzi, Nalan Huanzi, and the evil beasts also noticed the change.
"Mother, this—"
"Yes." Shang Shizhe nodded to her first daughter.
"This is one of the signs the thing will appear soon, but I can’t confirm its location before it appears."
"The thing?"
Nalan Wangzi immediately informed Zhang Fei.
"The thing is the amalgamation of the wandering evil souls, and it usually appears in a different form with each appearance.
Last time, it took the form of the Evil Three-Eyed Crow Beast, and its power was quite terrifying, especially its soul abilities."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.
"Basically, it resembles the wandering soul demon I encountered in the Nine Hells Darkland Realm, but it is much stronger because the wandering evil soul in this domain possesses greater power."
"Look over there!" Zhang Fei and the others looked in the far east in the direction Nalan Huanzi was pointing, where a vortex of countless evil souls was starting to form.
"Doesn’t this mean that thing will appear there, mother?"
"Yes." Nalan Shizhe took out a device, and a silverish-black light shot into the sky after she activated it, which was a danger signal for members of his race.
"Zhang Fei, I have to go to that area and wait for that thing to appear; otherwise, my demon race members won’t be able to deal with it."
"It’s okay; you can go there, mother-in-law." Zhang Fei looked at those evil beasts.
"Xie Heilong and the others should be strong to protect them from these wandering evil souls."
Nalan Shizhe agreed with him.
"I’ll come back after I stop that thing."
Since they couldn’t fly in the forest, Zhang Fei opened the gate to the domain, and Nalan Shizhe immediately disappeared into it.
"Aren’t you two going to follow her?"
"Brother-in-law, it’s no different from committing suicide if we follow our mother," Nalan Huanzi replied with a bitter smile.
Nalan Wangzi then told him.
"Brother-in-law, that thing has power equal to our mother’s, so only she can handle it.
Even if she is overwhelmed by it, the previous demon god will appear to help her, so you don’t need to worry about her."
Zhang Fei returned his gaze to the vortex that was getting bigger and stronger. ’Do you think my soul power is enough to deal with that thing, Mei?’
[Master, I can’t estimate it now, and we have to wait for the thing to appear first.
As soon as it appears, I will scan its power, and I will tell you the results.]
’Alright.’ While waiting, Zhang Fei went hunting the wandering evil souls, but he didn’t go too far because most of them were stronger than him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1279: The Soul Creature
paragraphs: Nalan Shizhe was already not far from the location of the soul vortex, and five elders of the soul-devouring race were standing behind her. "Have you evacuated the members of our race who live in this area?"
"As soon as this soul vortex formed, they already realized that the creature would appear soon, so they hurriedly fled this area." A male demon answered her.

"That’s good." Nalan Shizhe exhaled with a sense of relief. "All of you must prepare, as the creature this time will likely be stronger than the last one. If that is true, the battle this time will be even tougher, and the impact will probably change the situation in our domain forever."
"We are waiting for your signal, Demon God."
Nalan Shizhe nodded to them before turning his head to the side with a frown, as did those elders. Soon, Zhang Fei [1] arrived at their side. "Why did you come here?"

"I was curious about the creature, so I decided to come here, mother-in-law." The five elders were stunned by the way Zhang Fei addressed Nalan Shizhe, as they knew that Nalan Wangzi was not married yet, and they also did not know that Nalan Yushu had returned.
"You—"
"Who is this young demon, Demon God? Why did he address you as his mother-in-law?" A female elder curiously asked while maintaining a respectful attitude.
"His name is Zhang Fei, and he is indeed my son-in-law." Nalan Shizhe’s revelation further confused the five elders. "He’s not Wangzi’s husband but Yushu’s."
"What?" The five elders exclaimed in shock. "Is the second princess really back, Demon God?"
Nalan Shizhe confirmed that with a nod. "Zhang Fei freed her soul from the Star Tower and helped her to reshape her body, and they have been husband and wife ever since."
Hearing that, the five elders looked at Zhang Fei [1] before cupping their hands to him. "Thank you for freeing our second princess from the Star Tower and helping her reshape her body, Prince. We—"

"No need." Zhang Fei [1] stopped them, but he also felt a little strange hearing them address him as their prince. "Honestly, I accidentally met Yushu, and I freed her from the tower for some reason. However, our relationship gradually changed, and she is my wife now. Even though I am her husband, I hope you guys stop addressing me as a prince, as I’m not used to that. Instead, you can address me with something else."

Naturally, the five elders did not dare to do that because Zhang Fei [1] was their second princess’s husband, so they turned to Nalan Shizhe, who nodded to them. "In that case, we will address you as a young master from now on."
"That’s good." Zhang Fei [1] nodded in satisfaction and then asked Nalan Shizhe. "How long until the creature appears, mother-in-law?"
Nalan Shizhe pointed to the soul vortex. "These evil souls are starting to merge into one, and the creature will appear once the vortex disappears."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] looked at the vortex with a frown. "Can’t we stop these evil souls before they finish merging?"

"Look at this." Nalan Shizhe flicked her finger forward, and a sizable darkness ball shot towards the vortex, but it disappeared before it reached the vortex. "There is an invisible barrier that surrounds the vortex, and it instantly dispels my attack."

The five elders were shocked when Zhang Fei [1] activated his soul domain and spread it towards the soul vortex, but his gaze only focused on the vortex, and he took out the abyssal demon halberd as his real body using the demon extermination sword.
"What are you going to do?" Nalan Shizhe asked with raised eyebrows.

"Mother-in-law, you can’t see that invisible barrier, but I can see it clearly." The five elders shifted back and stared at Zhang Fei [1] in shock as he used his light element, as no demon had it. "Let me show it to you."
Even though he was using a halberd, Zhang Fei [1] slashed it like he was holding a sword, and a crescent sword qi mixed with his light element hurtled towards the vortex.
Nalan Shizhe watched Zhang Fei [1]’s attack with a serious look. To her shock, his attack did not disappear; instead, she and the five elders heard a screeching voice full of pain.
*Screee*
Soon, a giant bloody red eye appeared right in front of the vortex, and there were two soul wings on both sides, which shocked Nalan Shizhe and the five elders.
"Eye demon!" One of the elders shouted.
"Demon god!"

The eye demon immediately flew away, but Nalan Shizhe hurriedly flew to chase after it. She made several gestures with her hands, and a giant mouth full of sharp teeth appeared in front of the eye demon and devoured it instantly.
Thereafter, Nalan Shizhe returned to Zhang Fei [1]’s side again. "I never expected that the Jiu Mozu would infiltrate one of his men into my domain, which means he already knows about you now."

"It’s okay; sooner or later, I will also meet him, as one of his subordinates is in my hands now." Nalan Shizhe turned to Zhang Fei [1], who immediately put away the halberd. "I managed to capture Ma Youling some time ago, and she was one of the nine demons beside him. Even though he learned about me from the eye demon moments ago, I didn’t reveal my true form, ensuring that he would never be able to find me. Since there’s no one else blocking us, then—"

"Too late." Nalan Shizhe pointed to the soul vortex that was beginning to dissipate. "The creature will appear soon, and its strength is clearly higher than last time. Therefore, you should go now, and we will handle it, or you will die if it targets you."
After saying that, Nalan Shizhe immediately led the five elders to fly into the sky, and they surrounded the area while using their abilities, creating a barrier to isolate it.
Zhang Fei [1] did not leave immediately, but he entered an invisible state and flew a little away to monitor the situation.
Soon, the vortex completely disappeared, but a soul creature that looked more like a grey three-horned behemoth appeared there before attacking Nalan Shizhe and the others.

Nalan Shizhe attempted to block the soul creature’s attack, but its attack pushed her back. The five elders immediately moved to help her, but they were also blown away by the soul attack released by the creature.
’What about the creature’s strength, Mei?’

[Master, that creature’s strength is equivalent to Nalan Shizhe in the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable, but its soul power is far below yours, around the saint soul level rank. Therefore, you can attack it using soul attacks, but you should not get too close to it. I suggest you bring all your clones here, and all of you attack it in unison.]

Zhang Fei [1] immediately agreed with Mei and summoned his other three clones, as his fourth clone was still at the bottom of the Blood Sea to monitor Tian Shuixiang’s situation. All of them immediately used the reversal mirror technique they learned from Shang Ziyuan, and they summoned five different mirrors.

Zhang Fei [5] didn’t move from his spot and held the hilt of the Sky-Severing Sword, which he borrowed from Xian Xianqin. "Ling, I know I’m not your master, but I need your help to get rid of that soul creature."

"Hmm?" Ling, the spirit of the Sky-Severing Sword, immediately emerged from within the sword. "Heh! That soul creature is indeed powerful, but it’s far too weak compared to the one my creator faced in the past."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [5] was surprised a bit.

"All living creatures in our era are much stronger than those from this era; not even those people from the ancient era can fight them." Zhang Fei [5] became increasingly curious about the identities of Ling and Tiankong Changqiong. "You are right; my creator was one of the primordials, but he died long ago. Just like him, Tian Huangjin was once a primordial, and he was the first ancestor of the winged race. Used the last sub-technique of the Heaven-Severing Sword Technique now, and you will understand my true power."

"Alright." Zhang Fei [5] activated his sword qi and light qi simultaneously before channeling them into the Sky-Severing Sword. Soon, a golden sword appeared above him, but its size was not as large as when he used it in the Moon Illusion Domain. "Is it enough to attack that soul creature?"
"Hmm?" Ling looked up at the golden sword before nodding. "I think it’s enough since you will use my sword, so you can attack that soul creature now. Attack it now!"
"Alright." Zhang Fei [5] first signaled Nalan Shizhe and the others to move away before slashing the Sky-Severing Sword forward. "Final move: Sever the Heavenly Path!"
Not far from the creature, the other clones were already holding their respective weapons, and they immediately used the last sub-technique of the Forgotten Sword Technique.
The golden sword quickly rushed towards the soul creature, followed by four flurries of petals, formed from sword intent, that bloomed from nothing.
"Move! You will be affected by those attacks!" Nalan Shizhe shouted as she flew away, followed by the five elders of the soul-devouring race.
The soul creature wanted to chase them, but one of the flurries of petals directly hit its body, causing it to release a loud roar that attacked the soul.
*Roar*

chapters.title: Chapter 1280: Jiu Mozu’s Sudden Arrival
paragraphs: Since Zhang Fei’s three clones were not far from the soul creature, its attack reached them. Fortunately, they had used the reversal mirror technique, and they reversed its soul attacks.

The soul creature staggered backwards in dizziness after being hit by its own attacks. Not long after, two flurries of petals directly hit it, causing it to roar in pain again and the evil souls that formed its body to begin to scatter.

However, many soul threads come out of the soul creature’s body and pull those evil souls back, making it whole again. It looked at Zhang Fei [5]’s golden sword that hurtled toward it, and it launched an attack toward the sword before the two collided.
Zhang Fei [5]’s golden sword instantly shattered the soul creature’s attack and kept hurtling toward it, but it suddenly disappeared from its spot, causing his attack to miss its target.

Zhang Fei [5] and the others did not stay in their spots; instead, they teleported repeatedly as the soul creature tried to attack them as soon as it reappeared. They did not expect that it could see them, even though they were still in an invisible state.
Seeing that, Nalan Shizhe led the elders to block the soul creature, but it ignored them and focused on chasing them.

"Use your soul-devouring soul technique!" The five elders followed Nalan Shizhe’s orders, and six giant mouths appeared to surround the soul creature before devouring the evil souls that formed its body.

Annoyed by that, the soul creature fired several soul attacks at them. However, Zhang Fei’s four clones moved in front of them and reflected its attacks using their mirror reversal techniques, causing it to stagger backwards in dizziness after being hit by its own attacks again.
Nalan Shizhe spoke straight away. "Zhang Fei! That soul creature is clearly targeting you and can see your invisibility, so you should leave and leave the rest to us."

"Mother-in-law, that soul creature’s attack is quite powerful, and you guys won’t be able to withstand it. Moreover, its speed isn’t as fast as mine, so you don’t need to worry about me." Zhang Fei [5] and the other three clones attacked the creature again. "Last move! Ashen Bloom!"
Seeing the four flurries of petals rushing toward it, the soul creature immediately flew away to avoid them, especially after it was hit by the same attack three times before.
The Soul creature suddenly disappeared again, just like before, but it was not difficult for Zhang Fei [5] to track its location. He pointed in one direction. "Attack that area."
Nalan Shizhe and the elders directed their attacks in that direction, followed by those of Zhang Fei [5] and the other clones. However, the soul creature quickly fled again, dodging their attacks.
Zhang Fei [5] furrowed his brows. "We can’t attack the soul creature directly, and we have to think of a way to absorb the evil soul that forms its body first, which will weaken it."

"I agree." Nalan Shizhe turned to her five subordinates. "We must approach the soul creature, but we must also keep our distance from it to avoid its soul attacks. If its soul attacks hit us, it will definitely absorb our strength."
"Yes, Demon God."
Nalan Shizhe suddenly frowned after she felt something enter her domain. "Zhang Fei! Leave now!"
[Master! You must leave now and take all your clones!] Mei also shouted into Zhang Fei [5]’s mind.

Hearing their panic, Zhang Fei [5] and the other clones swiftly entered his soul world without thinking twice. Not long after they disappeared, Jiu Mozu and his eight subordinates arrived not far from the place.
"Hahahaha!" Jiu Mozu laughed seeing Nalan Shizhe’s expression. "Why are you looking at me like that, Soul-Devouring Demon God?"
"You bastard!" Nalan Shizhe shouted at him. "You deliberately sent one of your subordinates into my domain to cause trouble."
"Hehehe." Jiu Mozu casually laughed in response. "Where did you hide that young demon? If you hand him over to me, I will help you to defeat that soul creature."

"Hehe." Nalan Wangzi giggled. "I told you before, you don’t need to worry about them; the previous demon god will appear if they are unable to handle that creature."
