chapters.title: Chapter 1281: Soul-Devouring Demonic Seal
paragraphs: Nalan Shizhe and the five elders were increasingly overwhelmed in stopping the soul creature, especially after it had absorbed many wandering evil souls to increase its strength.
"Demon God! We must use that." A male elder spoke with a grim expression.

Nalan Shizhe had considered using the strongest technique of her soul-devouring race, but she was still reluctant to use it because it would drain too much of her strength, and it would take a long time for her to recover to her peak.
After thinking about it, Nalan Shizhe decided to use the strongest technique of their race. "Let’s do it."
"Yes!" The five elders immediately moved behind Nalan Shizhe, touched her back, and channeled their demon power into her body.

In the distance, Jiu Yaoming, who was still busy looking for Zhang Fei, immediately stopped and looked in their direction. ’Nalan Shizhe finally decided to use that, huh? Once she uses it, she will be weakened and vulnerable for quite a while, and she will become an easy target for the other demon gods. Unfortunately, Mo Shentian and Shang Zhanluo are away, so they are unlikely to attack her anytime soon. The last person who will likely attack her is the Torture Demon God, Ku Shenzu.’
Jiu Yaoming ignored Nalan Shizhe and continued her search for Zhang Fei, and she went to the Wailing Soul Forest.

After receiving a significant amount of demon power from the five elders, Nalan Shizhe immediately made several hand gestures while chanting an incantation. The air temperature throughout the domain dropped rapidly, which made those wandering evil souls scatter in various directions, especially those in that area.
Nalan Shizhe’s red eyes turned grey, and a pitch-black aura enveloped her body. "Soul-Devouring Demon Domain!"
A giant transparent mouth shot out and lunged towards the soul creature, devouring it whole. The soul creature struggled to escape from it, but all its attacks were nullified by the mouth.
"Phew." Nalan Shizhe sighed in relief, then proceeded to make several other gestures. "Soul-Devouring Demonic Seal!"
Quickly, the giant transparent mouth shrank rapidly before disappearing completely along with the soul creature, making the situation in their domain return to normal.

The five elders withdrew their demon power, and a female demon hurriedly supported Nalan Shizhe, who looked exhausted after using both techniques. "We can’t go on like this, and I have to think of something to kill that creature, or it will keep coming back."

"How are we supposed to kill it, Demon God?" The female elder asked. "As long as these wandering evil souls exist in this domain, that soul creature will continue to appear. Even the previous demon god had tried various ways to kill it, but he never succeeded, and he always used the same technique to repel it."

Nalan Shizhe released a soft sigh before looking at the surrounding area. "The existence of these wandering evil souls is like a double-edged sword for our race. They can protect us against the other demon races, but they also bring disaster upon us, particularly whenever that soul creature appears. The only way to stop this situation from recurring is to eliminate them, but we will lose our protectors. That’s why the previous demon god never thought about getting rid of them, and I would never think of doing it either. Let’s go back for now and never mention that kid, as Jiu Mozu still watches over our domain through Jiu Yaoming."
"Yes, Demon God."
In the forest, Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Huanzi let out sighs of relief when Zhang Fei informed them that their mother had successfully eliminated the soul creature.

"Even though she succeeded in eliminating the soul creature, she lost a lot of her strength in doing so, and she’s in a weakened state now." Zhang Fei then handed some pills to Nalan Huanzi. "Brother-in-law, I’ll send you out of this forest, and you can give these pills to her. If she’s in this condition, I’m afraid the other demon gods will take advantage of the situation to attack your demon race. Although these pills can help her recover her qi, they can’t help her recover her demon power, so she must recover it herself."

After he received the pills, Zhang Fei immediately opened a gate leading to the Slaughter Blood Domain because it was the closest to the Soul Devouring Domain, and Nalan Huanzi hurriedly disappeared into it.
Zhang Fei closed the gate and looked towards the sky. "Jiu Yaoming is right above us."

"Are you thinking of doing something to her, brother-in-law?" Nalan Wangzi asked him. "Her eyes can see through your invisibility, so I think it’s too risky for you to confront her head-on. Furthermore, these people are still absorbing the lotuses, so I think it would be better if you wait for them to finish first, and you can think of other ways to deal with her while they wait."

"Actually, I only need to touch Jia Youming once, and I can do something to her right then and there." Nalan Wangzi naturally knew what Zhang Fei meant. "Forget it; I will wait for them to finish absorbing these lotuses before making a decision about her."

"I think that would be much better." Nalan Wangzi then pulled Zhang Fei away. "Rather than having both of us idle and these evil beasts protecting them, I will accompany you to absorb these wandering souls."

Upon returning to his domain, Nalan Huanzi hurriedly went to see his mother. He handed her all the pills and informed her of Zhang Fei’s previous message. "You should swallow these pills now, mother."

"I know." Nalan Shizhe immediately sat cross-legged on the bed and swallowed the pills one by one. Within moments, she could feel her Qi recovering rapidly, and she tried to absorb Qi from the air to speed up her recovery. To her surprise, her absorption rate was also much faster than usual, which excited her. ’Sigh! A god-rank alchemist is indeed different, and the effect of his pills is really powerful. Fortunately, he is my son-in-law, and he should be able to help my demon race become stronger.’
"How did it go, mother?" Nalan Huanzi asked as soon as his mother opened her eyes.

"Phew." Nalan Shizhe exhaled with a sense of relief. "His pills are unmatched, and we won’t be able to find them anywhere else. My qi absorption rate has become several times faster than before, and the qi in my body has also recovered by half. Since he doesn’t have pills to help me absorb demon power, I’ll try to recover it myself. Alright, you can go now, and I will start my seclusion. Since Jiu Yaoming is still in our domain, I’m sure he won’t come back here, and you don’t need to mention him to anyone."
"Yes, Mother."
After Nalan Huanzi left, Nalan Shizhe sealed her room and began her seclusion.

After searching for several days, Mo Shentian and his third son, Mo Tianqi, finally arrived at a remote area in the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain. Although the area was surrounded by many graves, like the other areas, they saw a rather beautiful pond in the center. However, a barrier prevented them from approaching, and it pushed them back when they tried to touch it.
"How strong is the female evil beast really, father?" Mo Tianqi asked.
Mo Shentian released a soft sigh. "How strong do you think she would be if the four perils couldn’t control her?"
"Huh?" Mo Tianqi looked at his father in shock. "Are the four of them really unable to control her, father?"

"Stop talking about her because she can hear you; otherwise, she will capture you, and I won’t be able to save you from her." Mo Shentian then walked in front of the barrier. "Dong Xuanyin, I know you are there, and I came here to ask for your help. If you are willing to help me, I will fulfill your one request, no matter what it is."
Mo Tianqi was stunned when he heard that. ’Why did my father go that far by promising like that?’
"I’m not interested in that, so you can take your stupid son away." Dong Xuanyin answered him without showing herself.
Mo Tianqi’s face darkened upon hearing that, but Mo Shentian shot him a sharp glance, signaling for him to control himself.

Mo Shentian then spoke to Dong Xuanyin again. "Won’t you be interested in the ten-tailed fox’s successor, Xuanyin? I haven’t met Zhang Fei in person, but I heard he has arrived in our realm, and several races are looking for him now. If you are willing to help me achieve my goal, I will help you to get him, and you can do whatever you want to him."

"Hahaha!" Dong Xuanyin laughed heartily, but she still had no intention of meeting Mo Shentian. "Do you think I don’t know that the ten-tailed fox’s successor has arrived in this realm? If I want to get him, I don’t need your help to find him, and I can go find him myself. Therefore, you better leave my place now, or I will teach you a lesson far more severe than in the past."

Mo Shentian frowned at that, as not many dared to threaten him. However, he was fully aware of Dong Xuanyin’s strength and abilities, and he also urgently needed her help to find Wu Mian’s true body, so he swallowed his anger immediately. "Xuanyin, I—"
*Boom*
The water in the pond immediately exploded, followed by Dong Xuanyin’s thunderous voice. "Leave!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1284: The Lotus Start To Bloom
paragraphs: "Don’t worry, okay? I guarantee they won’t recognize him." Zhang Fei smirked after that. "I’m more curious about Mo Taizi’s reaction if he finds out that his wife is actually a man."

"Hahaha!" Nalan Wangzi burst into laughter. "Your idea is truly insane, you know? Only you and your demon race have such an ability! I’m sure Mo Taizi will regret it for the rest of his life if he finds out that Nalan Qinghe is actually a man!"

Zhang Fei pulled Nalan Wangzi onto his lap, hugged her waist, and kissed her. "Since Mo Taizi dares to want my woman, I must teach him a lesson, right? Unfortunately, I don’t have the ability to face his father yet, so I used such a method to teach him a lesson. Once I surpass his father, I will do something about them, and I will unite the demon races under me."
"Hmm?" Nalan Wangzi looked at him with surprise. "Do you really want to unite all the demon races?"

Zhang Fei nodded at her. "To bring peace back to this universe, I have no choice but to unite all races. The beast race has already united under Long Wuzhao, so I don’t need to worry too much about them. Although some of the natural races don’t expect my existence, many of them are waiting for the return of the ten-tailed fox, so I think uniting them won’t be too difficult. The most difficult to unite are the human and demon races, as many of them are too ambitious to control their race, for example, Mo Shentian."
Nalan Wangzi agreed with that. "What about the Winged Race?"

"I don’t have much information about the Winged Race yet." Zhang Fei replied while shaking his head. "However, I have the support of Tian Huangjin and several grand elders, and Xu Ling’er is the reincarnation of their first ancestor. Although some grand elders, such as Tian Ziye, prefer not to be subordinate to anyone, I believe they will not be as troublesome as the human and demon races."
"You’re right about them." Nalan Wangzi moved on to something else. "You forgot about another race, the demihuman race. Their numbers are substantial in the Heavenly Mistveil Domain."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei had almost forgotten about the demihuman race, as he had never encountered any members of that race again, except for the ones in the Wasteland Realm in the past. "How strong are they compared to the beast and demon races?"

"The demihuman race’s strength is between that of the beast and human races, but some of them are as strong as Mo Shentian, especially some of their leaders." Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow, prompting Nalan Wangzi to explain a few things to him. "That’s all I know, but you can ask Long Wuzhao or Empress Huo for more. Since your sect doesn’t have members from their race yet, I think you can try going to their domain. They don’t like humans or other races, but they like the beast race, so I believe they won’t be hostile to you if you use your half-fox form there."

Zhang Fei was interested in visiting the demihuman race in the Heavenly Mistveil Domain, but it was not an urgent matter, and he could meet them at any time in the future. "I have many problems at hand, so I won’t meet them for now, and I will meet them when I’m strong."

"Your main problem for now is Jia Zizhen and Jia Mozu, especially since both of them already know about your existence. Mo Shentian should already know about you from the fairy king, as the two of them are in cahoots. I’m sure he won’t make a move on you himself, but he will probably send his subordinates to hunt you down soon, so you have to be more wary of him." Nalan Wangzi then looked at Morgana and Oz the First among those people. "That man is a celestial demon, but his strength and demon rank are still low, so he won’t be able to help you for now."
"You’re right, Mo Shentian—" Zhang Fei didn’t continue when he saw a Phantom Soul Lotus shining brightly. "Is it as I think, Wangzi?"

"Quickly! Send them back to your space, brother-in-law! The Phantom Soul Lotus will soon fully bloom into a nine-petal lotus, at which point the Soul Wraith Lord will appear." After Nalan Wangzi got off his lap, Zhang Fei asked them to stop absorbing the lotus, and he sent them back to the training space afterwards.
"What happened? Why did you suddenly stop us?" Yao Qilin asked him in confusion.

"Look at that." Yao Qilin looked at the Phantom Soul Lotus, which had floated in midair. "The Soul Wraith Lord will appear once the lotus fully blooms, and its strength is equal to, or even stronger than, my mother’s. If they stay here, they will die in his hands."

As the lotus glowed brighter, Zhang Fei grabbed Nalan Wangzi and Yao Qilin by the shoulders, leading them away from the area. He didn’t have clear information about the Soul Wraith Lord’s strength and abilities, but he had already tested the Blood Tree King’s strength before, so he didn’t want to risk getting too close to that location.

Xie Heilong and the others followed them, but Zhang Fei immediately sent them into his best space, allowing him to borrow their strength. He then took the two women into the invisible state once they were far enough from the heart of the forest, waiting for the Phantom Soul Lotus to fully bloom.

Nalan Wangzi wanted to contact her mother for help, but Zhang Fei forbade her because Nalan Shizhe was in a weakened state after using both techniques to stop the soul creature earlier. He wasn’t too worried about the Soul Wraith Lord, as he could take them to his soul world directly if the situation got out of hand.

As time passed by, the Phantom Soul Lotus glowed brighter and brighter, and it continued to rotate in midair, attracting all the wandering evil souls in the area. In a few minutes, countless wandering evil souls had gathered around the lotus, making the air temperature in the area completely cold.
"How long before the lotus blooms?"
Nalan Wangzi shook her head at Zhang Fei. "This is my first time watching the lotus bloom, so I don’t know how long it will take for it to fully bloom."
"Let’s wait then." Zhang Fei sighed.

Up in the sky, Jiu Yaoming frowned after sensing the changes in the Wailing Soul Forest, and she hurriedly returned to the forest. Although she couldn’t see the forest’s interior due to the natural formations, she could still sense the changes taking place within.

"What’s going on here? Why is this area of the forest colder than the others? Moreover, I sense a lot of movement inside, which I believe is caused by the wandering evil souls." Jiu Yaoming landed in front of the forest, but she did not immediately enter it because she did not understand the situation inside. "Heh! Mere wandering evil souls won’t be able to stop me, so I’ll go inside now, and I hope I can find something interesting inside."

After she summoned several eyes, Jiu Yaoming immediately moved into the forest, but she was confronted by several formations. With her abilities as an eye demon, it wasn’t too difficult for her to get past those traps, and she moved into the depth of the forest faster.
[Master, Jiu Yaoming entered this forest, and she moved toward your location really fast.]
’Hmm?’ Zhang Fei immediately looked at the map and found Jiu Yaoming’s name on it. ’How did she manage to avoid those traps? Could it be because of her eye abilities?’

[I think so, Master. Unfortunately, we don’t have any information on her abilities yet, but I think she has some abilities that might be useful to you, and you could try mimicking her abilities if you find anything interesting about her abilities.]
Zhang Fei himself had not added to his collection of demon abilities in his demon mimicry for a long time, and Jiu Yaoming’s ability to avoid those natural traps piqued his interest.

Zhang Fei informed the two women beside him. "That female eye demon is on her way here, and I want you to help me capture her, Qilin. Her cultivation is one minor stage below yours, so you should have no trouble capturing her."
"Hmm?" Yao Qilin turned to him in surprise. "Do you want to do something to her?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "She’s one of the Jiu Mozu’s nine direct subordinates, so I want to use her to spy on him, and I also have other plans for her."
"Alright." Yao Qilin readily agreed. "Tell me when she gets close to our location, and I’ll immediately move to capture her."

Zhang Fei returned his gaze to the Phantom Soul Lotus, but it still showed no signs of fully blooming. However, the number of wandering evil souls gathering around it was increasing, making the area crowded.

As they waited, Zhang Fei continued to monitor Jiu Yaoming’s movements on the map, and the distance between them continued to shrink rapidly. Sometime later, he saw that the female demon was getting closer to their location, and he immediately told Yao Qilin about her position.
Yao Qilin did not move from her spot, but Zhang Fei took Nalan Wangzi away from her side, as Jiu Yaoming’s eye abilities could see through his invisibility.

chapters.title: Chapter 1285: Demon-Piercing Eye
paragraphs: After waiting for quite a while, Zhang Fei found Jiu Yaoming already close to their location, and he immediately informed Yao Qilin about the female demon.
’Brother-in-law, the lotus is starting to bloom.’

’Yes.’ Zhang Fei thoughtfully looked at the lotus, which was glowing increasingly brightly. He could see that one petal had already opened, but he still had to wait for the remaining eight to open. ’I hope it doesn’t fully bloom before we take care of Jiu Yaoming, or her presence will be troublesome for us.’
’I hope so.’ Nalan Wangzi looked at another area. ’Jiu Yaoming is almost here, right?’
’She’ll be here soon.’ Zhang Fei took Nalan Wangzi further away so that Jiu Yaoming could not find them.

A few minutes later, Jiu Yaoming arrived at the heart of the forest, and she stopped as soon as she saw Yao Qilin casually sitting on a boulder. "How did you end up in this forest? Didn’t Long Wuzhao capture you and the other beast generals?"

"Haha." Yao Qilin laughed softly as she looked at her. "Do you think I’m that weak, little eye demon? Long Wuzhao almost captured me, but I managed to escape from him, and I hid in the abyss until the time was up. Thereafter, I escaped into this forest to hide and recover from my injury at that time."
"Hmm?" Jiu Yaoming looked distrustful of Yao Qilin.

"I wasn’t the only one who escaped, and there was still one more, but Fei Lian was hiding in another domain." Yao Qilin then pointed at the lotus. "I came here to look for it, as it can help me recover from my soul injury."
Jiu Yaoming looked at the lotus. "Huh? What luck! The Phantom Soul Lotus will soon fully bloom into a nine-petal lotus!"

"First come, first served!" Yao Qilin shouted at Jiu Yaoming as she released her aura to deter her, causing her to frown. "I may be injured, but you’re still no match for me. Even if Jiu Mozi were here, he wouldn’t dare to bother me because I’m Lord Qiongqi’s woman."

"This bitch! She deliberately used the name of one of the four perils to bully me!" Jiu Yaoming moved her eyeballs around to inspect the area, and she only approached Yao Qilin after she ensured everything was safe. "Did you know that the Soul Wraith Lord will appear once that lotus is in full bloom?"

"I’ve lived a lot longer than you; do you think I don’t know such a trivial matter?" Yao Qilin’s mocking response angered Jiu Yaoming, but she reconsidered attacking her due to her status and the disparity in their cultivation levels. "What brings an eye demon like you to this domain? Aren’t you afraid of provoking Nalan Shizhe’s anger?"

"Heh." Jiu Yaoming snorted at her. "Do you think Nalan Shizhe would dare attack me? She’s long known of my presence, but she didn’t even try to stop me. As for my affairs here, they’re none of your business."
"Hahaha!" Yao Qilin laughed mockingly. "What an ignorant and arrogant puny demon! Since you dare to be so arrogant in front of me, I’ll teach you a lesson."
"You—Gah!" Jiu Yaoming was knocked back several steps by her sudden attack, but Yao Qilin right away moved in front of her, preventing her from stabilizing herself. "Gah!"

"Gah!" Yao Qilin kicked Jiu Yaoming in the chest, sending her flying backwards. She spun around and retaliated against her, and the eyes flying around them fired several laser-like attacks at the female beast.

"Useless!" Yao Qilin waved her hand, and several bolts of dark lightning instantly countered Jiu Yaoming’s attacks, dispelling them all at once. She waved her hand once again, and some other bolts of dark lightning struck those eyes, paralyzing them. "Without your friends and demon god, you are just a useless and weakling demon."
After saying this, Yao Qilin moved as fast as lightning in front of Jiu Yaoming, strangled her neck, and punched her stomach.
"Gah!" Jiu Yaoming tried to attack her, but Yao Qilin’s dark lightning bolts electrocuted her first. "Argh!"
"Is this all you have?" Yao Qilin coldly asked.
"Argh!" Yao Qilin’s dark lightning bolts electrocuted Jiu Yaoming once again, making her hair messy. Even her dress was torn in several places, exposing her scorched skin. "Argh!"
"Heh!" Yao Qilin snorted, sealed Jiu Yaoming’s cultivation, and slammed her to the ground really hard.
"Gah!" Jiu Yaoming screamed in pain.
Yao Qilin stood by Jiu Yaoming’s side and stomped her right leg at her chest, causing her to spurt out a mouthful of blood. "Such a weak little demon, yet you dared to be arrogant in front of me."
"Cough... Cough..." Jiu Yaoming coughed up blood as soon as Yao Qilin removed her leg from her chest. "If you dare to kill me, my demon god will kill you!"

"Hahaha." Yao Qilin looked at her with disdain and disgust. "Even if your demon god borrows the power of the nine of you, Lord Qiongqi can still kill him without blinking, so your threats are useless. Honestly, I want to kill you, but you are lucky because someone needs you, so I will spare your life this time."
Jiu Yaoming was confused by that, but she froze and her eyes widened as soon as Zhang Fei and Nalan Wangzi appeared before them. "You—Mhmm."
Zhang Fei swiftly stuffed Jiu Yaoming’s mouth with a thick cloth as he squatted at her side. ’Show me her best eye abilities, Mei.’
[Alright.]
[Demon-Piercing Eye: It allows the user to see through all barriers—spatial, temporal, and illusory. No concealment or illusion technique can hide from its sight.]

[Demon-Prison Eye: The user’s gaze creates a dimension where all visible entities are trapped within an illusory reflection of themselves. Within it, the demons control what they perceive, including turning allies against each other or collapsing their sanity.]
[Thousand-Eyed Legion: Countless spectral eyes emerge from the demon’s body, each turning into an autonomous minion. They obey the master’s will and see through everything, sharing sight.]

’Shit! What will he do to me? How can I contact my demon god with my cultivation sealed by that bitch?’ Jiu Yaoming naturally wouldn’t be afraid of Zhang Fei if her cultivation wasn’t sealed, but she was in a helpless situation now, which made her afraid of him.

Zhang Fei ignored Jiu Yaoming’s expression and considered the options between her three abilities. ’Hmm? Her third ability is interesting, but I have the Demon Eye’s Orb, and I also have the familiar manipulation ability, so it’s not useful. Her second ability is almost the same as my illusion manipulation ability, so I don’t need it. Her first ability is the most useful for me because I can see through many things, especially barriers.’
[Ding]
[You succeeded in mimicking the Demon-Piercing Eye of an Eye Demon named Jiu Yaoming.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1286: Soul Wraith Lord
paragraphs: In the Heavenly Fiend Domain, Dong Xuanyin stood with a satisfied smile in front of the red corpse she had just killed. She squatted beside it and extracted its Blood Core, but she suddenly sensed a powerful aura flying at high speed toward her location. "Hehe! That Heavenly Fiend Demon God just noticed my actions, but he realized it too late."

Shortly after Dong Xuanyin disappeared, the Heavenly Fiend Demon God, Sha Mo, landed in the area. His face turned furious as soon as he saw the Infernal Fiend’s corpse, and his aura exploded, frightening the members of his race who were nearby.

"Bastard! Who dares to kill my pet? Come out, you coward!" Naturally, no one answered Sha Mo, making him even more furious. "Who exactly intruded into my domain and killed my pet? How could that person escape my surveillance? Furthermore, I’ve already used my fastest speed to get here, but I still lost track of that person. My pet’s Blood Core is extremely precious. Whoever killed it, I think there are only two possibilities. First, that person wants to sell the core. Second, that person wants to use it to help another demon break through to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks."

Since he couldn’t find anyone, Sha Mo immediately destroyed the corpse and ordered all his subordinates to search their own domains as well as some other domains, particularly those associated with black markets.

Sha Mo examined a nearby area and was relieved to discover numerous Infernal Fiends still alive. "Whoever designed the requirements for breaking through to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks is truly annoying! That person makes the demons continue to hunt my pets, and their numbers continue to decrease every year."
Thereafter, Sha Mo hurriedly left the area and returned to his palace, waiting for the results of his subordinates’ search.

On top of a tree trunk, Zhang Fei sat facing the lotus, accompanied by Nalan Wangzi and Yao Qilin on either side, with Jiu Yaoming standing beside them. They patiently waited for the lotus to fully bloom, but they felt the process slow down after the fifth petal opened.
"Aren’t you interested in eating her, brother-in-law?" Nalan Wangzi glanced at Jiu Yaoming.

"Even though she is powerful and has reached the Demon Saint Rank, I have no interest in her. For the time being, I intend to use her to monitor the Jiu Demon Clan, but I will do something to her in the future depending on the situation." Zhang Fei hugged Nalan Wangzi and briefly kissed her. "Instead of her, I’m more impatient to eat you, my dear sister-in-law."
"Hehehe." Nalan Wangzi giggled at that. "Then, you have to wait until I’m fully ready, but I won’t promise you when I’ll be ready."
Zhang Fei’s lips twitched slightly. "Little minx, you are mine alone; you must always remember that."
"Why don’t you ask her to release her Yin Qi by force, Master? Her Yin Qi is powerful, and it should be useful for you and your people." Yao Qilin spoke.

"Naturally, I’ve thought about that." Zhang Fei pointed to the lotus. "We will face the Soul Wraith Lord soon, so I can’t possibly tire her out now, right? Once we complete our tasks in this forest, I will harvest a significant amount of her Yin Qi for my people."
"Oh." Yao Qilin nodded slightly.
Zhang Fei kissed Yao Qilin while fondling her breasts. "As for me, I have you, Fei Lin, and all my wives."

"You’re a pervert!" Despite this, Yao Qilin seemed eager to dual cultivate with Zhang Fei, especially after they had done it repeatedly in the past half year at the pavilion. "This lotus takes too long to fully bloom."
"We have no other choice but to wait."

Dong Xuanyin flew into another domain with a joyful smile, as she was sure that Sha Mo must be enraged after finding his pet dead. She immediately ignored that and searched for Fei Lian in the domain.

"Why did she choose to hide in this domain? Did Zhang Fei order her to hide here?" After she discovered the location of Fei Lian and her subordinates, Dong Xuanyin flew at full speed towards their location.
Fei Lian, who was relaxing within a whirlwind, hurriedly opened her eyes as soon as she felt Dong Xuanyin’s aura.

"Shit! Who is coming here? This aura clearly belongs to an evil beast like me!" Fei Lian wanted to flee immediately, but Dong Xuanyin landed in front of her first, causing her to freeze in place. "Why... why are you here? Did they ask you to hunt us?"
"Hehe." Dong Xuanyin chuckled in response. "Do you think Taotie and the others can order me around? Actually, we’re both on the same side now, so you don’t need to be this afraid of me."
"What... what do you mean by that?" Dong Xuanyin took out the Infernal Blood Core and handed it to Fei Lian, leaving her dumbfounded. "This—"

"Zhang Fei asked you to look for the other three materials, right?" Fei Lian was even more stunned when she heard that name from Dong Xuanyin’s mouth. "Honestly, I’ve never met him in person, but I’m his ally. I know a few things he needs, including the three materials. You can bring this core to him in the Soul-Devouring Domain, so he only lacks the Demon Soul Elixir for his demon rank to break through."

Fei Lian put the core into her storage ring. "How can you be his ally if you’ve never met him? Furthermore, the four lords have always wanted your help, but you’ve always refused them; instead, you chose to help a young demon you still don’t know."

"You don’t need to concern yourself with my affairs, do you?" Fei Lian shivered when Dong Xuanyin’s eyes glowed. "As for the Demon Soul Elixir, I heard there is a witch demon active in the Nightshade Domain, so you should go there to look for her. However, I don’t know her or her character, and that demon race is famous for being difficult to deal with, so you should be careful when you go to see her."

Fei Lian naturally knew about the characters of the Witch Demon Race, and she really didn’t want to meet any of them. "Why don’t you help him search for the Demon Soul Elixir? You are stronger than me, and you have your special abilities, so your chances of getting the elixir are much greater. On the other hand, I will go to the Soul-Devouring Domain to find him, and I will hand over the core to him."

"Hmm?" Dong Xuanyin thought for some time before agreeing. "Alright, I will go to the Nightshade Domain to look for that witch demon, and you can find Zhang Fei in the Soul-Devouring domain. However, you must not tell him about me; do you understand?"
"I know." Dong Xuanyin disappeared directly after that, and Fei Lian spoke to her subordinates. "You guys wait for me here, and I will go to the Soul-Devouring domain."
"Yes, Master."
Sometime later, Fei Lian arrived at the Soul-Devouring Domain, and she immediately contacted Zhang Fei as she couldn’t track his location.

Soon, a portal appeared behind Fei Lian, and a hand quickly pulled her inside. When she came out again, she found herself in the forest. She then looked at Zhang Fei. "How can you move so fast? I just entered this domain, but you suddenly brought me here, and I can barely see the previous place."
"Haha." Zhang Fei used his aura to pull Fei Lian into his lap before kissing her. "We fought in the dungeon before, and you couldn’t catch up to me, remember? So, what are you doing here?"
"This." Fei Lian took out the Infernal Blood Core, surprising Zhang Fei and Nalan Wangzi.
Zhang Fei took the core from Fei Lian’s hand. "Where did you get it? How did you know that I was in this domain?"
"A female beast gave me the item, but I cannot disclose her identity." Zhang Fei furrowed his brows at Fei Lian. "She can find me wherever I hide, and she will beat me if I tell you about her."
"Master, I know—"
*Swoosh."
A massive shockwave suddenly swept toward them, and Zhang Fei carried them all away from their previous location. He looked ahead and found the lotus in full bloom. "Shit!"
"Look at that, brother-in-law!" Nalan Wangzi pointed at the vague figure of a giant that was slowly becoming clear. "It’s the Soul Wraith Lord!"
Zhang Fei nodded to her. "Mei, scan that creature!"
[Master, I can’t scan that creature’s status yet, so we have to wait for its figure to become fully clear first.]

"Wangzi, I can’t confirm the strength of this creature yet, but I believe it is very strong. I will send you away, and the four of us will deal with it." Nalan Wangzi did not argue and let Zhang Fei send her into the training space. "Get ready!"
Yao Qilin, Feli Lian, and Jiu Yaoming immediately became alert and took out their respective weapons.
Zhang Fei immediately summoned the demon extermination sword before using his absolute condition ability and the Soul Link to strengthen himself, and he used several of his other abilities.
Zhang Fei gripped the hilt of the demon extermination sword tightly, as his eyes never left the figure of the Soul Wraith Lord that was becoming increasingly clear.
Soon, the Soul Wraith Lord’s figure was completely clear, but it immediately released an angry roar.
*Roar*

chapters.title: Chapter 1287: Facing The Enemies
paragraphs: Fortunately, Zhang Fei had already activated his soul domain and the five mirrors from the Reversal Mirror Reversal Technique; otherwise, the Soul Wraith Lord’s soul attack would have affected the three female demons.
"How did your strength increase so rapidly, master?"
Fei Lian nodded in agreement with Yao Qilin. "Your strength suddenly became on par with us."

"There are many things you two don’t know about me." Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow as soon as the Soul Wraith Lord ordered the wandering evil souls to attack them. "Let’s talk later! We have to get rid of these troublesome souls."
"Yes." Zhang Fei and the three female beasts ran away while scattering in four different directions, splitting the group of wandering evil souls into four.
As Zhang Fei expected, the Soul Wraith Lord did not chase after them, and it stayed where it was to protect the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus.

Zhang Fei activated the Demon-Piercing Eye that he mimicked from Jiu Yaoming to avoid those natural traps, and he lured the wandering evil souls that chased him to a more open area. After he arrived at the right area, he activated his light element, forcing them to stop. Then, he used the Exorcismus ability to attack them, and he also used the Soul Light Purification Ability to weaken them.
*Shriek... Shriek... Shriek...*

The wandering evil souls shrieked as countless light rays rained down on them from above, and most of them tried to escape from the area. However, Zhang Fei created light walls, confining them and preventing them from escaping.

From the beginning, Zhang Fei could have fought the wandering evil souls by borrowing the power of all the evil beasts in his beast space through the soul link, but he didn’t intend to do that before because he needed their soul powers to strengthen his.
*Roar*

A loud roar echoed in the forest as soon as Zhang Fei used the Demon King’s Roar, instilling fear and confusion among those wandering evil souls. Since there were quite a lot of enemies, he decided to summon his four clones, and all of them used the Demon King’s Roar once again, causing them to become even more afraid and confused.
After that, Zhang Fei and his four clones used the Demon Absorbing ability, and they absorbed those wandering evil souls at a rapid pace, which quickly reduced their numbers.

"Hmm? My soul power is starting to climb rapidly, but their numbers won’t be enough for my soul power to break through to the perfection stage." As they continued to absorb those wandering evil souls, Zhang Fei monitored the situation of the three female demons, but the three of them had no significant difficulty in dealing with them due to their high cultivation. "Mei, how strong is the Soul Wraith Lord?"

[Master, the system cannot detect the Soul Wraith Lord’s strength, so I cannot gauge its true strength. Judging from its previous soul attack, its strength should be on par with Nalan Shizhe, but it should not be a problem for you as long as you activate the soul link and absolute condition ability. Moreover, you have your four clones, Yao Qilin, Fei Lian, and Jiu Yaoming, by your side. Even so, I don’t recommend attacking it from close range; instead, you should use long-range attacks to attack it.]
Zhang Fei agreed with Mei, as he himself had already thought about attacking the Soul Wraith Lord from a distance.
[If necessary, you can summon Feng Yichen to assist you, as his dark flames are deadly.]

"No." Zhang Fei immediately rejected Mei’s suggestion. "Even though Feng Yichen’s dark flames are deadly, his strength is still too low to face the Soul Wraith Lord. Moreover, I have the Golden Crow Flame and the Eternal Flame, and I think they are sufficient to deal with it."

[Well, that’s true.] Mei then surveyed the surrounding area. [The three female demons have almost finished eliminating those wandering evil souls, Master. However, other wandering evil souls continue to gather at the Soul Wraith Lord’s location, and it will surely command them to attack you all again.]

"The wandering evil souls in this forest are simply too many." Zhang Fei decided to summon Nalan Wangzi out again because she was a devouring demon, and her abilities to devour would be very helpful in helping him.

"Hmm?" Nalan Wangzi was surprised when she arrived outside, but she didn’t ask anything and used her soul-devouring abilities to devour the wandering evil souls in front of them, quickly eliminating them. "Where are the three female demons, brother-in-law?"
"Over there." Zhang Fei pointed in three different directions, but he and one of his clones immediately moved in the other two, as Yao Qilin and Fei Lian had trouble finding their way back.
A while later, Zhang Fei had already brought Yao Qilin and Fei Lian to Nalan Wangzi’s side, and Jiu Yaoming arrived at their location not long after.
"What should we do now?" Fei Lian asked.

Yao Qilin then spoke. "The number of wandering evil souls on the Soul Wraith Lord’s side is endless, and they will keep arriving to assist it; therefore, we would waste a lot of time if we tried to eliminate them all."
"Can you use your Demon-Prison Eye to imprison those wandering evil souls?" Zhang Fei asked Jiu Yaoming.

Jiu Yaoming shook her head before explaining. "Master, their numbers are simply too numerous, so I can’t imprison them all at once. Instead, I can use my eye minions to attack them from afar and lure them towards us, so we can destroy them more quickly if we gather together. Moreover, Princess Wangzi is here now, and she can use her soul-devouring abilities to devour them, shortening the time we have to get rid of them."

"Brother-in-law, I think her idea is the best for now, so we should use it." Zhang Fei also thought the same as Nalan Wangzi. "If we wait too long, the Nine-Lotus Phantom Soul Lotus will disappear again, and your wait will be in vain."

"Let me try something first." Zhang Fei looked at his four clones, who immediately used their light elements, forcing the four female demons to stay away from them because that element was their nemesis.
Thereafter, the five of them used the Exorcismus ability before combining it, making the four female demons’ jaws drop after they saw a vast light circle appear above the heart of the forest.

"Attack!" After Zhang Fei said that, countless light rays rained down on the entire area under the vast light circle. The forest that was supposed to be dark became brightly lit, followed by loud shrieks from all wandering evil souls affected by his attack.
’His light attack is too terrifying! I will die if I get hit by that attack!’ Yao Qilin and Fei Lian screamed in their hearts, and even Jiu Yaoming stared at Zhang Fei in horror.

’Show off!’ Nalan Wangzi’s lips curled up, as she already knew more or less some of Zhang Fei’s advantages, including his ability to borrow the power of beasts within his beast space. ’Now that I think about it, he should be able to deal with Jia Zizhen by borrowing their power, but he doesn’t seem to want to do that because it would only draw too much attention to himself.’

When the light disappeared, Zhang Fei frowned because the Soul Wraith Lord was not injured in the slightest by his combined attack with his four clones, and the number of wandering evil souls on its side did not decrease much.
[Master, look around them; it is a powerful soul barrier, and it deflected almost all of your previous attacks.]

Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "Yaoming, use your eye minions to lure those wandering evil souls to us now. However, you must avoid attacking the Soul Wraith Lord, as I’m afraid their attacks will damage the lotus."

"Yes, master." Jiu Yaoming summoned dozens of eyes before moving them toward the heart of the forest, and she used them to attack the wandering evil souls nearby. As expected, the souls immediately attacked the eyes, and she began luring them toward her. "Get ready, master."
Zhang Fei turned to the three female demons, who nodded and prepared to get rid of the wandering evil souls.

As soon as the wandering evil souls arrived, Zhang Fei and the others immediately moved to absorb and kill them. On the other hand, Jiu Yaoming controlled her eye minions to lure more souls towards them so they could clear them out faster, as they raced against time before the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus disappeared again.

However, the Soul Wraith Lord continued summoning wandering evil souls from various areas within the forest and domain, making their numbers difficult to reduce. Despite this, Zhang Fei and the others continued to use this tactic to further reduce their numbers while strengthening themselves, especially their soul powers.
[Master, you can’t continue like this because these wandering evil souls are endless, and you’ll run out of time if you don’t get rid of the Soul Wraith Lord soon.]
Zhang Fei understood that too, but he didn’t have clear information about the Soul Wraith Lord’s strength and abilities, which made him hesitate to attack it head-on.

Someone suddenly spoke into Zhang Fei’s mind. ’Haha! Why are you so afraid of the Soul Wraith Lord? It can’t move from its spot, you know? Even though your strength is below it, your soul power is more than enough to face it, and your speed surpasses it.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1288: Defeat The Soul Wraith Lord
paragraphs: Zhang Fei furrowed his brows upon hearing that. ’Do you believe that will be sufficient to fight the Soul Wraith Lord, Feng Yao?’

’Haha.’ Feng Yao laughed in Zhang Fei’s mind. ’Hey, you’ve borrowed the power of all the evil beasts in your space, your soul power was already high, and your speed also surpassed that demon’s. Try fighting it to prove my words, and you can ask them to distract those wandering evil souls.’
’Alright.’ Zhang Fei then spoke to the others. "I want you guys to lure those wandering souls to other places, and I will face the Soul Wraith Lord myself."
"Brother-in-law, you—"
"Trust me, okay?" Zhang Fei stopped Nalan Wangzi. "Alright, move now."
Nalan Wangzi let out a soft sigh before moving into the heart of the forest with the other three, and the wandering souls immediately chased after them as soon as they arrived in the vicinity.

The four women quickly dispersed into four different areas, while Jia Youming used her eye minions to lure more wandering evil souls in her direction. Zhang Fei’s four clones also moved to lure them, causing the soul around the Soul Wraith Lord to decrease significantly.
Zhang Fei saw the Soul Wraith Lord trying to summon other wandering evil souls, so he immediately moved to attack it.
*Roar*
The Soul Wraith Lord roared at Zhang Fei and used its Soul Dominion Ability, but unfortunately, it was useless against him as he countered it with his Demonic Force Manipulation.

Zhang Fei used the Darkness Corruption ability, which weakened the Soul Wraith Lord’s strength while simultaneously bolstering his own power. He also used the Demon Body ability, harnessing the power of his darkness to further enhance his strength, speed, and vitality.
The Soul Wraith Lord was furious because of that, and several soul chains shot out from its body before shooting towards Zhang Fei, but he countered them using his eternal flame, dispelling them.
*Roar*
The Soul Wraith Lord roared again, but this time it let out a roar of pain after Zhang Fei slashed its body with the demon extermination sword imbued with his light element.

Zhang Fei used his clone illusion steps, created ten illusion clones, and slashed the Soul Wraith Lord several times at his maximum speed. He also teleported several times when it attacked him with its strange abilities.
*Roar*

Zhang Fei suddenly sensed something unusual happening around him, and he immediately realized that the Soul Wraith Lord was using an illusion to trap him, but his Illusion Negation activated itself to dispel it.

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow when he saw a flame shoot out from the Soul Wraith Lord’s mouth, but he was familiar with it because he had the Soul Flame. Instead of dodging it, he absorbed its flame, even though it was no longer useful to him.
Zhang Fei became irritated when he saw the injuries he had inflicted on the Soul Wraith Lord quickly recovering on their own, and its body was intact again as before.
Zhang Fei wanted to use his strongest attacks to attack the Soul Wraith Lord, but the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus was right in front of it, and his attacks would damage the lotus.

[Master, bring your four clones here to attack the Soul Wraith Lord simultaneously. If you attack it alone, it will continue to recover due to the presence of wandering evil souls in this forest; therefore, you must use continuous attacks to prevent it from recovering.]

Without wasting any time, Zhang Fei brought his four clones to that area, and he kept attacking the Soul Wraith Lord while waiting for them to arrive. However, it suddenly roared again, and an army of lesser wraiths quickly emerged from the ground around that area.

"Sigh! This demon is truly troublesome!" Zhang Fei activated his ice domain, and it froze those lesser wraiths, but it had no effect on the Soul Wraith Lord. Thereafter, he activated his light and fire domains, eliminating them directly.
The Soul Wraith Lord became increasingly furious as all its attacks were ineffective against Zhang Fei, either countered or dispelled by him.

’Wasn’t your previous worry toward the Soul Wraith Lord unfounded?’ Feng Yao questioned Zhang Fei in his mind. ’You have strength, speed, and many abilities that can suppress it, but you act like you’re missing your past guts. In the past, you were braver than this, but you more or less changed after the incident with your cursed demon heart, and you became too cautious.’

Zhang Fei did not refute Feng Yao, as he had long realized his changes since the incident that day, and he became much more afraid of death than in the past. However, he had no other choice because there were too many people by his side who would be sad if he were injured or died, so he chose to be more careful than before.

As soon as Zhang Fei’s four clones arrived, five of them utilized their high speed to attack the Soul Wraith Lord, launching a barrage of attacks. Some used their light element, and the rest used their fire element with their eternal flame.
The Soul Wraith Lord tried to defend itself using its soul barrier, but their swift and powerful attacks, coupled with the support of their soul domains, instantly shattered its defenses.
Despite this, Zhang Fei and his four clones did not relax their attacks; Instead, they attacked the Soul Wraith Lord even faster, giving it no chance to counterattack.
*Roar*

Once again, the Soul Wraith Lord summoned the wandering evil souls, but Zhang Fei and his five clones immediately used their Exorcismus abilities at the same time. As soon as those countless light rays rained down from above, almost the entire area of the forest became brightly lit, followed by shrieks of wandering evil souls affected by their attacks.

Due to the relentless barrage of attacks from Zhang Fei and his four clones, the Soul Wraith Lord quickly faded as its regeneration ability was unable to keep up with the injuries they inflicted on him.
Zhang Fei took advantage of that to grab the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus, and he hurriedly stored it into the system inventory after he managed to pick it.
Noticing Zhang Fei’s actions, the Soul Wraith Lord let out a furious roar before using its final ability, which transformed its body into pure soul mist.
The Soul Wraith Lord attempted to possess Zhang Fei and his four clones, but they quickly used their eternal flames to surround themselves, preventing the possession and instead burning it.

After a long battle, Zhang Fei and his four clones managed to eliminate the Soul Wraith Lord, allowing them to breathe a sigh of relief. They swallowed several Qi Recovery Pills, as their previous attacks had drained a lot of their Qi, and the forest was still filled with wandering evil souls.

Zhang Fei immediately sat on the ground and allowed the demon extermination sword to absorb those wandering evil souls, but three of his four clones went to pick up Yao Qilin, Fei Lian, and Nalan Wangzi because they were trapped by those natural traps.
Zhang Fei didn’t worry about Jiu Yaoming in the slightest, and he asked her to return to his side after she cleared out the wandering evil souls that were previously chasing her.
Soon, the four female demons returned to Zhang Fei’s side, and he sent his four clones back to the training space immediately.
"Did you manage to obtain the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus, brother-in-law?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded to Nalan Wangzi as he rose to his feet. "Our business in this forest is over now, and I was exhausted from facing the Soul Wraith Lord earlier, so we’ll return to your clan’s residence."
"How did you defeat the Soul Wraith Lord, Master?" Fei Lian asked.
Yao Qilin was more curious about Zhang Fei’s strength. "Please tell me how you managed to increase your strength to such a high level all of a sudden, Master."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at that before opening a gate. "Enter first, and we’ll talk about it while I rest."
A while later, they arrived at Nalan Shizhe’s residence, and Nalan Wangzi immediately took them to the guest room. However, she didn’t join them and went to check on her mother’s condition.

Upon their arrival, Zhang Fei gave Jiu Yaoming several empty bottles and Qi Recovery Pills, asking her to fill them with her Yin Qi. She hurriedly sat down on an empty chair before starting to fill the bottle with her Yin Qi.

Fei Lian could only shake her head as she watched the female eye demon’s actions, but she knew that her Yin Qi was precious to Zhang Fei, and she was fortunate that he hadn’t ordered her to do such a shameful thing before.
"Hmm?" Fei Lian raised an eyebrow as Yao Qilin helped Zhang Fei take off his clothes. "Have you dual cultivated with him, Qilin?"
Yao Qilin nodded slightly. "I’ve dual cultivated with him repeatedly in the past six months, and I’m used to it now."
"Huh?" Fei Lian was confused by that. "How did you dual cultivate with him for six months? As I recall, we left the dungeon about a month and a half ago, right?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "I told you before that there are many things you don’t know about me, but you’ll know everything soon because you’ll be living with me from now on, and you will help me to improve my cultivation."

However, he is still too weak, so I decided to come out to specifically help him."
Dong Xuanyin’s explanation made Wu Zu feel that there was something strange about her decision.
"Why did you suddenly take such a decision?
As far as I remember, you never cared about anyone apart from yourself, but you went this far for the sake of a weak demon."
"Haha." Dong Xuanyin softly laughed.
"We have known each other for thousands of years, so you should already understand my character, right?
My acquaintance is still weak now, but you can’t underestimate him because he is different from other demons or evil beasts.
I won’t explain to you in detail for now, but I can tell you that he will bring changes to all living creatures, including your Witch Demon Race."
"Hmm?" Wu Zu furrowed her brows as she looked at her with disbelief.
Dong Xuanyin shook her head slightly.
"I won’t talk much about him now, and you will know the truth of my words in the future.
So, are you willing to give me your elixir?"
"Wait." Wu Zu hurriedly went to the back room before returning with a vial filled with purple liquid, and she exchanged it for the fruit in Dong Xuanyin’s hands.
"My witch demon race has long lived under pressure from other demon races, and our number continues to decrease every year.
If this condition continues, my race will become extinct one day, so I sincerely hope for change.
I don’t know your acquaintance, but I know that you are not a braggart, so I will put my trust in you."
Dong Xuanyin gladly accepted the elixir.
"Don’t worry, I won’t betray your trust in me.

However, my acquaintance will never be able to change the situation by himself, and he needs as much help as possible, so I hope that you and the members of your race will be willing to help him when the time comes."
"I know." Wu Zu nodded to her.
"If your acquaintance really has the intention to change the situation for the better, my witch demon race will stand by his side and help him to the best of our ability.
However, if he betrays us, we will use all our strength to eliminate him, even if we have to fight you."
Dong Xuanyin smiled in response.
"I assure you that my acquaintance is not a person who would betray his allies, and I believe you will meet him soon, so you can judge his character for yourself at that time.
By the way, thanks for the elixir, and I will give it to him now."
"What—" Dong Xuanyin disappeared before Wu Zhu could ask again.
"Tch!
That woman always acts mysterious!
Who is the real identity of her acquaintance?
Does a lust demon really have the ability to change the adverse situation in this realm?
Since she said I would meet her acquaintance one day, I will wait for him to come to me.
For now, I won’t tell the others about him, and I will tell them everything after I meet him."
Thereafter, Wu Zu focused her attention on the cauldron in front of her, but many questions kept popping up in her mind.
After she left the domain, Dong Xuanyin went straight to the Soul-Devouring Domain, but she didn’t meet Zhang Fei or the leader of the Soul-Devouring Demon Race.
Instead, she used her abilities to control one of their members, and she ordered him to hand over the Demon Soul Elixir to Nalan Wangzi.
After she confirmed that the elixir fell into Nalan Wangzi’s hands, Dong Xuanyi left the domain for the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain.
She then returned to her pond and informed the man who lived with her about everything.
[Daily quest I: Absorb 10,000,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1000 purple jewels.]
[Daily Quest II: Absorb 10,000,000 demon essence.]
[Reward: 1000 advanced-grade demon cores.]
[Daily Quest III: Absorb 10,000,000 beast essence.]
[Reward: 1000 advanced-grade beast cores.]
[Daily Quest IV: Killing 1000 beasts/demon beasts in the Celestial Lord or above.]
[Reward: Celestial daily pack x1]
After two days of dual cultivation with Fei Lian and Yao Qilin, Zhang Fei sent them to the training space.

Although Jiu Yaoming’s figure was quite tempting to him, he never touched her even once; instead, he ordered her to fill as many bottles as possible with her Yin Qi, and he continued to give her the Qi Recovery Pills.
Luckily, Jiu Mozu had not contacted Jiu Yaoming for the past two days, so she could focus on that.
After he felt that his stock of Yin Qi was sufficient, Zhang Fei asked her to stop and let her leave, waiting for her demon god’s next order.
Outside the guest room, Zhang Fei found Nalan Wangzi, who immediately informed him about Mo Shentian’s return and several other things.
After she finished explaining everything, Nalan Wangzi took out the Demon Soul Elixir and handed it to Zhang Fei.
"This way, all the items you need have been collected, so you can break through to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks, and I think you will evolve once again after that."
"Who gave it to you?"
"I don’t know that person’s identity." Nalan Wangzi told Zhang Fei how she could obtain the elixir.
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.
"I think the person who gave this elixir to you was Dong Xuanyin."
"Huh?" Nalan Wangzi was surprised.
"Are you sure that person is Dong Xuanyin?
Why did she help you?
You two don’t know each other, right?"
"I’ve never met Dong Xuanyin before, so how could I know her?" Zhang Fei took out the Infernal Blood Core before continuing.
"I don’t know her reason for helping me this far, but Fei Lian told me that she gave this core to her.
She also said that woman went to the witch demon race to find the elixir, so I’m sure she’s the one.

If I want to know her reason, I have no choice but to go to the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain, but I won’t do something so crazy with my current strength because the four perils will detect my presence, and they will attack me directly.

Even if I borrow the power of all the beasts inside my beast space, I will never be able to defeat any of them because they are immortal rank beasts, let alone if I have to face all four of them at once."
Although she wasn’t a beast or a demon beast, Nalan Wangzi knew that beast ranks held significant influence among beasts.

Moreover, Zhang Fei’s cultivation was still at the Celestial Lord Realm, so he was clearly no match for the four perils, who already stood at the pinnacle of the cultivation world alongside Long Wuzhao and several other powerful cultivators.
"In that case, let’s return to your pavilion first, and you can use these items to break through to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks.
I can’t wait to see your evolution after this, and I’m sure you’ll become even stronger."
"Haha." Zhang Fei softly laughed.
"My demon identity is a lust demon, remember?
All my demon abilities are related to sex, so I will become stronger at it.
Since you can’t wait to have sex with me, I will take you there now, but we have to say goodbye to my mother-in-law first."
Nalan Wangzi pursed her lips.
"Who did you say can’t wait to have sex with you?
I haven’t thought about doing it with you yet, so you should have sex with all your wives."
"Haha." Zhang Fei simply laughed when he heard that.
After they went to see Nalan Shizhe and discussed some matters with her, Zhang Fei immediately took Nalan Wangzi back to the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Then, he took her and all his wives in the sect to the pavilion, and one of his clones picked up his other wives, who were in other domains.
Soon, they were already gathered in the pavilion’s main garden, but Zhang Fei didn’t use those items right away.
Instead, he handed the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus to Ru Xue first, which surprised her.
"Why did you give this lotus to me, Fei’er?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1291: Preparation For Evolution
paragraphs: Zhang Fei grabbed Ru Xue’s shoulders. "Xue’er, I’ve never said this before, but our relationship has left some things in my heart, and it often makes me feel guilty toward you."
"Hmm?" Ru Xue looked at Zhang Fei in confusion. "What do you mean by that?"

Zhang Fei immediately told her, "You are my first woman, and you have sacrificed so much for me, starting from divorcing Xu Xuan to allowing Xu Ling’er to be my wife. You never even complained, even though I had so many women by my side, but I often felt that I never treated you as one. I’m not saying that this lotus is worth your sacrifice for me, and I only wanted to give it to you as a gift so you know how I feel about you."

"Sigh." Ru Xue sighed heavily. "I don’t understand why you feel that way, but you should know that I am happy with you. At first, I was in a dilemma about our relationship because I was Xu Xuan’s wife at that time, but I never felt that way again after I divorced him, and my heart has long belonged to you. I never thought about sacrifice or anything like that because I decided to be with you on my own, even though I knew that you would have many women in the future. As for Ling’er, I’ve known for a long time that she loves you, and I don’t want her to be disappointed, so I asked you to take her as your wife. Therefore, you don’t need to keep such thoughts in your mind and heart, especially since I’m truly happy now."
"But—"
"No buts, okay?" Ru Xue stopped him. "I’m happy, and I’ll never regret my decision, so you should put all those thoughts out of your mind."

Zhang Fei stared at her for a while before nodding. "Alright, I’ll put those thoughts aside. By the way, I’ve decided to give this lotus to you, and you can use it to increase your soul power now. As for Lin’er and the others, I’ll definitely look for other items that can help them increase their soul power."
"Just use the lotus for you, Big Sis Xue." Ling Long and the others nodded in agreement with Zhang Lin.
After all, Zhang Fei had never treated them differently, and he always tried to treat them fairly, so they didn’t mind if Ru Xue used the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus.

Ru Xue nodded to them before sitting cross-legged on her spot, and she began to absorb the Nine-Petal Phantom Soul Lotus. However, Zhang Fei forbade her from absorbing it all at once because the soul power within it was too abundant; instead, he asked her to absorb it slowly and gradually.

Zhang Fei himself immediately sat a little far from them and took out the materials for his demon rank to break through to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks. The Abyssal Demon Heart, the Infernal Blood Core, the Demon Essence Drop, the Demon Soul Elixir, and the Demon Ritual Sigil.

"Let me explain it to you first, brother-in-law." Nalan Wangzi walked before Zhang Fei and took the Demon Essence Drop. "You can’t use them all at once, and you must start with this essence drop, as it is the first key to surpass the mortal limitation. It will flow to your body through your cultivation veins and fuse with your cultivation core, and it will also purify and condense your demon qi into its purest form, which we call the true demon Qi. During the process, your cultivation veins will expand, opening the path for your ascension."
"Then?"

Nalan Wangzi returned the Demon Essence Drop to him. "After your body fully absorbs the essence drop, you can use the soul elixir. It will expand and baptize your demon soul to perfection. Then, you can use the blood core; it will melt and flow through your bloodstream. At first, you will feel your blood boil and become hot, and it will also temper your flesh and bones."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "What is the fourth item I should use?"

"This one." Nalan Wangzi pointed at the Abyssal Demon Heart. "After you complete the previous three processes, you can use this demon heart, but it will replace your original heart. Unlike our Qi stored in our dantian and cultivation core, your demon heart will function as the core to accommodate your true demon qi."
"Wait a minute, Big Sis." Nalan Yushu suddenly spoke. "You don’t know about this matter yet, but my husband’s heart is no longer a human heart."
"Huh?" Nalan Wangzi turned to her little sister in shock. "Is that true? Is his heart really no longer a human heart? Then, what is his heart now?"

"The Cursed Demon Heart." Nalan Wangzi was even more shocked as soon as Jia Yuyan said that. "Zhang Fei got the heart a long time ago, and it almost took over his body two decades ago. Fortunately, Zhang Chen managed to help him, and he eventually took over control of the heart from its previous owner."

Nalan Wangzi returned her gaze to Zhang Fei with a frown. "The Cursed Demon Heart belonged to an ancient demon, and Long Wuzhao killed him. He wanted to destroy the heart, but it suddenly disappeared. In fact, all the demon gods, including my mother, had been trying hard to find the heart for thousands of years. They believed it would grant them greater power, so they were ambitious to obtain it, but their efforts never bore fruit.

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed wryly before pressing his palm against his heart area. "To be honest, I never wanted this Cursed Demon Heart, but it immediately entered my body after I opened the chest. Since then, this heart has become one with me, but it always gave me a feeling of fear, which was proven true by the incident at that time. I almost lost my body because the previous owner was powerful and was helped by another creature, but I was fortunate because my grandmother came to save me; otherwise, I wouldn’t be myself anymore."

Nalan Wangzi let out a heavy sigh upon hearing that. "Since the Cursed Demon Heart is already a part of you, I don’t know what will happen if you use the Abyssal Demon Heart, but I think your current heart will absorb it and merge with it because it is much stronger. Even though you already have full control over your current heart, you will probably experience some changes after your demon rank breaks through to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks. However, that’s just my guess, so you have to be prepared for the worst."
"Doesn’t that mean my husband will become much stronger than our mother and the other demon gods, Big Sis?"

Nalan Wangzi shook her head in response to her little sister’s question. "According to the story, the previous owner of the Cursed Demon Heart was indeed powerful, but I don’t know how strong he was. As far as I know, only Long Wuzhao knows for sure his strength, especially since he was the one who fought and killed him. However, Zhang Fei possesses many advantages that other cultivators, including the Golden Dragon Emperor, don’t possess. Therefore, I believe the heart will help him surpass them all in the future, especially after his cultivation reaches the Celestial God Realm."
"Alright, we don’t need to talk about that now." Zhang Fei then asked Nalan Wangzi. "What should I do after I absorb the Abyssal Demon Heart?"

"Are you impatient to break through and evolve again, brother-in-law?" Zhang Fei responded to Nalan Wanzi with a broad grin. "Once you’ve used the other four, you just need to activate the Demon Ritual Sigil. Once you activate it, a demon gate will open, which will connect you to the true demon laws."
"True demon laws?"

Nalan Wangzi nodded slightly. "I can’t explain it in detail, and you’ll experience it for yourself soon. After the process is complete, you will enter your evolution process, which may take quite a while. However, it’s not a big deal because the flow of time in this place is four times faster than the outside world, so you can go through the process calmly. Since you can’t wait for your demon rank to break through, you can consume the essence drop now to start the process, and I’ll be here to monitor you."

"Alright." Zhang Fei unhesitatingly consumed the Demon Essence Drop, and it quickly flowed into his body. As Nalan Wangzi had said before, he could feel it flowing into his body through his cultivation veins, rapidly flowing to his cultivation core.

A while later, Zhang Fi felt that his cultivation veins gradually expanded, and the Demon Essence Drop began to purify and condense his demon qi, which excited him. He had been waiting for this day for a long time, as his demon rank had already broken through to the Emperor Rank long ago, but he didn’t have those materials to break through.
The process lasted for three full hours, and Nalan Wangzi immediately spoke to him. "Brother-in-law, release your demon soul and use the Demon Soul Elixir on your soul."

Zhang Fei didn’t say anything and released his demon soul, and he used the Demon Soul Elixir on his soul directly according to Nalan Wangzi’s instructions. In a few minutes, his soul turned black, and his expression changed repeatedly as he felt the changes beginning to occur in his soul.

chapters.title: Chapter 1292: Evolution Start
paragraphs: "Back off!" Nalan Wangzi shouted to the women who were not demons and did not possess darkness elements as Zhang Fei’s darkness spread to the surrounding area, but several women with light elements protected them with their light domains.

Zhang Fei’s darkness did not spread around for too long, and it quickly shrank back into his body. Gradually, his demon soul also reverted to its normal state, but it underwent quite significant changes and became slightly different compared to the original.
Luo Yunxiao and the others could see that Zhang Fei’s demon soul had become more perfect, and his soul power had also increased, even though not too significantly.
"Is the change in my big brother’s soul due to the effects of the elixir?"

"Yes, you’re right." Nalan Wangzi nodded to Zhang Lin as she watched Zhang Fei, who had already swallowed the Infernal Blood Core. "His cultivation veins have expanded, the demon qi within his body has become much purer, and its quantity has also become more abundant. However, his demon soul has become stronger than his human or beast souls, and it might become a problem for him because the balance between the three has collapsed."
"Will Fei’er’s demon soul control his other two souls?"

"I can’t say for sure yet." Nalan Wangzi answered Zhang Chen with a shake of her head. "For now, we can only wait until Zhang Fei completes his ascension process, and we will get the answer at that time."

They became tense as soon as Zhang Fei’s body turned red due to the effects of the Infernal Blood Core, which had melted and flowed through his bloodstream. His expression also looked so painful as it began to temper his flesh and bones, causing his muscles to bulge out from all over his body.
"How long will he be in a situation like this?" Zhang Yue asked Nalan Wangzi and clasped her hands together, as she was worried about Zhang Fei’s condition.

"Hmm?" Nalan Wangzi thought for a moment. "Every demon needs a different amount of time to complete this stage, so I can’t predict how long Zhang Fei will be in this state. Back then, it took me several hours for the process to complete, and it got more painful as it neared the final phase."

Zhang Yue sighed inwardly, but she knew that Zhang Fei was strong, so she believed he would make it through the process well. However, she still had other concerns, particularly about how he might change after his next evolution. ’Fei’er, I hope you will never change, and I hope you continue to be like you are now.’

In the end, Zhang Fei spent ten hours going through the process, and all his wives were finally able to calm down after his condition returned to normal. However, they became tense again once he took the Abyssal Demon Heart, and they were worried about what would happen in the process, mainly because of the Cursed Demon Heart in his body.

Just like them, Zhang Fei himself was hesitant and worried about using the Abyssal Demon Heart, but he had no choice but to use it, or his demon rank would never advance to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks.

Nalan Wangzi wanted to stop Zhang Chen, who decided to approach Zhang Fei. However, Qing Yi, Zhang Yue, and Zhang Lin asked the female demon not to stop her because they fully understood her feelings for him. He was the most important part of her life, and she was also the most important part of his life.

Zhang Chen sat behind Zhang Fei, hugged him from behind, pressed her palm to his heart area, and whispered to him. ’Fei’er, I’m here with you, so you don’t need to hesitate anymore and use the Abyssal Demon Heart now. If anything happens to you, I will save you again.’

Zhang Chen’s hug and words gave Zhang Fei a feeling of calm, and he immediately used the Abyssal Demon Heart. His Cursed Demon Heart suddenly beat rapidly, and several black threads shot out from his chest before enveloping the Abyssal Demon Heart, pulling it into his body.
"Ugh!" Zhang Fei groaned softly as he felt the changes in his Cursed Demon Heart, and his darkness quickly enveloped him and Zhang Chen.

Zhang Fei wanted to push Zhang Chen away, but she hugged him tightly and had no intention of letting him go, even though his darkness was starting to have an effect on her. ’Fei’er, don’t worry about me, and I will accompany you through this process. Even if I have to become a demon for it, I will never let you go.’

Zhang Fei finally gave in as he endured the pain from the activity of his Cursed Demon Heart, and he could feel that his heart was devouring the Abyssal Demon Heart, as Nalan Wangzi had previously predicted.
The process didn’t take long, and the Abyssal Demon Heart began to merge with Zhang Fei’s Cursed Demon Heart, causing his darkness to become thicker and darker.
Behind Zhang Fei, Zhang Chen’s face began to look pale, and some parts of her body also began to turn black due to Zhang Fei’s darkness.
Zhang Chen ignored her own condition and continued to hug Zhang Fei, but she felt relieved when she felt her heartbeat begin to stabilize, though not completely.

A few hours later, the Abyssal Demon Heart had merged with Zhang Fei’s Cursed Demon Heart, but he felt that his heart had become slightly larger than its original size, and all the demon qi in his body was rapidly flowing into it.

Soon, Zhang Fei’s darkness disappeared completely, but Zhang Chen’s condition wasn’t so good. Nalan Wangzi immediately moved and pulled her away from him, and she devoured the remaining darkness in her body, allowing it to return to its original state.
"Thank you."

"I know you love my brother-in-law very much, but you were too reckless in doing that. Fortunately, his darkness didn’t affect you much, or your condition would have been much worse than this." Zhang Chen smiled at Nalan Wangzi before closing her eyes.
Qing Yi and Zhang Lin immediately lifted Zhang Chen to his feet, supported her, and carried her to her room to rest.
Nalan Wangzi observed Zhang Fei, who was holding the Demon Ritual Sigil. "The final process."
