paragraphs: ’This guy has swapped bodies again!’ Nalan Shizhe then asked him. "What brought you here today, Wu Mian?"

"Mo Shentian tried so hard to find my real body, but he never knew that I had already infiltrated all the demon domains, including yours." Nalan Shizhe frowned at Wu Mian, who then pointed to Zhang Fei. "Back then, I heard you talking to Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu about him, including your daughter’s relationship with him. Therefore, I monitor your domain, and I’ve been keeping an eye on him since he arrived here. I already know some of his actions in this realm, such as him sending them to the Three Lower Realms to look for my real body."
Zhang Fei frowned after hearing that because he, Mei, and the system never detected Wu Mian’s actions.

Wu Mian immediately spoke to him. "You don’t need to be confused about how I can monitor you without being detected by anyone because I can possess the bodies of all living creatures, including beasts and trees. In fact, we already met several years ago, but I’m sure you would never have guessed it."

"Several years ago, I was still living in the Three Moral Realms, but I didn’t have too many demon friends at that time." Zhang Fei looked at Wu Mian thoughtfully. "I’ve visited several demon realms there, and one of them is the Diyu Realm. However, I’m sure you wouldn’t go there, especially since there’s no Qi at all there."
"Haha." Wu Mian laughed at that. "I do know about the Diyu Realm, but I’ve never been there."

"I believe you have also never been to the Blue Water Realm, the Nine Hells Darkland Realm, and the Demon Purgatory Realm." Zhang Fei finally realized something. "I’m sure we met in the Netherworld Realm back then, isn’t that right?"
"Hahaha!" Wu Mian laughed again. "That’s right, we did meet in the Netherworld Realm. Back then, those three heavenly foxes hunted you in the Sky Jade Realm, and you decided to escape to that realm."

"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Apart from my three wives and two friends from that realm, there’s only one other demon who knows much about me. After all, he was the one who helped me hide when those foxes were chasing me, and he assisted me a lot while I was living in that realm. Isn’t that right, Old Arbeola?"

"Hahaha!" Wu Mian burst into laughter as soon as Zhang Fei mentioned that name. "You’re right, but you’re also wrong. I’m Arbeola, but I’m not him either, and I only borrowed his body in the past. Why don’t we return to that realm now? This way, you will know my true identity, and you will also know the reason I monitor you in this realm."
"Alright." Zhang Fei immediately got up and opened the gate to the Netherworld Realm.
"We’ll go with you guys." Nalan Shizhen, Nalan Wangzi, and Nalan Yushu immediately moved to Zhang Fei’s side.
"Let’s go now." Wu Mian was the first to enter the gate.

A while later, they arrived at the Ghostveil Forest, where Arbeola lived. "Haha! You’ve finally returned to this realm, kid. It’s been two and a half years since you last came to this realm, but you’ve become so much stronger now that I can’t detect your cultivation."

"Long time no see, Old Arbeola." Zhang Fei nodded at the old demon. "Two and a half years have only passed for you, but almost three decades have passed for me. Honestly, I probably wouldn’t have returned to this realm if it wasn’t for this man beside me, especially after he said that we had met before here through you."
Arbeola nodded in understanding to Zhang Fei before asking Wu Mian. "Do you want to take your real body now, Emperor?"

"Huh?" Zhang Fei turned to Wu Mian in shock. "So, you’re the fourth demon emperor of this realm, huh? Old Arbeola told me that you planted him here to guard the chamber beneath him, which means the body inside is your real body." (Chapter: 406)
Wu Mian grinned broadly. "Did you just realize this now? I remember you kowtowing in front of my golden coffin back then."
"Tch!" Zhang Fei gnashed his teeth. "If I had known you were still alive at that time, I wouldn’t have done that."
"Haha!" Wu Mian laughed and patted Zhang Fei’s shoulder. "Isn’t it too late? Moreover, my private chamber protected your four women from the Shang Clan people back then, remember?"

Zhang Fei released a heavy sigh. "You’re right! My four women would have faced danger if Old Arbeola hadn’t allowed me to take them into that chamber, and they might have died at the hands of those people in the past."
"Hmm?" Wu Mian, Nalan Shizhe, and Zhang Fei suddenly looked far away. "I knew the three of them would notice our presence in this realm."
Nalan Shizhe nodded in agreement with Wu Mian. "Here they come."
*Swoosh... Swoosh... Swoosh...*
Soon, three demons landed in front of them, but Qi Qingxiu immediately shot a deathly glare at Zhang Fei.
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled at that. "Did you miss me, Qingxiu? We—"
"Shut up!" Qi Qingxiu fiercely glared at Zhang Fei. "If you dare—"
*Bam*

Qi Qingxiu had not finished speaking, but she suddenly fell unconscious to the ground, confusing Wu Mian and Ye Futian. Unlike the two of them, Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe already knew Zhang Fei’s actions toward her, so they knew that he sent her subconscious into the dream.
Nalan Yushu immediately spoke to him. "Husband, she’ll beat you up if you keep doing this to her."

"Do you really think she can do that, Yushu?" Zhang Fei asked with a playful smile. "I used my dream ability on her long ago, remember? No matter how high her cultivation is or how great her abilities are in controlling the emotions of living beings, she will never be able to attack me after she is affected by my ability, and I just need to send her subconscious there to defeat her."
Nalan Yushu could only shake her head at that. "Are you going to send her to our private place?"
"Not now." Zhang Fei replied by shaking his head.
Ye Mingran suddenly asked him. "When did your demon rank break through to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks?"
"I just finished my evolution today." Zhang Fei then pointed at Wu Mian. "I met him at my mother-in-law’s residence, so I brought them here."
"Hmm?" Both Ye Mingran and Ye Futian looked at Wu Mian. "Does this mean your true body is in this realm?"
"Why are you so impatient?" Wu Mian looked at Arbeola, who immediately shifted back, revealing the staircase beneath him. "Let’s enter."
Wu Mian immediately walked to the side of the golden coffin. "My real body is inside this coffin, but I won’t take it out now because it’s not the right time yet."
"What do you mean by that?" Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran asked in unison.
"Him." Wu Mian pointed at Zhang Fei. "I will only bring my real body out of this coffin after he reaches the Demon God Rank. At that time, we will fight together against Mo Shentian and the others."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei furrowed his brows. "Don’t tell me, you—"
"Yes." Wu Mian nodded at Zhang Fei. "I once met your predecessor in the past, and he asked me to hide my real body in this realm because he knew you would come here."
Since they already knew Zhang Fei’s other identities, Nalan Shizhe, Ye Mingran, and Ye Futian immediately understood that his predecessor was the ten-tailed fox.
Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh, especially since the ten-tailed fox had arranged so much for him. "Why are you revealing everything today? Why didn’t you tell me all those years ago?"
Ye Mingran and Ye Futian looked puzzled by Zhang Fei’s question to Wu Mian, especially since they had only just met today.

"Why don’t you ask yourself those questions? Have you forgotten how weak you were back then?" Zhang Fei chose not to argue with Wu Mian. "You’ve changed a lot now, but you’re still weak. I could have met you a long time ago, but I deliberately waited for you to reach the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks first. I deliberately revealed everything today because you have places that no one else can enter, so I want you to hide my real body in one of them; only then will my real body be truly safe. When the time comes, you can take it out, and I will return to my real body."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei thought for a moment before deciding. "The only safest place to hide your true body is to keep it in my soul world."

"That’s right." Wu Mian nodded. "Qian Yan’s middle eye is too terrifying, and he can see through all private spaces. However, he won’t be able to see through your soul world, so that place is the safest place to hide my real body. Therefore, you can send this coffin there now, and we will immediately return to our realm."
"Alright." Zhang Fei touched the coffin and sent it to his soul world. "Now no one will be able to find your real body."
When they arrived outside, and Zhang Fei asked Wu Mian, "Can you move Old Arbeola from this place? He’s helped me a lot in the past, so I want to take him to the Paradise Realm."

"I’ve visited several demon realms there, and one of them is the Diyu Realm.
However, I’m sure you wouldn’t go there, especially since there’s no Qi at all there."
"Haha." Wu Mian laughed at that.
"I do know about the Diyu Realm, but I’ve never been there."
"I believe you have also never been to the Blue Water Realm, the Nine Hells Darkland Realm, and the Demon Purgatory Realm." Zhang Fei finally realized something.
"I’m sure we met in the Netherworld Realm back then, isn’t that right?"
"Hahaha!" Wu Mian laughed again.
"That’s right, we did meet in the Netherworld Realm.
Back then, those three heavenly foxes hunted you in the Sky Jade Realm, and you decided to escape to that realm."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.
"Apart from my three wives and two friends from that realm, there’s only one other demon who knows much about me.
After all, he was the one who helped me hide when those foxes were chasing me, and he assisted me a lot while I was living in that realm.
Isn’t that right, Old Arbeola?"
"Hahaha!" Wu Mian burst into laughter as soon as Zhang Fei mentioned that name.
"You’re right, but you’re also wrong.
I’m Arbeola, but I’m not him either, and I only borrowed his body in the past.
Why don’t we return to that realm now?
This way, you will know my true identity, and you will also know the reason I monitor you in this realm."
"Alright." Zhang Fei immediately got up and opened the gate to the Netherworld Realm.
"We’ll go with you guys." Nalan Shizhen, Nalan Wangzi, and Nalan Yushu immediately moved to Zhang Fei’s side.
"Let’s go now." Wu Mian was the first to enter the gate.
A while later, they arrived at the Ghostveil Forest, where Arbeola lived.
"Haha!
You’ve finally returned to this realm, kid.
It’s been two and a half years since you last came to this realm, but you’ve become so much stronger now that I can’t detect your cultivation."
"Long time no see, Old Arbeola." Zhang Fei nodded at the old demon.
"Two and a half years have only passed for you, but almost three decades have passed for me.
Honestly, I probably wouldn’t have returned to this realm if it wasn’t for this man beside me, especially after he said that we had met before here through you."
Arbeola nodded in understanding to Zhang Fei before asking Wu Mian.
"Do you want to take your real body now, Emperor?"
"Huh?" Zhang Fei turned to Wu Mian in shock.
"So, you’re the fourth demon emperor of this realm, huh?
Old Arbeola told me that you planted him here to guard the chamber beneath him, which means the body inside is your real body." (Chapter: 406)
Wu Mian grinned broadly.
"Did you just realize this now?
I remember you kowtowing in front of my golden coffin back then."
"Tch!" Zhang Fei gnashed his teeth.
"If I had known you were still alive at that time, I wouldn’t have done that."
"Haha!" Wu Mian laughed and patted Zhang Fei’s shoulder.
"Isn’t it too late?
Moreover, my private chamber protected your four women from the Shang Clan people back then, remember?"
Zhang Fei released a heavy sigh.
"You’re right!
My four women would have faced danger if Old Arbeola hadn’t allowed me to take them into that chamber, and they might have died at the hands of those people in the past."
"Hmm?" Wu Mian, Nalan Shizhe, and Zhang Fei suddenly looked far away.
"I knew the three of them would notice our presence in this realm."
Nalan Shizhe nodded in agreement with Wu Mian.
"Here they come."
*Swoosh...
Swoosh...
Swoosh...*
Soon, three demons landed in front of them, but Qi Qingxiu immediately shot a deathly glare at Zhang Fei.
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled at that.
"Did you miss me, Qingxiu?
We—"
"Shut up!" Qi Qingxiu fiercely glared at Zhang Fei.
"If you dare—"
*Bam*
Qi Qingxiu had not finished speaking, but she suddenly fell unconscious to the ground, confusing Wu Mian and Ye Futian.
Unlike the two of them, Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe already knew Zhang Fei’s actions toward her, so they knew that he sent her subconscious into the dream.
Nalan Yushu immediately spoke to him.
"Husband, she’ll beat you up if you keep doing this to her."
"Do you really think she can do that, Yushu?" Zhang Fei asked with a playful smile.
"I used my dream ability on her long ago, remember?

No matter how high her cultivation is or how great her abilities are in controlling the emotions of living beings, she will never be able to attack me after she is affected by my ability, and I just need to send her subconscious there to defeat her."
Nalan Yushu could only shake her head at that.
"Are you going to send her to our private place?"
"Not now." Zhang Fei replied by shaking his head.
Ye Mingran suddenly asked him.
"When did your demon rank break through to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks?"
"I just finished my evolution today." Zhang Fei then pointed at Wu Mian.
"I met him at my mother-in-law’s residence, so I brought them here."
"Hmm?" Both Ye Mingran and Ye Futian looked at Wu Mian.
"Does this mean your true body is in this realm?"
"Why are you so impatient?" Wu Mian looked at Arbeola, who immediately shifted back, revealing the staircase beneath him.
"Let’s enter."
Wu Mian immediately walked to the side of the golden coffin.
"My real body is inside this coffin, but I won’t take it out now because it’s not the right time yet."
"What do you mean by that?" Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran asked in unison.
"Him." Wu Mian pointed at Zhang Fei.
"I will only bring my real body out of this coffin after he reaches the Demon God Rank.
At that time, we will fight together against Mo Shentian and the others."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei furrowed his brows.
"Don’t tell me, you—"
"Yes." Wu Mian nodded at Zhang Fei.
"I once met your predecessor in the past, and he asked me to hide my real body in this realm because he knew you would come here."
Since they already knew Zhang Fei’s other identities, Nalan Shizhe, Ye Mingran, and Ye Futian immediately understood that his predecessor was the ten-tailed fox.
Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh, especially since the ten-tailed fox had arranged so much for him.
"Why are you revealing everything today?
Why didn’t you tell me all those years ago?"
Ye Mingran and Ye Futian looked puzzled by Zhang Fei’s question to Wu Mian, especially since they had only just met today.
"Why don’t you ask yourself those questions?
Have you forgotten how weak you were back then?" Zhang Fei chose not to argue with Wu Mian.
"You’ve changed a lot now, but you’re still weak.
I could have met you a long time ago, but I deliberately waited for you to reach the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks first.
I deliberately revealed everything today because you have places that no one else can enter, so I want you to hide my real body in one of them; only then will my real body be truly safe.
When the time comes, you can take it out, and I will return to my real body."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei thought for a moment before deciding.
"The only safest place to hide your true body is to keep it in my soul world."
"That’s right." Wu Mian nodded.
"Qian Yan’s middle eye is too terrifying, and he can see through all private spaces.
However, he won’t be able to see through your soul world, so that place is the safest place to hide my real body.
Therefore, you can send this coffin there now, and we will immediately return to our realm."
"Alright." Zhang Fei touched the coffin and sent it to his soul world.
"Now no one will be able to find your real body."
When they arrived outside, and Zhang Fei asked Wu Mian, "Can you move Old Arbeola from this place?
He’s helped me a lot in the past, so I want to take him to the Paradise Realm."

chapters.title: Chapter 1298: Ten-Tailed Fox’s Bloodlust Soul
paragraphs: "Arbeola."
"Yes, Emperor."
Zhang Fei furrowed his brows when the ground began to shake violently, and Mei informed him of the intense underground movement, which originated from Arbeola’s roots.
Soon, Arbeola’s body shrank rapidly before transforming into an old male demon, still retaining his tree-like appearance.
Zhang Fei spoke directly to him. "So, from the start, you could have left this place, but you refused my invitation back then because of your master’s real body."
"Haha." Arbeola laughed at that. "Kid, my emperor planted me in this place to protect his real body, so I couldn’t possibly leave without his orders."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei then spoke to Yi Mingran and Ye Futian. "Please contact your members and ask them to gather here, and I will take you all back to the Paradise Realm."
"Wake her up first." Ye Mingran pointed to Qi Qingxiu, who was still lying unconscious on the ground.

Shortly after Zhang Fei released her unconsciousness, Qi Qingxiu immediately opened her eyes before jumping to her feet. She stared at him hatefully, and her face was completely red with shame and anger, causing her chest to heave up and down.
Zhang Fei casually smiled in response to her. "Contact your subordinate first, and we will continue later."
*Boom*
Qi Qingxiu’s aura exploded, and she used her abilities on him, but as Zhang Fei expected, the system neutralized them.

Zhang Fei retaliated against Qi Qingxiu with his new abilities, causing her to feel guilty toward him. Additionally, she had hopes of being together with him, which made her feel strange about her feelings. "How could you do that to me?"
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled. "I was born as your nemesis, so you should forget about your desire to beat me. Even though you are much stronger than me, you will never be able to do anything to me."
"Tch! Tell me the truth!" Qi Qingxiu furiously shouted.

Zhang Fei shrugged slightly. "I know you can control the seven emotions of other living creatures, but you don’t know about my new abilities that I got after I evolved into a lust demon monarch, and they are almost the same as yours."
"Hmm?" Qi Qingxiu’s expression clearly showed that she didn’t believe Zhang Fei, as no other demon had ever possessed such abilities before.
Nalan Shizhen immediately spoke to her. "He didn’t lie to you, Qingxiu. He can control the free will and subconscious of other living creatures."
"Are you kidding me? I’ve never heard of lust demons having such abilities!" Qi Qingxiu shouted really loud.

Since Wu Mian, Ye Futian, and Ye Mingran already knew about Zhang Fei’s other identities, they were not surprised that he had such abilities. After all, he was the only living being with four identities in one body, and there has never been one like him in the past.

Nalan Yushu also spoke to her. "My mother isn’t joking with you, Aunt Qingxiu. My husband does have such abilities, and I’ve tried their effects myself before we went to this realm. Furthermore, you don’t know him well, and he has many other abilities that other lust demons don’t have. Your abilities will never be useful against him, but his abilities will be effective against you, so he is your nemesis now."
"Hmm?" Qi Qingxiu kept staring at Zhang Fei. "Remove their effects from me right now!"
"No." Zhang Fei refused without a second thought. "You tried to attack me, so I won’t remove their effects from you."

Qi Qingxiu fiercely glared at Zhang Fei as she clenched her fist. She considered attacking him physically, but she abandoned the idea because he would immediately send her subconscious into a dream if she did that.

"Alright, contact your subordinates now and ask them to gather here, and we will return to our realm directly." Ye Mingran herself couldn’t wait to go home, especially since they had been gone for too long.

Qi Qingxiu didn’t say anything and contacted her subordinates directly, but she continued to feel angry with Zhang Fei because she couldn’t dispel the effects of his abilities, and the effects continued to affect her.
After their subordinates gathered in the realm, Zhang Fei immediately brought them all back to the Soul-Devouring Domain.
Upon arrival, Ye Mingran and Ye Futian led the Eternal Night Demon Race members back to their domain.
Before he took Arbeola away, Wu Mian told Zhang Fei not to look for him, and he would look for him himself when the time came.

Zhang Fei did not stop Qi Qingxiu as she led her subordinates to leave the Soul-Devouring Domain to return to their own domain, and he took the Nalan Sisters into the training space again after they said goodbye to Nalan Shizhe.
After making all his wives wait for over a year, Zhang Fei invited them to the main bedroom of the pavilion, where he dual cultivated and dual-soul cultivated with them.
Since she had accompanied Zhang Fei and dual cultivated with him in the cocoon for a year, Nalan Wangzi did not join them; instead, she went to the training ground and practiced alone there.

Zhang Fei’s four clones also dual-cultivated and dual-soul cultivated with their respective wives in four other rooms. However, his fifth clone had not returned to the pavilion, forcing Qing Qiu’er, Yan Jinwu, and Sima Huiqing to wait for him.
Within the Blood Sea, Zhang Fei [5] managed to persuade the Slaughter Blood Phantom to take him to the underground river, and the two were on their way there.

Upon arrival, Zhang Fei [5] saw a blood-red river, which was pure blood essence. He also saw countless wandering evil souls roaming the river, all of which were as powerful as the ones in the Wailing Soul Forest.

However, those evil souls did not dare to approach Zhang Fei [5], mainly because of the presence of the Slaughter Blood Phantom. This way, he didn’t need to bother using the soul link to borrow the power of the beasts in his beast space.
On the way, Zhang Fei [5] absorbed the blood essence in the underground river, and he also let the demon extermination sword absorb those wandering evil souls.
As they got closer to their destination, Zhang Fei [5] could sense an extremely terrifying bloodlust coming from its deepest parts, which caused the Slaughter Blood Phantom to tremble violently.

Zhang Fei [5] rubbed the head of the Slaughter Blood Phantom. "This bloodlust belongs to the late ten-tailed fox, and he was once a primordial being, so his bloodlust is far stronger than that of other living beings, including the Asura Demon God. I know you’re scared of it, but trust me, everything will be fine because I am his successor."
The Slaughter Blood Phantom nodded to Zhang Fei [5], and it slowly began to calm down due to his presence.

Some time later, they arrived at the end of the underground river, and the bloodlust in that place was suffocating for them. Zhang Fei [5] was naturally unperturbed by that, and he released his bloodlust to counter it before jumping to the ground on the surface.
The Slaughter Blood Phantom did not follow Zhang Fei [5] and waited at the underground blood river, preventing those wandering evil souls from approaching the area.
Zhang Fei [5] leisurely walked over to the red fox statue at the end of the area, but a powerful pressure immediately enveloped him and pressed down, causing the ground beneath him to crack.

Zhang Fei [5] transformed into his complete nine-tailed fox form and activated the soul link, borrowing the strength of all evil beasts in his beast space. "Phew! Old fox, I know you are inside the statue, and I came to meet you, so please come out now."
*Swoosh*
A giant ten-tailed fox immediately shot out from within the statue, but it was different from any other that Zhang Fei [5] had encountered in the past.

The ten-tailed fox’s lust soul is plain white, as is his benevolent soul. His evil soul is pitch black, and his proud soul is blackish red. Meanwhile, his bloodlust soul in front of Zhang Fei [5] was deep blood red.

The ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul stared at Zhang Fei [5] with his bloody-red eyes. "You didn’t disappoint me, brat. Your cultivation is still low, but your bloodlust is deadlier than that Asura Demon God."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] chuckled. "I’ve faced many enemies to reach this place, and I’ve killed too many living creatures either directly or indirectly."

The ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul nodded at him. "Unfortunately, your bloodlust is still inferior to mine, so you must continue to hone it; otherwise, you will never be able to defeat the primordial genesis beast and the primordial nihility beast."

"Sigh." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at him. "Old fox, you were once a primordial being, and you’ve lived for millions or even billions of years, okay? Unlike you, I was born as a human, and I was born in a world without qi. Currently, I’m still 45 years old, so I still have plenty of time to develop in the future, and I will definitely surpass you one day."
"Hahaha!" The ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul laughed heartily when he heard that. "Your arrogance is sky-high, kid."

Zhang Fei [5] shrugged his shoulders. "Isn’t this due to the influence of your pride soul? At first, I wasn’t this arrogant, but I became extremely arrogant after I merged with that soul. So, do you also want to fight with me before merging with me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1299: Out Of Control
paragraphs: "Compared to fighting, there’s something more interesting." Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow for a moment, but the ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul suddenly shot a ball of blood into his body.
*Swoosh*
"Shit!" Zhang Fei [5] hurriedly suppressed his overflowing bloodlust, causing both of his eyes to turn completely red like blood. "Damn it!"
[Ding]
[A powerful bloodlust enters the host’s body.]
[The process for neutralizing the bloodlust begins.]
Zhang Fei [5] immediately sat cross-legged on the ground, won his mind, and let the system do its work.

"Hahaha." The ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul laughed heartily upon seeing Zhang Fei [5]’s condition. "I only gave you a millionth of my bloodlust, but you’ve already lost control, let alone if my soul merges with yours. If that happens, your bloodlust will overcome you, and you will lose your rationality. If you can’t control it, you will eventually turn into a cold-blooded killer."
[The bloodlust has been neutralized.]

"Is that so?" The ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul looked at Zhang Fei [5] in surprise as his condition suddenly returned to normal. "I had some difficulty controlling it at first, but I’ve got it under control now."
The ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul narrowed its eyes at Zhang Fei [5] before shooting more bloodlust into his body. "Taste it."
*Swoosh*
Like before, Zhang Fei’s [5] bloodlust flared up again, and it became deadlier than before. To his relief, the system quickly reactivated itself.
[Ding]
[A powerful bloodlust enters the host’s body.]
[The process for neutralizing the bloodlust begins.]
"Hmm?" The ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul kept observing Zhang Fei [5], and he shot several more blood balls towards him while the system had not finished neutralizing the previous one.
*Swoosh*
[Ding]
[A powerful bloodlust enters the host’s body.]
[The process for neutralizing the bloodlust begins.]
’Fuck! This old fox!’ Zhang Fei [5] couldn’t remain silent any longer, and he followed the system to suppress his bloodlust, which was getting stronger.
The ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul showed off its sharp teeth and shot several more blood balls toward Zhang Fei [5]. "Hahaha! Let’s see how long you can last, kid."
*Swoosh*
[Ding]
[A powerful bloodlust enters the host’s body.]
[The process for neutralizing the bloodlust begins.]
’Fuck! I really want to beat this damn soul!’
"Oh? You can still hold it in, huh? In that case, I’ll add more." Having said that, the ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul has more blood balls than the previous five towards Zhang Fei [5].
*Swoosh... Swoosh... Swoosh...*
[Ding]
[A powerful bloodlust enters the host’s body.]
[The process for neutralizing the bloodlust begins.]

This time, Zhang Fei [5] was on the verge of erupting as a bloody red aura enveloped his body, and his muscles bulged from beneath his skin in numerous blood-red lines. Even his eyes turned even redder, like someone controlled by his bloodlust.

Fortunately, Zhang Fei’s real body and his other four clones also tried hard to suppress the bloodlust, and they were helped by several women. The system also works even faster as his bloodlust continues to increase.
[The bloodlust has been neutralized.]
The ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul seemed annoyed when he saw Zhang Fei [5]’s bloodlust begin to subside, and he shot even more blood balls into his body.
*Swoosh... Swoosh... Swoosh...*
[Ding]
[A powerful bloodlust enters the host’s body.]
[The process for neutralizing the bloodlust begins.]
*Boom*
Zhang Fei [5]’s bloodlust finally exploded, frightening not only the Slaughter Blood Phantom and wandering evil souls in the area but also the Blood Tree King, which resided directly above.

"Hahaha." The ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul laughed heartily upon seeing Zhang Fei [5] losing control of his bloodlust. Instead of waiting for it to subside, he shot many other blood balls, which immediately entered his body. "Hahahaha!"
*Swoosh... Swoosh... Swoosh...*
[Ding]
[A powerful bloodlust enters the host’s body.]
[The process for neutralizing the bloodlust begins.]
*Boom... Boom... Boom...*
Mei, who had been observing the changes in Zhang Fei [5], was left speechless by the actions of the ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul.
The Slaughter Blood Phantom and all the wandering evil souls in the underground river decided to stay away from Zhang Fei [5]’s location, especially when his bloodlust spread toward the exit route.

In the pavilion, Nalan Wangzi restrained Zhang Fei, as his bloodlust had already taken control of him. Fei Lian and Yao Qilin restrained his other four clones; otherwise, they would attack all the women present, and they would suffer serious injuries.

"What exactly happened? Why did he suddenly become like this?" Nalan Yushu asked in confusion.

Nalan Wangzi suddenly remembered something. "His fifth clone hasn’t returned here yet, right? If my guess is correct, his clone must have gone to meet one of the tailed fox souls hidden in that domain, and that soul influenced his bloodlust."

"If I remember correctly, big brother told me once that the ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul was hidden there." All of them turned to Xu Ling’er. "Back then, the ten-tailed fox’s pride soul told him to go to the Slaughter Blood Domain, and he told him about that soul."

In the Slaughter Blood Domain, a strong tremor suddenly shook Shang Zhanluo, Shang Chi, and the five asura demon guardians who were conversing in the palace.

"Damn it! Who owns this bloodlust? How can this bloodlust be this strong? It even surpasses mine!" Shang Zhanluo spoke with a furious and fearful expression.

Shang Luohu immediately spoke to him. "Husband, I remember Zhang Xiaolong thinking of entering the underground river, and the river is connected to the area below this place, so I’m sure this bloodlust is his."
"Are you fucking kidding me? How could a young demon like him have such a powerful bloodlust that surpasses mine?" Shang Zhanluo responded with a raised voice.
Shang Luohu shook her head. "I don’t understand that myself, but I’m pretty sure that Zhang Xiaolong is the owner of this bloodlust."
"Hmm?" Shang Zhanluo frowned. "Hey, Shu Wang! There’s an entrance to the underground below you, right?"

Shu Wang nodded. "There’s an entrance below me, but you still won’t be able to enter that place. If I open the entrance, those wandering evil souls will also escape, and they will wreak havoc in this domain."

"Open the entrance now! Don’t mind those wandering evil souls; I can ask Nalan Shizhe for help to eliminate them. Shu Wang looked at Shang Zhanluo for a while before opening the entrance, but Zhang Fei [5]’s bloodlust spread further into the forest, frightening them. "Let’s go! We have to get rid of that brat as quickly as possible!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1300: Frightened Asura Demons
paragraphs: "Emperor, the more we walk forward, the stronger this bloodlust becomes." Shang Beixuan spoke.
Shang Dongzhu chimed in. "I’m not sure if this bloodlust belongs to that young demon, Emperor."
"Perhaps there is a powerful living being residing in this underground path, Emperor." Shang Nanzhui said.

"Emperor, this bloodlust somehow feels familiar to me." Shang Zhanluo turned to Shang Xijiao. "This bloodlust is a bit similar to Long Wuzhao but also different, so I think its owner is a beast like him."
Shang Zhanluo raised an eyebrow. "Have you ever known of a beast that has such a powerful bloodlust other than Long Wuzhao before, Zhui?"

"In the past, I accidentally witnessed Qiongqi fighting Long Xukong, and his bloodlust was nearly or even as powerful as this one. Besides, Beixuan and the others had sparred with Zhang Xiaolong before, and his bloodlust wasn’t this strong yet, so I agreed with Xijiao that the owner should be someone else." Shang Zhanluo did not refute Shang Zhui. "If he wants to achieve a bloodlust as strong as this one, he must kill millions or even billions of living beings, and he won’t be able to achieve that at such a young age."

"Zhui is right, husband. I witnessed their spar before, so I also think that Zhang Xiaolong is not the owner of this bloodlust." Shang Luohu put on a serious face as she looked ahead. "There’s no point in us wondering now, and we’ll find the answer once we reach that place. However, Shu Wang previously said that the area is covered by a powerful barrier that is still too strong for even him, so I’m not sure we’ll be able to break through it."

Shang Zhanluo agreed with his wife, but a thought suddenly flashed through his mind. "What if that brat had already killed millions or billions of living beings before? He’s too weak to fight cultivators from this realm, but he came from the Three Mortal Realms."
"You mean Zhang Xiaolong has killed many living creatures in the Three Mortal Realms, husband?"

"Yes." Shang Zhanluo then continued. "I don’t know the situation in the Three Mortal Realms because I’ve never descended there before, but I think he’s stronger than the cultivators from that place. Even Shang Xiuluo acknowledged his strength, and he was willing to help him as far as bringing him here, so I think such a possibility should exist."

"I agree with you, Emperor." Shang Xijiao spoke again. "When I sparred with Zhang Xiaolong some time ago, he was able to suppress his bloodlust and killing intent to the point that I couldn’t detect them, and his speed far surpassed mine. Moreover, he could materialize his bloodlust into a bloody red figure with his low cultivation, so I agree with you that he has already surpassed all the cultivators in the Three Mortal Realms."
"Therefore, it is very likely that Zhang Xiaolong has killed too many living beings in the Three Mortal Realms, and if that is true, then this bloodlust is probably his." Shang Nanzhui added.

After he recalled his spar with Zhang Fei, Shang Beixuan immediately spoke. "That kid should be the strongest cultivator in the Three Mortal Realms, Emperor. Back when I sparred with him, I didn’t use my true strength, but my raw strength was still superior. He only got minor bruises from my repeated attacks, and he wasn’t in much pain at the time because of his ability to recover from his injuries extremely quickly. If cultivators at his level had suffered all my attacks back then, I’m sure they wouldn’t have been able to recover for at least a year, which proved his body’s strength and resilience."
"Let’s move faster."
*Roar*

An extremely loud, powerful roar suddenly resounded within the underground path, followed by a powerful shockwave rushing towards them. Shang Zhanluo and the others tried to block it, but all of them were knocked quite far back, which shocked them.
"Where did that shockwave come from?" Shang Beixuan shouted.

Shang Zhanluo’s expression became serious after being hit by the shockwave attack. After all, his cultivation was already at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable and he was the demon god of his Asura Demon Race, but the shockwave could knock him so far away.
Shang Luohu immediately spoke to him. "That attack just now wasn’t Zhang Xiaolong’s, Husband. With his current cultivation and strength, he would never have been able to knock us back this far."

"I agree with my empress, Emperor." Shang Zhui tried to use something and shoot it forward, but it immediately disappeared on its own. "See? I am certain that another living being resided in the front area, and the barrier was intentionally placed there to prevent that individual from escaping. However, I have an idea about who installed that barrier, and it was powerful enough to stop Shu Wang from detecting the area inside. The attack just now was clearly a warning, indicating that the individual did not want us to approach that area."
"Let’s go!" Shang Zhanluo didn’t listen to Shang Zhui and walked forward again, making them sigh helplessly.

Like before, another powerful shockwave shot toward them, but Shang Zhanluo was already prepared to meet it, and he deflected it straight away. He immediately ran quickly towards the front area, forcing Shang Luohu and the others to follow him in a hurry.
Several powerful shockwaves attacked them again, but Shang Zhanluo continued to deflect them, making their journey easier than before.

When they were halfway there, Shang Zhanluo and the others suddenly stopped in their tracks. They stared at the ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul that suddenly appeared, blocking their path. Even with their superior strength, they trembled as the fox’s bloody red eyes stared at them, causing Shang Luohu and the five asura guardians to involuntarily take several steps back.
Unlike them, Shang Zhanluo stood still in his spot, undeterred by the presence of the ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul. "Who exactly are you? How did you get in here?"
*Roar*
*Crack... Crack...*

The ground beneath Shang Zhanluo started to crack because of the ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul’s roar, causing him to tremble while frowning. "You are not a true living being, and this is just your soul remnant, right?"
"Even if I’m just my soul remnant, I can still defeat you easily, puny asura demon god."

Shang Zhanluo’s facial veins bulged out after hearing the ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul’s taunt, but Shang Luohu hurriedly walked behind him and grabbed his hand, speaking to him via voice transmission. ’Husband, this fox is not an ordinary fox! He is the remnant soul of the ten-tailed fox, the strongest living being ever born in this universe. Even though it is only his soul remnant, he is still stronger than us, so we should not disturb him.’

Shang Zhui and the other four asura guardians swallowed their saliva as they stared at the ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul. They were fighting demons, and they had fought countless battles until they could reach their current level, but the mere presence of the ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul frightened them, and they wanted to run away from that place as quickly as possible. ’What a terrifying monster!’

"Hmm?" Shang Zhanluo naturally knew about the ten-tailed fox, but he never expected that his soul remnant would live underground in his domain. He seriously looked at the ten tails before asking. "Senior, can—"
"Scram!" The ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul shouted. "If you guys don’t leave this place, I will attack you for real, and I guarantee your souls will be destroyed."
Shang Luohu pulled her husband’s hand. ’Let’s go back, husband! We must not anger the ten-tailed fox!’
Seeing Shang Zhanluo continuing to remain silent, the ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul opened its mouth wide, showing off its sharp teeth.
"Please stop it, senior. We’ll go now." Shang Zhanluo finally gave in after realizing the disparity in their strength.
"Leave!"
Shang Zhanluo took a deep breath and turned around, leading Shang Luohu and the others to leave the place.
As they followed behind Shang Zhanluo, Shang Luohu and the others felt relief in their hearts, especially since the ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul was extremely frightening for them.

Shan Zhanluo repeatedly glanced at the ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul. ’Holy shit! Just his soul remnant is already this powerful! How could such a powerful beast like him die? How strong would he be if he were still alive and using his real body? I’m sure not even Long Wuzhao and the four perils can fight him, and they will definitely submit to him.’
After he confirmed that they were gone, the ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul disappeared from that location and returned to Zhang Fei [5].

The ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul observed Zhang Fei [5]. "This kid is quite tough, huh? I’ve already given him quite a bit of my bloodlust, and his bloodlust has gone out of control, but he still hasn’t turned cold-blooded. Perhaps, he will truly surpass me in the future, and he might be able to free himself and those around him from the universe chains to become free-living beings."
The ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul narrowed his eyes as white smoke billowed out of Zhang Fei [5]’s body. "So, he’s already gotten you, huh?"

"Haha." The ten-tailed fox’s benevolent soul laughed at that. "I’ve lived inside his soul for over two decades, but you’re wrong if you think I’m helping him because he doesn’t need my help to receive our bloodlust."
"If you don’t help him, then who helps him?"

"Even if I’m just my soul remnant, I can still defeat you easily, puny asura demon god."

Shang Zhanluo’s facial veins bulged out after hearing the ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul’s taunt, but Shang Luohu hurriedly walked behind him and grabbed his hand, speaking to him via voice transmission. ’Husband, this fox is not an ordinary fox!

Shang Zhui and the other four asura guardians swallowed their saliva as they stared at the ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul.

"Senior, can—"

"If you guys don’t leave this place, I will attack you for real, and I guarantee your souls will be destroyed."
Shang Luohu pulled her husband’s hand. ’Let’s go back, husband!

Seeing Shang Zhanluo continuing to remain silent, the ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul opened its mouth wide, showing off its sharp teeth.
"Please stop it, senior.

"Leave!"
Shang Zhanluo took a deep breath and turned around, leading Shang Luohu and the others to leave the place.
As they followed behind Shang Zhanluo, Shang Luohu and the others felt relief in their hearts, especially since the ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul was extremely frightening for them.
Shan Zhanluo repeatedly glanced at the ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul. ’Holy shit!

After he confirmed that they were gone, the ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul disappeared from that location and returned to Zhang Fei [5].

The ten-tailed fox’s bloodlust soul narrowed his eyes as white smoke billowed out of Zhang Fei [5]’s body.
"So, he’s already gotten you, huh?"

"I’ve lived inside his soul for over two decades, but you’re wrong if you think I’m helping him because he doesn’t need my help to receive our bloodlust."
"If you don’t help him, then who helps him?"
